title: 15 Minute Quiche
instructions: Microwave onions on High 2 minutes in a round 1 quart container. Sprinkle bacon and cheese over onions. Heat milk for 2 minutes in microwave. Combine eggs, salt, cayenne, and pepper in medium sized mixing bowl and slowly whisk in the milk.
Pour over onion mixture and microwave, covered, for 5 minutes. Cut into wedges and serve. Enjoy!

title: 2-minute Fudge
ingredients: In 1 1/2 quart casserole or large glass bowl stir sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla together until partially blended (mixture is too stiff to thoroughly blend in all of dry ingredients).  Put butter over top in center of dish. Microwave at High 2 Minutes, or until milk feels warm on bottom of dish.  Stir vigorously until smooth.  If all butter has not melted in cooking, it will as mixture is stirred. Blend in nuts.  Pour into wax paper lined 8 x 4 x 3 inch dish.  Chill 1 hour in refrigerator or 20 to 30 minutes in freezer.  Cut into squares.

title: 3-Ingredient Baked Ham and Cheese Rollups
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Roll out pizza dough on a lightly floured surface. Press to form a 12 x 8-inch rectangle.

Arrange ham slices evenly over dough to within 1/2 inch of edges. Sprinkle evenly with cheese. Starting at one of the short ends, roll up dough to form log. Pinch seam together to seal. Place, seam side down, on a greased baking sheet.
Bake for 50 minutes, or until deep golden brown. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting into 8 slices with a serrated knife.
Serve with mustard or horseradish sauce, if desired.
Enjoy!

title: Acapulco Bay Shrimp Salad
ingredients: In a medium size bowl whisk oil and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper.  Add shrimp, onion, tomatoes, avocado, cilantro and basil, toss lightly.  Let stand for about 15 minutes before serving.  Mound on lettuce leaves.

title: Aioli Sauce
ingredients: olive oil (or vary the oil for different flavors)
instructions: You should have all of the ingredients at room temperature before you start. Make this in a bowl that is heavy enough that it won't move across the counter as you're mixing, or make it in your food processor. Mix the garlic, egg yolk, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a heavy mixing bowl with a hand mixer until the yolk lightens and thickens slightly (about 1 minute).

Start adding the olive oil, drop by drop, mixing all the while with your hand mixer. You can add it a bit faster as you go along, but as with mayonnaise, the key to success is going very slowly. When you are done adding the oil you can adjust the seasoning as suits your taste.
This makes 1 cup - maybe you should double the recipe, it is so good.

title: Albondigas (mexican Meatball)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl.  Mixture will be wet. Form 1 ounce balls.
Bake on rack in oven at 350 for 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Albondigas and Tortilla Soup Base
ingredients: Dice all vegetables into 1/2 inch pieces.  Combine all ingredients, including vegetables into large pot.  Bring to boil and then simmer. Just before serving, simmer meatballs in soup broth.

title: Alessandro's Seashell Pasta W/almond Pesto and Shrimp
ingredients: Freshly ground black pepper to taste

Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil on high heat. Add pasta and cook until al dente, tender but still firm to the bite. Drain and set aside. 2. To prepare pesto, process almonds and garlic until minced. Add basil, parsley, spinach, and olive oil; process until minced. 3. Heat a large, heavy bottomed skillet on medium-high heat. Add butter. Add shrimp in single layer. Sauté shrimp just until cooked through, turning half way through cooking. Season with salt and pepper. Add cream and cook until heated. Remove from heat and stir in enough pesto to make a creamy sauce (see cook's notes about using leftover pesto). Add pasta and toss to coat. 4. Use tongs to arrange shrimp, placing them near the edge of the plates; top shrimp with diced tomatoes. Fill center of each plate with pasta and top with lemon zest. Serve immediately.

title: Alfredo Sauce
ingredients: Large pot to boil water and cook the pasta
instructions: Melt the butter in a sauce pan but don't let it boil or it will separate. If it does, toss it out and start fresh. This sauce must be creamy.
Slowly add the cream and let is simmer for about 1 minute. It will thicken slightly as it heats but the sauce really get thick once you add the parmigiano.

Once the butter and cream are heated and begin to thicken naturally, sprinkle with the nutmeg and salt. This adds a really subtle and deliciously soothing flavor. You'll taste it even though it's subtitle.
Drain the pasta directly from the hot water. Then almost immediately add it to the cream and butter mixture.
IMPORTANT: Remove from the heat and then add the parmigiano and toss.
Now we're dining on the classic fettucini with an Alfredo sauce recipe like there's no tomorrow!

title: Alice’s Cranberry Sauce Recipe
ingredients: Place all the ingredients in a sauce pan and cook on medium-high for 15-20 minutes or until most of the liquid has reduced – stirring occasionally. You’ll hear the cranberries popping – don’t worry, that’s what you want them to do. Remove from heat and serve.  Cranberry sauce can be made days ahead and brought to room temperature or slightly heated before serving.

title: Almond Banana Nut Bread
ingredients: Pre heat oven to 350. Grease and flour two loaf pans. Beat banana, oil, sugar, brown sugar. eggs and vanilla. Combine flour, baking powder, soda, and salt.  Reserving 2 T of almonds for top, stir remaining almonds into batter. Divide batter evenly between the loaf pans, sprinkle each loaf with 1 T almonds. Bake 50-60 minutes. Cool on rack.

title: Almond Cake That Will Save Your Soul
instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Butter sides and bottoms of one 9-inch springform pan; line sides and bottoms with parchment paper. Butter the paper. (You may forego the parchment paper as long as you are generous with the butter on the pan itself.) Mix together the sour cream and baking soda in a small bowl. Sift the flour and salt into another bowl.
2. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle, cream the butter and sugar until fluffy. Add the almond paste, a little at a time, at medium speed, and beat for 8 minutes.

Beat in the egg yolks one at a time, and mix until incorporated. It will look curdled; don’t worry. Blend in the almond extract and sour cream mixture. Reduce mixer speed to low and gradually add the flour mixture, just until blended.
3. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and spread evenly.

Bake about 1 hour. It is done when you press the top and it returns to its shape, and also shrinks from the sides of the pan. Remove from the oven and place on a baking rack to cool in the pan. When ready to serve, sift confectioners’ sugar on top and slice like a pie.
Behold the celestial magesty of this cake:

title: ALMOND CAKE WITH BOYSENBERRY JAM
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Butter 8 inch round cake pan with 2 inch high sides.  Line bottom with parchment; butter parchment.  Blend sugar and almond paste in processor until finely ground.  Sift flour, baking powder, and salt into medium bowl.  Using electric mixer, beat almond paste, butter, and vanilla in large bowl on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.  Add eggs 1 at a time, beating on medium high speed until incorporated.  Fold in dry ingredients.  Transfer to pan.

Bake cake 40 minutes without opening oven.  rotate pan; bake until top is golden and cake is firm to touch, about 8 minutes.  Cool in pan on rack 10 minutes. Run knife around pan sides.  Invert cake; remove parchment.  Turn cake over; cool on rack.

Using long serrated knife, cut cake in half horizontally.  Using tart pan bottom as aid, transfer top half of cake to work surface.  Spread jam over cut surface of remaining cake layer.  Place top layer, cut side down, atop jam.  Can be made 8 hours ahead.  Cover and let stand at room temperature.  Dust cake with powdered sugar and serve with whipped cream.

title: Almond Cheesecake Bars
ingredients: graham cracker or vanilla wafer crumbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Spray an 8x8 pan with non-stick cooking spray. Mix crust ingredients together in a mixing bowl. Mix well. Press into prepared pan. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until firm. Mix cream cheese and SPLENDA® Granulated Sweetener together until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time, scraping the sides of the bowl, and mixing well after each addition. Add sour cream and extracts; mix well. Pour over prepared crust. Bake in preheated oven for 40 to 47 minutes, or until firm. Top with toasted almonds. Makes 20 bars. Preparation Time: 15 Minutes Total Time: 1 Hour 14 Minutes
Nutrition Info Per Serving (1 bar): Calories 120 | Calories from Fat 70 | Fat 8g (sat 3.5g) | Cholesterol 35mg | Sodium 105mg | Carbohydrates 8g | Fiber 0g | Sugars 4g | Protein 4g

title: Almond Coconut Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Combine butter, sugar and brown sugar in large bowl. Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often, until creamy. Add eggs and almond extract; mix well. Reduce speed to low; add flour and baking soda. Mix well. Stir in coconut, almonds and 1/2 cup white baking chips.
Drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake for 8 to 11 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets. Cool completely.

Place 3/4 cup white baking chips and shortening in small microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on HIGH (100% power), stirring every 30 seconds, until melted (1 to 2 minutes). Drizzle over cooled cookies in a crisscross pattern.

title: Almond Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Combine all cookie ingredients in large bowl. Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often, until creamy.

Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls, 2 inches apart, onto ungreased cookie sheets. Flatten balls to 1/4 inch thick with bottom of buttered glass dipped in sugar. Bake for 7 to 9 minutes or until edges are very lightly browned. Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets. Cool completely.
Combine all glaze ingredients except almonds in small bowl with wire whisk. Decorate cooled cookies with glaze and sliced almonds as desired.

title: Almond Orange Balls
ingredients: In large bowl, combine vanilla wafers and almonds. Stir in corn syrup, orange marmalade and liqueur. Turn onto work surface; knead until blended and smooth. Shape into 1-inch balls, roll in powdered sugar. Sprinkle top of each ball with orange peel.

title: Almond Strips
ingredients: cups cold LAND O LAKES® Butter
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Combine flour, sugar and salt in large bowl; cut in butter with pastry blender or fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Mix in enough water until flour is just moistened.

Shape dough into ball; divide into fourths. Wrap each in plastic food wrap; refrigerate for 1 hour. Roll out dough, one-fourth at a time (keeping remaining dough refrigerated), on lightly floured surface to 12x8-inch rectangle. Cut into 4 (8x3)-inch strips. Place strips onto ungreased cookie sheets.

Combine all filling ingredients in small bowl with fork until well mixed. Spread about 1 tablespoon filling down center of each strip. Moisten edges of strips with water. Fold pastry over filling; press edges together with fork. Prick tops in several places. Bake for 14 to 17 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 2 to 3 minutes; remove from cookie sheets. Cool completely. Repeat with remaining pastry and filling.

Combine powdered sugar, almond extract and enough milk for desired glazing consistency. Drizzle glaze over cooled cookie strips. Sprinkle with decorator sugar, if desired. Cut strips into 2-inch lengths.
*Substitute 1 (7-ounce) roll almond paste.

title: ALMOST CHERRY GARCIA COOKIES
ingredients: Plump dried cherries by covering them with boiling water.  Let stand a couple of minutes.  Drain well and toss with cherry liquer.  Drain when required or let sit a couple of hours or overnight for best flavor, then drain and use in reciper.  Cream butter with granulated and brown sugars.  Blend in egg, vanilla and almond extracts.  Fold in salt, baking soda and flour.  Fold in drained cherries, white and semisweet chocolate and nuts.  Batter should be soft.  Drop in generous tablespoons onto baking sheets lined with parchment paper.  Bake at 350 degrees until lightly browned around edges, 12 to 14 minutes.

title: Almost Instant Rice Salad
ingredients: In small bowl, whisk lemon juice, oil, cumin, a pinch of salt, and pepper to taste until well blended. In medium bowl, mix beans, feta, green onions, tomato, parsley, and cooked rice; gently stir in avocado.

title: Aloha L.a. Cocktail
ingredients: peeled, cored and cut into 1-inch cubes (to yield about 3 cups)
fresh lime juice (from 2 to 3 large limes)
instructions: In a blender, combine the pineapple, rum, agave nectar, and lime juice. Blend until the pineapple is almost pureed. Pour the pineapple mixture into a large pitcher. Add the ice and stir. Slowly pour in the ginger ale.
Pour the cocktail into glasses and garnish with lime wedges.

title: Amaretto Brownies
instructions: Combine shortening and chocolate in a heavy saucepan; place over low heat, stirring constantly, until melted. Add sugar, stirring until combined.  Remove from heat and cool. Stir in eggs and amaretto. Combine flour and salt; add to creamed mixture, stirring well.  Pour batter into a lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes; cool. Frost with Amaretto Frosting. Sprinkle with sliced almonds. Cut into squares.

AMARETTO FROSTING Combine butter and chocolate in a heavy saucepan; place over low heat, stirring constantly, until melted. Stir in half and half. Add powdered sugar, salt and Amaretto, stirring until smooth.

title: Amaretto Dessert Truffles
ingredients: Melt chocolate in top of a double boiler.  Remove from heat, add butter, stirring in 1 T at a time.  Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored.  Gradually stir bout 1/4 of hot mixture into yolks; add to remaining hot mixture, stirring constantly.  Stir in whipping cream and amaretto.  Return to heat and cook 1 minute or until mixture is thickened and smooth, stirring constantly. Cover and refrigerate until firm enough to roll into balls. Roll truffles in chopped almonds or cocoa.  Store in refrigerator.

title: AMARETTO MINI CHEESECAKES
ingredients: Combine crumbs, butter and sugar.  Press rounded tablespoon onto bottom of 24 paper lined muffin cups.  Bake at 325 degrees for 5 minutes.  Combine cream cheese, sugar, amaretto, vanilla and almond extracts.  Mix at medium until blended.  Blend in eggs, pour over crust, filling 3/4 full.  Bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes.  Cool in pan.  Cover and refrigerate.  May be made the day before.  Plate ten minutes before serving and top with glazed almonds.

title: Amaretto Rice Pudding
ingredients: Combine eggs, sugar, salt in a medium mixing bowl. Slowly add scaled milk, stirring constantly. Stir in rice, Amaretto, cinnamon and vanilla. Spoon mixture into a buttered 1 1/2 quart baking dish.  Place dish in a larger shallow pan; add 1 inch of water to pan.  Bake at 325 for 1 hour.  Stir pudding, sprinkle with nutmeg, and bake an additional 30 minutes.  Remove dish from pan; let cool.

title: Amazing Sausage Hash
instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, brown the sausage.
Add onion, carrots and green pepper; cook until tender.
Stir in potatoes, salt and pepper. Reduce heat; cook and stir for 20 minutes or until lightly browned and heated through.

title: Ambrosia Salad
ingredients: Combine the orange, bananas, grapes and sprinkle with lemon juice and chill.  Fold mayonnaise in whipped cream. Serve on lettuce and sprinkle with the flaked coconut.

title: American Beef Pot Roast & Cheesy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: (1-3/4 to 2-1/2 pounds) refrigerated fully-cooked boneless beef pot roast with gravy
(16 to 20 ounces) refrigerated or frozen ready-to-eat mashed potatoes
instructions: Prepare potatoes according to package directions. Stir in cheese, milk and salt and pepper as desired; keep warm.

Meanwhile remove pot roast from package. Transfer gravy to 2-quart microwave-safe casserole. Stir in mustard. Cut pot roast into 1-inch pieces. Combine beef with gravy mixture. Cover and microwave on HIGH 6 to 9 minutes or until hot, stirring once.
Transfer beef mixture to platter; spoon potatoes around beef. Sprinkle with onions and parsley.
Per serving:	717 calories; 54 g protein; 40 g carbohydrate; 23 g fat; 1,643 mg sodium; 166 mg cholesterol; 6.8 mg niacin; 0.6 mg vitamin B6; 6.3 mcg vitamin B12; 5.3 mg iron; 15.2 mg zinc._____

title: Angel Hair with Zucchini and Tomatoes
ingredients: crushed red pepper flakes to taste
low-sodium fat-free chicken or (vegetable broth for vegetarian)
instructions: In a large pot of salted boiling water, cook pasta according to instructions.

While pasta is cooking, in a large saute pan, heat pan on medium-high flame, add oil when pan is hot. Add garlic and shallots to the pan and saute about 1 minute. Add zucchini and season with salt and pepper. Cook about 2 minutes, add tomatoes, crushed red pepper flakes, parsley, chicken broth and adjust salt and pepper. Stir for another minute. Remove from flame.
Drain pasta when done reserving some of the water and and toss the pasta well with zucchini. Add pasta water if needed and serve with grated Parmesan (optional).

title: Angie’s Tuscan Olives
ingredients: DIRECTIONS: CREATE A FOILVESSEL. POUR IN  OLIVES. PEEL THE RIND OF ORANGE AND LEMON—ADD TO OLIVES.CHOP FENNEL  TO BITE SIZE PIECES—ADD TO OLIVES. SPRINKLE IN FENNEL SEEDSAND CHILI  FLAKES. TOSS ALL IN EVOO AND BAKE 20-30 MINUTES IN 350 DEGREE OVEN.

title: Antipasti Bites
instructions: Preheat to 400 degrees and position a rack in the middle of the oven.
Place one salami slice in each muffin cup. Press the salami slices into the cups. Bake for about 7-10 minutes or until salami is crisp. Remove from the oven and let cool.

Next, in a large bowl, mix together artichoke hearts, roasted peppers, basil and the mozzarella balls. NOTE: You can prepare the artichoke mixture before hand and chill in refrigerator for up to a day ahead of time.
Place the salami cups on a platter. Fill with the artichoke mixture. Top with more chopped basil.

title: Antipasto Pasta Salad
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente. Drain, and cool under cold water.

In a large bowl, combine the pasta, salami, pepperoni, Asiago cheese, black olives, red bell pepper, green bell pepper and tomatoes. Stir in the envelope of dressing mix. Cover, and refrigerate for at least one hour.
To prepare the dressing, whisk together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, oregano, parsley, Parmesan cheese, salt and pepper. Just before serving, pour dressing over the salad, and mix well.

title: Apple Bread
ingredients: Cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy, beat in eggs. Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Add alternately with apples to egg mixture. Stir in lemon rind and nuts. Bake in greased and floured loaf pan in preheated 350 oven for 50 to 60 minutes. Cool before slicing.

title: Apple Muffins
ingredients: Combine first 8 ingredients in a large bowl; make a well in center of mixture. Combine eggs, milk and oil; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Stir in apple and lemon rind. Spoon into muffin pans coated with cooking spray, filling 2/3 full. Bake 400 for 10 to 12 minutes.

title: Apple Nut Bread
ingredients: Cream butter; add sugar, beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine flour, soda, salt, lemon rind, cinnamon, nutmeg and apple; add to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture. Stir in walnuts. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350 to 55 - 60 minutes. Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove and cool on a wire rack.

title: APPLE PIE
instructions: Adjust oven rack to lowest position and preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place cookie sheet in oven.  Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.  Add apple slices, sugar and cinnamon, and when they start to sizzle and steam, reduce heat to low.  Cover pan and simmer until apples soften and release their juices, about 8 minutes.  Uncover, increase heat to medium high and cook, stirring frequently, until softer apples start to fall apart and juices thicken to thin syrup consistency, about 8-10 minutes longer.  Transfer apples to jelly roll pan; refrigerate or set in a cool place until apples cool to room temperature.  Stir in calvados and vanilla.

Remove disk from refrigerator.  Roll disk out on a lightly floured board into a 12 inch circle, about 1/8 inch thick.  Transer and fit dough into a 9 inch glass pie pan, leaving any overhanging dough in place.  Turn cooled apples into pie shell.

Roll other disk out on a lightly floured surface into a 10 inch circle.  Lay it over fruit.  Trim top and bottom edges to 1/2 inch beyond pan lip.  Tuck this rim of dough underneath itself so that folded edge is flush with pan lip.  Flut dough.  Cut 4 vents at right angles on top of dough to allow steam to escape.  Brush pie top with egg white and sprinkle with sugar.  Freeze pie for 15 minutes.

Place pie on a baking sheet and bake until top crust is golden, about 25 minutes.  Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees and continue baking until crust is golden brown and juices bubble, 40 minutes.  Transfer to a wire rack; cool slightly.  Serve warm.
Description: "PAM ANDERSON"

title: Apple Raisin Dip - Fondue Sauce
ingredients: Soak raisins in red wine until they are plump. Peel and dice apple. Puree all but walnuts in blender. Stir in walnuts.

title: Apple-raisin Cole Slaw
ingredients: Kosher salt and freshly ground black peppe

In a large bowl, stir together the raisins, celery seeds, mayonnaise, sour cream and apple cider vinegar. Add the cabbage, carrots, and apples, then toss to combine. Taste and season with a pinch of salt and a grind or two of pepper. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving.

title: APPLES GRILLED IN PARCHMENT PAPER
instructions: Quarter the apples through the core.  Remove & discard core, then slice each quarter into thin slices.  Place slices in a medium bowl.  Add the cranberries, maple sugar, brown sugar, and cinnamon.  Stir to combine.

TO MAKE THE PACKETS:  Spoon 1/4 of the apple mixture into the center of each piece of paper and dot with 1/4 of the butter.  Bring together the two long ends of each paper together and fold them over several times to seal the top of the packet.  Twist the other two ends of the papers in opposite directions to close the packets.
Grill the packets over Direct Medium heat for about 10 minutes.
Serve in packets along side entree or pour the apple mixture over ice cream
Description: "Weber's Big Book of Grilling pg. 381"

title: Applesauce Spice Delight
ingredients: Sift together first 8 ingredients and add to the applesauce mixture. Flour and grease pan. Sprinkle cake with topping and bake at 350 for 50 minutes. Do not overbake.

title: Apricot Bars
ingredients: Rinse apricots and cover with water. Boil 10 minutes and drain, cool and chop. Heat oven to 350. Grease 8x8x2 square pan. Mix butter, granulated sugar and 1 C flour until crumbly. Pack into pan and bake until lightly brown. Sift 1/2 C flour, baking powder and salt. Gradually beat brown sugar into egg. Add flour mixture and mix well. Add vanilla, nuts and apricots. Spread over baked layer and bake 30 minutes. Cool in pan. Cut into bars and roll in powdered sugar.

title: Apricot Chews
ingredients: Grease (not oil) 8" or 9" square pan.  In large saucepan, combine first 3 ingredients.  Simmer, covered, until water is absorbed.  Cool slightly.  Stir in remaining ingredients. Bake 350 oven for 20-30 minutes.  Cut into bars while warm. Coat with powdered sugar.

title: Apricot Glaze
ingredients: Process apricot preserves, mustards, butter, chopped shallot, salt, and water in food processor until thoroughly combined, 20 to 30 seconds, scraping down sides of workbowl as needed. Reserve half of glaze for serving and use other half to brush on chicken while grilling.

title: Apricot Jam
ingredients: Wash and slice apricots. Mix with sugar and pineapple (fruit and juice). Cook until desired consistency. Pour into sterilized jars.

title: Artichoke and Cheese Tart
instructions: Sift the flour into a mixing bowl, add a pinch of salt and the garlic. Cut in the butter until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs. Stir in the water and bring the mixture together to form a dough. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured work counter to fit an 8-inch flan pan. Prick the pastry with a fork.

Preheat oven to 400°F. Heat the oil in a skillet. Add the onion and sauté over a medium heat for 3 minutes. Add the artichoke hearts and cook, stirring frequently, for another 2 minutes. Mix the cheeses with the beaten eggs, rosemary, and milk. Stir in the drained artichoke mixture and season to taste.
Spoon the artichoke and cheese mixture into the pastry shell and cook in a preheated oven at 400°F for 25 minutes or until cooked and set. Serve the tart hot or cold.

title: Artichoke Chili Dip
instructions: Finely chop both types of artichokes.
Drain chilies and add mayonnaise and 1 cup cheese.
Mix all together.
Cut top of bread off. Cut and scoop out bread, leaving the crust.
Fill bread with mixture and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Put under the broiler until cheese melts.
Serve with tortilla chips and the scooped out bread.

title: Artichoke Dip
ingredients: Mix all ingredients together and bake 350-30 minutes. Serve with crackers

title: Artichoke Frittata
ingredients: Saute sausage with onion and garlic.  Add artichokes and cook over low heat for about 10 minutes.  Season to taste with pepper.  Stir in eggs and turn into an oiled 8 x 8 inch baking pan.  Sprinkle with parsley and cheese and bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

title: Artichoke, Endive and Radicchio Salad with Walnuts
ingredients: walnut oil or extra-virgin olive oil
mixed greens (such as curly endive and radicchio)
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients and 3 teaspoons vinegar in heavy large pot. Bring to boil. Add artichoke cut side down. Reduce heat, cover and simmer until artichoke is tender, turning once, about 40 minutes.

Transfer artichoke to bowl using slotted spoon. Discard onion. Boil cooking liquid until reduced to 1/4 cup, about 10 minutes. Strain liquid into small bowl. Whisk minced shallot, walnut oil and remaining 1/2 teaspoon vinegar into cooking liquid. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Refrigerate vinaigrette until cold. Remove all artichoke leaves. Scoop out choke and discard. Thinly slice artichoke heart. (Can be prepared up to 8 hours ahead. Cover and refrigerate vinaigrette and artichoke leaves and heart slices separately.)

Arrange artichoke leaves in spoke pattern around edge of plates. Toss greens and Belgian endive in large bowl with vinaigrette. Divide salad between plates. Tuck artichoke heart slices under greens. Sprinkle with walnuts.

title: Artichoke, Spinach, and White Bean Dip
ingredients: 15oz. can white beans, rinsed and drained
14 oz. baby artichoke hearts, drained and quartered

Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Place romano cheese, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, 1 teaspoon lemon juice, salt, black pepper, red pepper, minced garlic, and white beans in a food processor and process until smooth.  Spoon into a medium bowl.  Stir in the artichokes and spinach.  Spoon the mixture into a 1 quart glass or ceramic baking dish coated with cooking spray.  Sprinkle with 1/2 cup mozzarella.  Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until bubbly and brown.  1/4 cup = 2 pts.

title: Artichoke-Olive Crostini
ingredients: plus extra for brushing on bread
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F. In a food processor, process the garlic, olives, capers, artichoke hearts and olive oil to a coarse paste.
Slice the baguette.  Brush with olive oil on both sides.  Bake for about 6 to 8 minutes, turning once.

title: Asian Barbecue Chicken
instructions: In large sealable plastic bag, mix together hoisin sauce, honey, soy sauce, orange juice, garlic, green onion, ginger and cayenne pepper.
Add chicken thighs and marinate at least 1 hour in refrigerator. Remove chicken and place marinade in small saucepan over medium high heat; boil 2 minutes.

Arrange thighs on broiler pan and place on oven rack in medium or low position. Broil about 15 minutes, turn and broil about 10 minutes more, basting occasionally with marinade until thighs are done, taking care not to burn. Garnish with green onions.

title: ASIAN FLANK STEAK
ingredients: Whisk first 5 ingredients to blend in 13 x 9 glass baking pan.  Add steak and turn to coat.  Let stand 1 hour at room temperature or cover and refrigerate overnight, turning occasionally.  Barbecue.   Transfer steak to platter.  Let stand 10 minutes.  Thinly slice steak across grain.

title: ASPARAGUS GRATIN
ingredients: grated sharp cheddar or parmesan cheese

In a small saucepan heat the butter until frothy.  Stir in the flour and cook slowly, stirring constantly, for a minute.  Add the milk and broth, whisking vigorously and bring the liquid to a boil.  Reduce the heat and simmer the sauce for 3 to 5 minutes.  Stir in the cheese, remove the sauce from the heat and whisk it until the cheese has melted.  Season with salt and pepper.  Preheat the oven to 425 degrees.  Arrange the asparagus in the bottom of a baking dish.  Top with sliced eggs and spoon the sauce over the top.  Top with bread crumbs mixed with cheese and drizzle melted butter over the top.  Bake for 20 minutes or until the cheese sauce is bubbly.

title: Asparagus Gratin
ingredients: trimmed and cut diagonally into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Butter a 2- to 2 1/2-quart shallow ceramic flameproof baking dish.

Cook asparagus in a 5- to 6-quart pot of boiling salted water , uncovered, until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes. Drain in a colander, then transfer to baking dish and keep warm, tightly covered with foil.

Meanwhile, heat oil and butter in a 12-inch heavy skillet over high heat until foam subsides, then cook shallots, stirring occasionally, until pale golden, about 3 minutes. Add bread and pine nuts and cook, stirring, until browned in spots, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and add pepper, 1/2 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano, and 1/4 teaspoon salt, tossing to combine.
Preheat broiler.
Toss warm asparagus with mascarpone, remaining 1/2 cup Parmigiano-Reggiano, and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt until combined well.
Sprinkle bread-crumb mixture evenly over asparagus. Broil 5 to 7 inches from heat until topping is golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes.
(You can cook the asparagus early in the day and immediately put in ice water to stop cooking.  Then follow the recipe when you are ready to serve.)

title: Asparagus with Balsamic Tomatoes*
instructions: Cook asparagus in boiling water 2 minutes or until crisp tender.  Drain.  Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.  Add tomatoes and garlic; cook 5 minutes.  Stir in vinegar; cook 3 minutes.  Stir in salt.  Arrange asparagus on a platter; top with tomato mixture.  Sprinkle with cheese and pepper.  4 servings.  2 pts per serving.

Additional recipe.  Sesame Ginger Glazed Asparagus.  Omit oil, tomatoes, vinegar, salt, cheese and pepper.  Microwave 1 tablespoon lower-sodium soy sauce, 1 teaspoon honey, 1 teaspoon lime juice, 1 teaspoon minced peeled fresh ginger, and garlic on high for 2 minutes.  Drizzle over asparagus, sprinkle with 2 teaspoons sesame seeds.  4 servings   less than 1 pt. per serving

(You can cook the asparagus early in the day.  When it is how you like it, drain and plunge in ice water.  When it is cool, pat dry and keep in a paper towel until you are ready to assemble the dish.)

title: Asparagus with Raspberry Dijon Dipping Sauce
instructions: Snap off and discard woody bases from asparagus. If desired, remove tips and strings from sugar snap peas. In a large deep skillet bring 1 inch of salted water to boiling. Add asparagus; reduce heat. Simmer uncovered, about 4 minutes or until crisp-tender. Using tongs, transfer asparagus to a large bowl of ice water to cool quickly. Add sugar snap peas to simmering water and cook about 2 minutes or until crisp-tender. Drain and transfer to bowl of ice water.

Meanwhile, for dipping sauce, in a blender container or food processor bowl combine vinegar, honey mustard, pepper, and salt. Cover and blend or process until combined. With the blender or processor running, slowly add the oils in a thin, steady stream. Continue blending or processing until mixture is thick.
If desired, line a serving platter with shredded red cabbage. Arrange asparagus and sugar snap peas on top of the cabbage. Serve with dipping sauce. If desired, garnish with raspberries.

title: AUNT MIMI'S SAUCE FOR PASTA
ingredients: Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pot.  Saute onion until soft.  Add garlic and saute 1 minute.  Add tomatoes and water.  Bring to a boil and add paste.    (If you want to include meat, brown meat and add to sauce at this time.)  Cook 2 - 3 hours or until the right thickness.

title: Aunt Phyllis's Meat Balls
ingredients: Mix well. Brown balls on all sides. Make gravy from drippings using 1 T flour and 1 bouillon cube, 1 C water and add rest of tomato sauce. Add balls to gravy and simmer 20 minutes.

title: Autumn Chicken Carnivale
instructions: Between 2 sheets wax paper, place chicken and pound to 3/8 inch thickness. Cut each in half, making 8 thin pieces of chicken.
Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and place over medium heat. Add onion and sauté until transparent, about 3 minutes.

Whisk in chicken stock and pumpkin purée. Reduce heat to low and whisk in cream, roasted red peppers, salt and paprika. Continue to simmer over low heat about 10 minutes or until thickened and reduced.
In shallow bowl, mix together ginger snap crumbs, flour, thyme and salt. In separate shallow bowl, combine egg and milk.
Lightly spray another large skillet with cooking spray and place over medium heat.
Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture and then ginger snap crumbs, coating well.

Add chicken to skillet and cook about 2 minutes per side until brown and cooked through. Place rice on large serving platter and arrange chicken on top. Spoon pumpkin sauce over chicken and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Avocado and Black Bean Salad
ingredients: Cut avocado and tomatoes into bite-size chunks. Cut peel and white pith from oranges; discard. Cut each orange crosswise into 3/4-inch-thick slices. In large bowl, combine avocado, tomatoes, orange slices, beans, corn, cilantro, and salt; toss to mix.

title: Avocado and Mango Salsa*
ingredients: salt and fresh pepper to taste
Combine all the ingredients and let it marinate in the refrigerator 30 minutes before 1/2 cup ww = 3 pts

title: AVOCADO BACON BOATS
ingredients: Combine bacon, sour cream, tomato, onion, lemon juice and salt.  Carefully scoop out halves.  Dice avocado meat.  Fold into bacon mixture.  Spoon in shells.  Serve immediately.

title: Avocado Mushroom Salad
ingredients: Combine oil, wine, chopped parsley, garlic, salt, pepper and lemon juice. Layer sliced avocados and mushrooms on serving platter. Carefully pour dressing over and marinate 1 hour. Garnish with parsley sprigs.

title: Avocado Salad with Citrus Vinaigrette
instructions: Citrus Vinaigrette:In a small bowl whisk olive oil, juice from lemon or lime, orange, crushed garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Arrange salad greens on a plate, top with cucumber, avocado, red onion, tomato, salt and pepper. Drizzle vinaigrette over the salad and serve right away.

title: AVOCADO SALSA*
ingredients: Combine first six ingredients in medium bowl.  Season with salt.  Can be prepared 2 hours ahead.  Cover and refrigerate.  Add avocado to salsa just before serving. Makes about 4 cups.

title: Avocado, Chicken & Shrimp Salad
ingredients: pressed, and combined with 1/2 tsp. salt

Cut tortillas into thin 1-inch strips.  Fry strips in hot oil until crisp and lightly browned.  Remove strips from oil; drain and set aside.  Mix together sour cream, onion, cilantro, garlic and sugar; add enough oil and vinegar dressing to mixture to thin slightly.  Place lettuce, half the chicken and shrimp and half the tortilla strips in a salad bowl; add sour cream mixture and toss.  Spoon salad onto chilled salad plates; top with the remaining chicken and shrimp, tortilla strips and avocado cubes.  Garnish each salad with tomato slices and black olives.

title: AWESOME BERRY JELLO SALAD
ingredients: Drain juice from berries.  Put aside juice.   Put berries in bottom of 13 x 9 glass pan.  Add enough water to juice to make 2 cups.  Bring this to a boil in the microwave.  Add to bowl with jello mix.  Stir 2 minutes.  Add 2 cups cold water.  Mix.  Measure out 2 cups and pour over berries.  Chill 1 hour.  Mix together softened cream cheese, sour cream and sugar.  Soften in microwave until very soft.  Pour onto 1st layer of berries.  Chill.  Add 2 cups (left over) jello to cool whip.  Mix.  Spread on last layer.

title: B. T. S. Cake
ingredients: Bake cake in a 13 x 9 pan according to directions. When done, leave in pan and poke several holes in the top with the handle of a wooden spoon. Pour in caramel and milk and refrigerate overnight. Before serving, top with Cool Whip and broken pieces of candy bars and serve.

title: Baby Red Potato Salad*
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water until soft, approx 10 minutes. Drain and let cool. While the potatoes are boiling, combine red onion, green pepper, mustard, olive oil, vinegar and mayonnaise and season with salt and pepper. Mix well and let the flavors marinade while the potatoes cook. Once the potatoes are done and cool, mix into the bowl and add scallions and additional salt and pepper to taste. Serve room temperature or refrigerate until ready to serve.
Serving size 3/4 cup = 3 ww pts.

title: Bailey's Irish Cream Mini Cheesecakes
ingredients: Combine crumbs, butter and sugar.  Press rounded tablespoon onto bottom of 24 paper lined muffin cups.  Bake at 325 degrees for 5 minutes.  Combine cream cheese, sugar, amaretto, and vanilla.  Mix at medium until blended.  Blend in eggs, pour over crust, filling 3/4 full.  Bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes.  Cool in pan.  Cover and refrigerate.  May be made the day before.

title: BAKED ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients: packed grated Romano or Parmesan cheese

Whisk 4 tablespoons grated cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, dried marjoram, black pepper, onion salt and garlic powder in medium bowl to blend.  Stir in chopped artichoke hearts.  Transfer to a 1 1/2 cup ramekin.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Bake dip until heated through, about 20 minutes (about 30 minutes if chilled.)  Preheat broiler.  Sprinkle dip with remaining 1 tablespoon grated Romano cheese and paprika.  Broil until cheese melts, about 2 minutes.  Serve warm with toasted baguette slices.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: Wash and soak beans in cold water overnight. Drain and reserve liquid. Place beans and all other ingredients in covered casserole or bean pot, add enough bean liquid to cover and bake in 350 oven 3 to 4 hours. Salt to taste.

title: Baked Brie
instructions: Place the brie on a sheet pan covered with parchment paper and drizzle with the honey. Bake for 5 to 7 minutes, or until it starts to ooze but not melt.
Serve with crackers.

title: Baked Cheese Olives
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

In a small mixing bowl, combine cheese and butter or margarine. Stir flour and cayenne pepper into the cheese and butter mixture. Blend well. Wrap a tablespoon of dough around each green olive. Arrange the wrapped olives on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: BAKED CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients: Let cheese stand at room temperature until softened.  Remove rind from brie.  Mix cheeses and remaining ingredients except paprika and bread on low speed until smooth.  Pour into greased 1-quart casserole;  sprinkle with paprika.  Bake uncovered in 350 degree oven until knife inserted 1 inch from edge comes out clean.  30 to 35 minutes.  Serve with french bread.

title: BAKED CHICKEN
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

Season the chicken with salt.  In a deep-sided oven-proof skillet, heat the olive oil.  Add the chicken, skin side down, and saute for 3 minutes to brown.  Place the pan in the oven, uncovered for 10 minutes.
Remove from the oven and turn the chicken over and place skin side up on a baking sheet.  Return chicken to the oven until cooked through, about 15 to 20 minutes.  REmove the pieces to a platter.
Description: "FOODTV"

title: Baked Chicken
ingredients: skinless chicken breast, four 4 oz halves
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºF. Coat a small, shallow roasting pan with cooking spray.

Season both sides of chicken with salt and pepper. Transfer chicken to prepared pan and drizzle with oil; sprinkle with lemon juice, rosemary and parsley. Pour broth around chicken to coat bottom of pan.
Bake until chicken is cooked through, about 30 to 35 minutes. Garnish with fresh lemon and serve. Yields 1 chicken breast half per serving.  ww = 3 points

title: Baked Chicken Parmesan*
ingredients: reduced fat mozzarella cheese (I used Sargento)
Preheat oven to 450°. Spray a large baking sheet lightly with spray.
instructions: Combine breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese in a bowl. Melt the butter in another bowl. Lightly brush the butter onto the chicken, then dip into breadcrumb mixture.  Place on baking sheet and repeat with the remaining chicken.

Lightly spray a little more cooking oil on top and bake in the oven for 20 minutes. Turn chicken over, bake another 5 minutes. Remove from oven, spoon sauce over chicken and top with shredded cheese. Bake 5 more minutes or until cheese is melted.  ww = 6 pts.

title: Baked Chicken Wings
ingredients: Arrange wings in shallow baking dish. Combine remaining ingredients, heat until butter and sugar dissolve. Cool and pour over wings. Marinate 2 hours, turning occasionally. Without removing from sauce, bake 350-45 minutes, turn once and spoon sauce over a few times. Drain on paper towels. Serve hot or cold.

title: Baked Chicken with Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Drizzle chicken with margarine. Sprinkle salad dressing mix over chicken. Cover and bake at 350 for approximately 45 minutes. Place chicken on platter, spoon over sauce.
SAUCE: Cook sauce ingredients until smooth.  Add 1/2 cup chicken broth from baked chicken until desired consistency.
RICE: Melt butter, add onion and rice and stir until coated. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil, then simmer till done. Serve with chicken.

title: BAKED CUSTARD
ingredients: Beat egg.  Add remaining ingredients.  Pour into custard cups.  Set pan in 1 1/2 inch of hot water.  Bake 35 - 45 minutes in 350 degree oven.  Test center.  Custard should be firm.

title: Baked Doughnuts
ingredients: Round Table Unbleached Pastry flour or 7/8 cup King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
instructions: 1) Whisk together all of the dry ingredients in a medium-sized mixing bowl.
2) In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, oil and water (or buttermilk or yogurt) until foamy.
3) Pour the liquid ingredients all at once into the dry ingredients and stir just until combined.

4) Butter or grease the doughnut pan; non-stick pan spray works well here. Note: even though the pan is non-stick, since the doughnuts are low-fat they may stick unless you grease the pan first. Fill each doughnut form half full.
5) Bake the doughnuts in a preheated 375°F oven for 10 to 12 minutes. When done, they'll spring back when touched lightly, and will be quite brown on the top.
6) Remove the doughnuts from the oven, remove them from the pan, and allow them to cool on rack. Glaze with icing, or coat with cinnamon-sugar or any non-melting sugar.

title: Baked Eggs with Chives and Cream
instructions: heat the oven to 425 degrees.  Butter two 6 inch gratin dishes with 1 teaspoon butter each.  Crack 2 eggs into each gratin dish.  Season with a pinch of salt and pepper and sprinkle with the chives.  Drizzle 1 tablespoon cream in each dish, starting over the yolks and working around the dish.  Bake until the eggs are bubbly and browned on the edges but not quite set in the middle, 5 minutes. (For firmer eggs, bake an additional 1 minute.)
Heat the broiler on high.  Broil the eggs, still on the center rack of the oven, until the center is just set, about 2 minutes.  Remove from the oven immediately--the eggs will continue to set.

title: Baked Fish Mexican-style
ingredients: firm-textured fish steaks such as halibut or swordfish

Rinse fish, pat dry, and lay side-by-side in a 8 by 12 inch baking dish.  Pour salsa over fish.  Evenly sprinkle cheese over salsa, then crushed chips over cheese.  Bake uncovered, in a 400 oven until fish is opaque in thickest part (cut to test), about 15 minutes.  Meanwhile, peel, pit, and slice avocado.  Serve fish and salsa with the avocado.  Add sour cream and squeeze lime juice onto fish to taste.

title: Baked Fish*
instructions: Use 4 oz. fillets.  Lay out a piece of foil, large enough for each fillet.  Spray with cooking spray.  Julienne enough carrots, celery and green onion for one serving and place on the foil.  Place fish over the vegetables.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper and spray with a little cooking spray.  Fold foil into a little packet making sure there are no exposed edges.  Place on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes.  Unwrap package to check that the fish is cooked.  May need a few more minutes.
This is basically 5 ww points per serving.  I like it with the fried rice that I gave you before.

title: BAKED GARDEN TOMATOES WITH CHEESE*
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Oil 11 x 7 inch baking dish.  Heat 2 tablespoons oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat.  Add garlic and saute until fragrant, about 30 seconds.  Add onion and saute until soft, about 6 minutes.  Add tomatoes, reduce heat to medium low and cook until beginnning to soften, about 5 minutes.  Mix in chives, season with salt and pepper.  Transfer tomato mixture to prepared baking dish, sprinkle grated cheeses over.  Bake until cheese melts and begins to turn golden, about 20 minutes.
Description: "BON APPETIT"

title: Baked Garlic Lemon Tilapia
ingredients: Melt butter on a low flame in a small sauce pan. Add garlic and saute on low for about 1 minute. Add the lemon juice and shut off flame. Spray the bottom of a baking dish lightly with cooking spray. Place the fish on top and season with salt and pepper. Pour the lemon butter mixture on the fish and top with fresh parsley. Bake at 400° until cooked, about 15 minutes.  6 oz. = 4 pts.  1 tsp butter = 1 pt.

title: Baked Garlic Lemon Tilapia*
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Melt butter on a low flame in a small sauce pan. Add garlic and saute on low for about 1 minute. Add the lemon juice and shut off flame. Spray the bottom of a baking dish lightly with cooking spray. Place the fish on top and season with salt and pepper. Pour the lemon butter mixture on the fish and top with fresh parsley. Bake at 400° until cooked, about 15 minutes.
6 oz tilapia = 4 pts 1 tsp butter = 1 pt

title: Baked Green Rice
ingredients: Heat oven to 375.  Heat oil in 10-inch skillet over medium heat until hot.  Add rice; cook, stirring constantly until rice turns opaque white, about 2 minutes.  Quickly add white onion; saute 1 minute.  Add chilies, green onions, garlic, salt and cumin; saute 20 seconds.  Add broth; mix well.  Heat over high heat to boiling; reduce to low.  Simmer, covered, until rice is almost tender, about 15 minutes.  Remove skillet from heat.  Add 1 cup cheese and the chopped cilantro; toss lightly to mix.  Transfer to greased 1 1/2 quart baking dish; top with remaining cheese.  Bake, uncovered, until rice is tender and cheese topping is melted, about 15 minutes.  Garnish with cilantro.

title: BAKED HALIBUT WITH SALSA VERDE
ingredients: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Set halibut on large sheet of aluminum foil, drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.  Bring together sides and ends of foil and seal into a tent, leaving an air space on top.  Transfer tent to a large baking dish.  Bake until the interior of the fish is opaque, 15 to 20 minutes.  Combine oil, parsley, shallots, capers, garlic, lemon juice and anchovy paste in a small bowl.  Season with salt and pepper.  Divide baked halibut into 4 medallions.  Spoon salsa on top of each portion.

title: Baked Kyoto Chicken with Asian Pan Gravy and Noodles
ingredients: coarsely chopped; 2 tablespoons reserved for garnish
instructions: In flat shallow bowl, mix together egg, milk and 1 teaspoon of the sesame oil. In another shallow dish, place panko, ginger, salt and pepper.
Dip chicken, first in egg mixture, then seasoned panko, coating well.
On foil lined lightly oiled baking pan, arrange chicken. Place in 375°F. and cook about 35 minutes or until fork tender.
About 15 minutes before chicken is done, in 10-inch skillet over medium high heat, place vegetable oil, garlic, bell pepper and onion.
Cook about 3 minutes and stir in chicken broth, remaining 1 teaspoon sesame oil, soy sauce, mushrooms and pineapple. Reduce heat to low and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir together cornstarch and water and add to mixture.

Place chicken on cutting board and slice diagonally into 3/4 inch strips. Divide noodles onto 4 plates and spoon pineapple-mushroom mixture over noodles. Arrange chicken on top and garnish with reserved chopped red bell pepper.

title: BAKED ONION BRIE SPREAD
ingredients: brie (8 oz.) rind removed and cubed
instructions: In a large skillet, cook onion and garlic in butter over medium heat for 8-10 minutes or until onion is golden brown, stirring frequently. Remove from the heat; set aside.
Place Brie and cream cheese in a microwave safe dish.  Microwave uncovered, until softened.  Whisk in the sour cream, brown sugar, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper and onion mixture.

Cut off top of bread; set aside.  Hollow out loaf, leaving a 3/4 inch shell.  Cut removed bread into cubes.  Fill shell with cheese mixture.  Replace top.  Wrap in a large piece of heavy duty foil, about 18th in. square.  Place on a baking sheet.
Bake at 400 degrees for 1 hour or until spread is bubbly.  Remove top of bread.  Sprinkle paprika over spread.  Serve with bread cubes and vegetables.

title: Baked Potatoes Slices 
ingredients: Cut unpared potatoes into 1/4" thick slices.  Place overlapping slices in buttered oven-to-table baking dish. Mix butter and oil.  Brush slices with mixture.  Pour remaining over potatoes.  Sprinkle with garlic, salt and thyme.  Bake at 400 for 25-30 minutes or until potatoes are done and browned at the edges.

title: BAKED SALMON WITH MUSTARD CRUMB CRUST
ingredients: Place vinegar, sugar and both mustards in blender.  With machine running, slowly pour in oil and blend until medium-thick sauce forms.  (Can be made 1 day ahead.  Chill.)  Preheat oven to 375.  Lightly grease 13 x 9 inch baking dish, and place salmon in dish skin side down.  Season with dried thyme, salt and pepper.  Spread 1 tablespoon mustard sauce over each fillet, covering completely.  Press breadcrumbs onto fish.  Bake salmon until cooked through and crum topping is crisp and golden brown, about 18 minutes.  Using large spatula as aid, transfer salmon fillets to platter.  Serve, passing remaining mustard sauce separately.

title: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
instructions: Slice each potato into 1/2 inch thick strips. Toss with oil, salt, pepper and paprika. Place on a non-stick baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Turn potatoes and bake until bottom is browned, about 10-15 minutes more. Serve immediately.  ww points 1/2 potato = 2

title: BAKED VEGETABLES WITH HALLOUMI CHEESE
ingredients: Rinse and trim the aubergine and squash, and cut into medium thick slices. Slice the halloumi cheese into thin slices. Place the vegetables and cheese in layers. Start with a slice of aubergine, then cheese, squash, cheese, tomato and end with cheese.Brush with a little olive oil, wrap in foil and place on the grill over medium heat for 10 minutes or until tender. Vegetables can also be placed in a casserole dish and baked in the oven at 350° F (175° C) for 30 minutes or until done.

title: BAKED ZITI CASSEROLE
instructions: In a large pot, saute onion and garlic until golden brown.   Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, 1 1/2 cups water, 2 tablespoons parsley, 1 tablespoon salt, sugar, basil, oregano and pepper.  Mix well and simmer, covered for one hour, stirring occasionally.

Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cook box of pasta following directions. To make cheese layer,  In a large bowl, combine ricotta, 1/3 cup parmesan,  eggs, parsley, salt and pepper.  Beat with wooden spoon until blended.

Spoon some sauce into casserole dish.  Place a third of the pasta as the bottom layer, then the cheese mixture, top with sliced mozarella cheese,  then the remaining sauce.  Sprinkle sauce with Parmesan.  Repeat again twice.
Bake uncovered 45-50 minutes, or until center bubbles.
Description: "RECIPE COTTAGE"

title: BALSAMIC VINAIGRETTE FOR TOMATO CAPRESE SALAD
instructions: Mix together asll ingredients with a whisk until smooth.  Drizzle over caprese salad.
Description: "G. GARVIN"

title: BANANA BREAD
ingredients: vinegar plus milk to make 1/2 cup

Sift flour, soda, salt.  Cream butter, Blend in sugar.  Add eggs one at a time and beat until fluffy.  Add flour mixture alternately with bananas and liquid beating after each addition.  Turn into greased loaf pan 350 degrees 60-70 minutes.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.  Cool completely before cutting.

title: Banana Bread
ingredients: Preheat oven to 350. Grease two 8 x 4-inch loaf pans.  In large bowl, with electric mixer at medium speed, cream butter, sugar, eggs and orange peel until light and fluffy. Beat in mashed bananas.  On waxed paper, combine flour, baking soda and 1/2 tsp. salt. At low speed gradually add flour mixture, then butter; beat just until smooth. Stir in nuts and chocolate. Evenly spoon into prepared pans. Bake 1 hour, or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.

title: Banana Bread
ingredients: Cream sugar and butter. Mash bananas and add with other ingredients. Bake at 350 for 1 hour.

title: Banana Bread
ingredients: soft, darkly speckled, mashed well (about 1 1/2 cups)
instructions: Adjust oven rack to lower middle position and heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease bottom only of regular loaf pan, or grease and flour bottom and sides of nonstick 9-by-5-by-3-inch loaf pan; set aside. Combine first five ingredients together in large bowl; set aside.

Mix mashed bananas, yogurt, eggs, butter, and vanilla with wooden spoon in medium bowl. Lightly fold banana mixture into dry ingredients with rubber spatula until just combined and batter looks thick and chunky. Scrape batter into prepared loaf pan; bake until loaf is golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, about 55 minutes. Cool in pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Banana Bread - Recipe
ingredients: Preheat oven to 350º F. Grease a 9"x5" loaf pan. In a large bowl combine sugar, shortening (or oil), and eggs. Beat in bananas. Add remaining dry ingredients and combine. Fold in nuts. Batter will be thick. Pour into prepared pan and bake for 60 minutes or until done. Insert a toothpick in center to check for doneness. If toothpick is clean when removed, the bread is done. Remove from pan and cool.

title: BANANA FRENCH TOAST
instructions: In a larage shallow bowl, whisk together milk, sugar, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt

Dip bread, one slice at a time, into egg mixture, pressing down so bread absorbs liquid.  In a large nonstick skillet, melt butter over medium heat.  Place all 4 slices in skillet; cook 2 minutes per side or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, cut banana crosswise into 1/4 inch thick rounds.  Divide bread between two plates; top with banana and syrup.
Description: "HEALTHY START"

title: Banana Muffins
ingredients: ripe large bananas (approximately 1 pound or 454 grams)
instructions: Banana Muffins: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C) and place the oven rack in the middle of the oven. Line a 12 - 1/2 cup muffin pan with paper liners or butter or spray with a non stick spray.
Place the nuts on a baking sheet and bake for about 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly toasted. Let cool and then chop coarsely.
In a large bowl combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, and nuts.

In a medium-sized bowl combine the mashed bananas, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla. With a rubber spatula or wooden spoon, lightly fold the wet ingredients (banana mixture) into the dry ingredients just until combined and the batter is thick and chunky. (The important thing is not to over mix the batter. You do not want it smooth. Over mixing the batter will yield tough, rubbery bread.) Spoon the batter into the prepared muffin tins. Bake about 20 - 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Place on a wire rack to cool for five minutes and then remove muffins from pan. Serve warm or at room temperature.
Makes 12 regular sized muffins.

title: Banana Nut Bread
ingredients: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in eggs and mashed bananas. Add sifted dry ingredients alternately with liquids. Add nuts. Bake at 350 about 1 hour.

title: Banana Oatmeal Pancakes
instructions: In a bowl, combine oats, flour, salt, baking powder, and baking soda.  In another bowl, mash the banana with an electric mixer or a fork. With mixer or fork, beat egg with the banana until blended.  Add buttermilk and 1 T oil; mix until smooth. Add the dry ingredients and stir until blended.
Heat griddle. Brush lightly with oil. Spoon 3 T batter per pancake onto griddle, cook until top of pancake is set and bottom is medium brown about 2 minutes. Turn pancakes cook until medium brown.

title: Banana, Coconut, Macadamia Nut Bread
ingredients: soft, darkly speckled, mashed well (about 1 1/2 cups)
instructions: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 350 degrees. Toast coconut and macadamia nuts on small cookie sheet, stirring every 2 minutes, until golden brown, about 6 minutes. Readjust oven rack to lower middle position. Grease bottom only of regular loaf pan, or grease and flour bottom and sides of nonstick 9-by-5-by-3-inch loaf pan; set aside. Combine first four ingredients, coconut, and nuts together in large bowl; set aside.

Mix mashed bananas, yogurt, eggs, butter, and vanilla with wooden spoon in medium bowl. Lightly fold banana mixture into dry ingredients with rubber spatula until just combined and batter looks thick and chunky. Scrape batter into prepared loaf pan; bake until loaf is golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, about 55 minutes. Cool in pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: BANANA, RAISIN, AND OATMEAL PANCAKES*
instructions: Whisk first 6 ingredients in medium bowl.  Whisk yogurt, milk, eggs, and vanilla in another medium bowl to blend.  Whisk dry ingredients into yogurt mixture just until blended.  Fold in mashed bananas, raisins, and 1/4 cup melted butter.

Brush nonstick griddle or skillet with melted butter.  Heat over medium heat.  Working in batches, pour batter by 1/3 cupfuls onto griddle.  Cook pancakes until bubbles form on top and bottoms are golden brown, about 2 minutes.  Turn pancakes over and cook until bottoms are golden brown, about 2 minutes.
Description: "BON APPETIT"

title: BANANA-OATMEAL BARS WITH CHOCOLATE CHUNKS
ingredients: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Butter and flour 15x10x1inch baking sheet.  Blend first 4 ingredients in medium bowl.  Beat butter in large bowl until fluffy.  Add both sugars and beat until well blended.  Add eggs 1 at a time, beating well after each addition.  Beat in bananas, then vanilla.  Stir in flour mixture, then chocolate and pecans.  Spread batter in prepared pan.  Bake until tester inserted into center comes out clean and top is golden, about 45 minutes.  Cool in pan on rack.  Cut into 3x2 inch bars and serve.

title: Banana-pineapple Layer Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: chopped bananas (from about 3 ban1 cup chopped pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Butter and flour two 9-inch round cake pans with 2-inch-high sides. Whisk first 5 ingredients in large bowl to blend. Whisk in oil, eggs, and vanilla. Stir in bananas, pecans, and pineapple. Divide batter equally between prepared pans. Bake cakes until tester inserted into center comes out clean, about 30 minutes. Cool cakes in pans on racks 10 minutes. Run knife around cake sides and turn out onto rack to cool completely.

For frosting: Using electric mixer, beat cream cheese and butter in large bowl to blend. Beat in sugar and vanilla. Place 1 cake layer on plate. Spread 1 1/2 cups frosting over. Top with second cake layer. Spread remaining frosting over top and sides of cake. Sprinkle toasted pecans in border around top edge of cake. (Can be made 1 day ahead. Cover; chill. Let stand at room temperature before serving.)

title: Bangkok Beef & Basil
ingredients: beef round sirloin tip center steaks
cut 1 inch thick or beef shoulder top blade  steaks (flat iron)
thinly sliced red bell pepper strips
thinly sliced green onion strips (3 x 1/8-inch strips)
instructions: Cut beef steak crosswise into 1/4-inch thick strips. Place in shallow glass dish. Add 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce; toss to coat. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 15 minutes.
Combine remaining 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce, lime juice and curry powder in small bowl. Set aside.
Prepare rice noodles according to package directions for stir-fry; drain and rinse with cold water. Set aside.

Meanwhile spray nonstick wok or large skillet with nonstick cooking spray. Heat over medium-high heat until hot. Add 1/2 of beef; stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes or until outside surface of beef is no longer pink. Remove from wok. Repeat with remaining beef. If necessary, re-spray skillet with cooking spray. Add bell pepper to wok; stir-fry 30 to 60 seconds or until crisp-tender. Remove from wok.

Add teriyaki sauce mixture to wok; bring to a boil. Add rice noodles, basil, 1/2 of green onions, bell pepper and beef; cook and carefully stir until heated through. Season with black pepper, as desired. Garnish with remaining green onions.

title: Bangkok Chicken Sate with Peppered Peanut Sauce
instructions: Cut chicken crosswise into 1/4-inch strips and place in sealable plastic bag.
In small bowl, mix together coconut milk, orange juice, soy sauce, gingerroot, sesame oil and garlic. Pour over chicken, seal bag and turn to coat well. Marinate in refrigerator 15 minutes.

Soak bamboo skewers in water. Remove chicken from marinade and thread onto skewers. Set oven to broil with rack about 5 inches from heat. Place chicken in oven and broil about 7 minutes, turning once.

Stir together rice, jalapeno, peanuts, sweet red pepper, green onions and coriander leaves; spread onto platter. Arrange chicken skewers on rice and garnish with orange slices and coriander sprigs. Serve with Peppered Peanut Sauce.

Peppered Peanut Sauce: In small bowl, mix together 1/2 cup chunky honey roasted peanut butter; 1/3 cup hot water; 2 tablespoons honey; 1/2 teaspoon crushed mixed peppercorns; and 1/4 teaspoon freshly grated orange peel.

title: BARBARA'S BAKED OMELET*
instructions: Heat oven to 325 degrees.  In oven, melt 1/4 cup butter in each of two 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dishes.  Tilt dish to coat bottom with butter.
In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs, sour cream, milk and salt until blended.  Stir in remaining four ingredients.
Pour into baking dishe.  Bake until eggs are set but still moist, about 35 minutes.  Cut into squares to serve.
Description: "CHRISTMAS RECIPES"

title: Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: Melt butter in large pan.  Add onion and garlic and saute until lightly browned.  Add zest, lemon juice, catsup, tomato juice, brown sugar, molasses, worcestershire sauce, chili powder, vinegar, chipotle puree and water.  Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes.  Add a pinch of salt.

title: Barbecued Ribs
instructions: Place ribs in 3 quart dish, cover with wax paper and micro on high for 5 minutes. Then on medium 10 minutes per pound.

SAUCE: In 4 cup glass dish, combine butter, garlic, onion. Micro high 3 minutes. Stir in remaining ingredients. Micro 2 1/2 minutes - stir-micro 3 minutes.  Pour over ribs. Let sit at least 1 hour.  BBQ about 10-12 minutes per side.

title: Barbecued Spare Ribs
ingredients: Brown ribs. Mix all ingredients and cook 5 minutes. Pour over ribs and bake 350 for 2 hours.

title: Barbeque Chicken, Pork Chops, Etc.
ingredients: Place meat in Bean Pot. Pour your favorite barbeque sauce over all. Bake at 350̊F until done or 250 degrees all day.

title: Bart's Cheesecake
instructions: Combine nuts, flour and butter in a 9 inch pie pan. Press to form crust.
Bake 20 minutes at 350°.
Combine eggs, sugar, lemon juice and vanilla. Add cream cheese and beat until smooth. Pour into crust.
Bake 20 minutes at 375°.
Let cool.
Combine sour cream, sugar, lemon juice and vanilla. Pour on top.
Bake 5 minutes at 400°.
Chill for 2-3 hours.

title: Basic Brown Sauce or Demi-glace
ingredients: a cut-in-half rib of celery, a few sprigs of parsley, a few sprigs of thyme - or a teaspoon of dried thyme leaves - and one or two bay leaves - all tied up with kitchen string in a piece of cheesecloth, the cheesecloth “bag” put in the pot
like “Bovril” - find in soup or spice sections of market

Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan. Add the chopped onion and carrot, cook over medium heat, stirring often for about 5 minutes, until vegetables are softened. Blend in the flour, and cook this mixture, stirring often, until browned (this browning develops essential flavors). Remove the pan from the heat, and beat in the stock or broth. Add all remaining ingredients, stirring well to blend. Return the saucepan to high heat, bring the mixture to a boil, then immediately reduce the heat, cover (or partially cover) the pan, and cook the sauce very slowly (at just a simmer), stirring occasionally, for 45 minutes-1 hour. Remove the bouquet garni, and strain the finished sauce into a clean saucepan. The sauce may then be reduced further if desired, or wine added. May be made in advance and refrigerated or frozen.

title: BASIC CHEESE SAUCE
instructions: (To make cream sauce, add 1 cup creme fraiche to white sauce.) In a saucepan over low heat, warm cream sauce.  Add the grated cheeses and the mustard.  Stir over low heat until the cheeses melt and the sauce is smooth.  Taste and add the salt and pepper as needed. (Basic cheese sauce may be stored in the refrigerator for 5 days or in the freezer for 1 month.)
I

title: BASIC CUSTARD SAUCE
ingredients: Scald milk.  Remove from heat.  Stir in sugar.  Gradually add yolks while stirring.  Heat over double boiler.  Stir in vanilla.

title: Basic Deviled Eggs
instructions: COOK EGGS Combine 4 cups water and 4 cups ice cubes in large bowl; set aside. Place eggs in saucepan, cover with 1 inch water, and bring to boil over high heat. Remove pan from heat, cover, and let stand 10 minutes. Pour off water from saucepan and gently shake pan back and forth to crack egg shells. Transfer eggs to ice water and cool 5 minutes.
MAKE FILLING Peel eggs and halve lengthwise. Transfer yolks to fine-mesh sieve set over medium bowl. Using spatula, press yolks through sieve into bowl. Stir in remaining ingredients until smooth.

FILL Arrange whites on serving platter. Divide yolk mixture among whites. Serve. (Egg white halves and filling mixture can be refrigerated separately for 2 days. Wrap egg whites in double layer of plastic wrap. Transfer filling mixture to zipper-lock bag, squeeze out air, and seal.)

title: Basic Grilled or Broiled Butterflied Leg of Lamb
ingredients: fresh rosemary leaves or 2 teaspoons dried rosemary
fresh thyme leaves or 1 teaspoon dried thyme
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
Minced fresh parsley leaves for garnish

Start a charcoal or wood fire or preheat a gas grill or broiler; the fire should be moderately hot, and the rack should be at least 4 inches from the heat source. (Delay this step until you’re just about ready to cook if you choose to marinate the meat.) Trim the lamb of any excess fat. Mix together the olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper; rub this mixture well into the lamb, making sure to get some into all the crevices. If you have the time, let the lamb sit, for an hour or more (refrigerate if it will be much longer). 2. Grill or broil the meat until it is nicely browned, even a little charred, on both sides, about 20 to 30 minutes, and the internal temperature at the thickest part is about 125°F; this will give you some lamb that is quite rare, as well as some that is nearly well done. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly, as you would a thick steak. Garnish, and serve with lemon wedges.

title: BASIC MUFFINS*
instructions: Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Coat a 12-cup muffin tin with vegetable cooking spray.
Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl; set aside.

Beat butter and sugar with an electric mixer at medium-high speed until light and luffy, about 2 minutes.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Beat in half of dry ingredients.  Beat in one-third of yogurt.  Beat in half of remaining dry ingredients, alternating with one-third of remaining yogurt, and repeat until fully incorporated.

Use a large ice cream scoop to divide batter evenly among muffin cups.  Bake until muffins are golden brown, 20 to 25 minutes.  Set on a wire rack to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.  Remove muffins from tin and serve warm.
Additions:  1 chopped banana and 3/4 cup chocolate chips, 1 cup flaked coconut and 1 cup chopped, drained pineapple,
Description: "PAM ANDERSON"

title: Basic Stock
ingredients: Combine all ingredients in large saucepan. Cover with cold water. Bring mixture to boil over high heat, skimming occasionally.  Reduce heat and simmer gently, uncovered, 8 hours, replenishing water as necessary to maintain 1 quart liquid. Strain stock. Cool to room temperature. Refrigerate. Discard any fat before using Makes about 1 quart.

title: BASIC WHITE SAUCE
ingredients: Melt butter in a heavy saucepan.  Stir in the flour and cook over low heat for about 3 minutes.  (It will smell nutlike, not like flour)  Add milk, whisking constantly, and continue whisking until the sauce comes to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally.  When the sauce is of the desired consistency, strain it and add the seasonings to taste.

title: BASIL AIOLI
ingredients: Combine mayonnaise, 1 tablespoon oil and basil in medium bowl.  Heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy small skillet over medium low heat.  Add garlic and saute until beginning to color, about 2 minutes.  Add dried red pepper and saute 30 seconds.  Add to mayonnaise.  Season with pepper.  (Can be made 1 day ahead.  Cover.  Chill)  Serve with vegetables.

title: BBQ PORK FOR SANDWICHES*
instructions: Pour can of beef broth into slow cooker, and add boneless pork ribs.  Cook on High heat for 4 hours, or until meat shreds easily.  Remove meat, and shred with two forks.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Transfer the shredded pork to a dutch oven or iron skillet, and stir in barbecue sauce.
Bake in preheated oven for 30 mintues, or until heated through.
Description: "ALL RECIPES"

title: Bean Dip
ingredients: Heat ingredients in crock pot. Serve when hot with tortilla chips.

title: Bean Salad
ingredients: Boil ingredients for dressing 2-3 minutes. Add the beans, pepper, and  onion. Chill. Cook bacon and crumble on top.

title: Beef and Beer Stew
ingredients: Melt butter in large sauce pot or Dutch oven. Add onions and cook 5 minutes to brown slightly. Add carrots herbs, and garlic and continue to cook over medium heat 10 minutes. Stir in flour, tomato paste, consomme, and beer. Add cooked meat and cover. Simmer 1/2 hour or longer, until carrots are tender and mixture is thick and aromatic. Serve over cooked egg noodles or steamed rice.

title: Beef and Cannellini Bean Minestrone
ingredients: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

In a large saucepan or Dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion, carrot and celery. Season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, for 5 minutes until the vegetables are soft. Increase the heat to high and add the ground beef and garlic. Season with salt and pepper, to taste. Cook for 6 to 7 minutes until the beef is browned and cooked through. Stir in the tomato paste until combined. Add the broth, tomatoes, beans, and bay leaf. Bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the liquid has reduced by half, about 30 minutes. Remove the bay leaf and discard. Season with salt and pepper, to taste. Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with Parmesan cheese.

title: Beef Bourguignon
instructions: In a large fry pan, cook bacon until crisp.  Add meat and brown quickly.  Transfer meat to 3  quart saucepan or covered casserole; sprinkle with flour and set aside.  Add butter to remainder of bacon drippings in fry pan; add onions and saute.  Combine onions with meat; add salt, pepper, wine, carrots, garlic, bouquet garni.  Add bouillon.  Simmer covered on low heat or bake 250 for about 3 hours or until meat is tender and sauce dark brown.  About 30 minutes before serving,  add mushrooms.  Remove bouquet garni and serve over buttered noodles. Serves 4-6.
Bouquet garni:  Use four springs parsley, 3 celery tops, two bay leaves, tie in cheese cloth.

title: Beef Chili Recipe
ingredients: 1 14 oz can diced tomatoes (do not drain)
seeded and chopped in adobo sauce
instructions: In a large pot, heat the brown the ground beef, making sure to continuously break up large pieces with a spoon or spatula.  Once browned drain fat off of ground beef.  Return the ground beef to the pot.
Add onions and green bell pepper to the ground beef and cook over medium heat with stirring until the onions are soft and translucent.
Add the garlic, ancho chile powder, pasilla chile powder, cumin, sugar, thyme, cayenne powder, oregano, and black pepper.  Heat over medium heat with stirring for 12 minutes.

Pour in the beef broth, pinto beans, diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, cider vinegar and chipotle peppers.  Stir to mix well.  Reduce heat to low and simmer for at least 2 hours before serving or refrigerating.

title: Beef On Skewer
ingredients: Cut meat into 3/4 inch cubes.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Add meat cubes.  Marinate from 15 minutes to 1/2 hour.  String a few pieces on a wooden or bamboo skewer and broil or grill for about 10 minutes.

title: Beef or Turkey Stock
ingredients: discard the liver as it will make the stock cloudy) and neck, from your Thanksgiving turkey
instructions: Heat the oven to 450 degrees. Place turkey giblets, necks, backs, carrot, celery, onions, and garlic into a large flameproof roasting pan. Spray lightly with nonstick cooking spray and toss to combine. Roast, stirring every 10 minutes, until well-browned, about 1 hour.
Remove roasting pan from oven, and place over 1 or 2 burners set at high heat. Add chicken stock and bring to a boil, scraping up browned bits on the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon.

Transfer contents of the roasting pan to a large stockpot or saucepan. Add wine, 3 cups of water, and thyme sprigs; bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to low and simmer until reduced by half, about 1 1/2 hours. Strain stock into a large measuring cup or container. Cool to room temperature, then cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until fat congeals, about 1 hour.
Skim fat from the stock and reserve. Pour the stock through a fine-mesh strainer to remove remaining bits of fat; discard bits in strainer.

title: Beef Soup
ingredients: Place soup meat and bones, water, parsley, celery, salt, onion, pepper and ginger in large kettle. Cover and bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer two hours. Remove bones. Cut meat from bones and return to soup. Add carrots and barley and simmer two hours or until barley is soft. Good.

title: Beef Steak with Curried Onion & Plum Sauce
ingredients: beef shoulder top blade (flat iron) steaks (6 to 8 ounces each) or 4 boneless beef chuck eye steaks
instructions: Heat oil in large heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot. Place steaks in skillet; cook shoulder top blade steaks 13 to 15 minutes (chuck eye steaks 9 to 11 minutes) for medium rare to medium doneness, turning occasionally. Season with salt and pepper, as desired. Remove to platter; keep warm.

Add green onions to skillet; cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes or until golden. Stir in preserves, chutney and curry powder. Add water; cook and stir until sauce is hot. Stir in lime juice; remove from heat.
Spoon sauce over steaks. Sprinkle with peanuts.
Per serving:	Nutrition information per serving, using top blade:
479 calories; 36 g protein; 29 g carbohydrate; 24 g fat; 251 mg sodium; 77 mg cholesterol; 6.2 mg niacin; 0.5 mg vitamin B6; 4.6 mcg vitamin B12; 4.3 mg iron; 11.7 mg zinc.
Nutrition information per serving, using chuck eye:
398 calories; 31 g protein; 29 g carbohydrate; 17 g fat; 244 mg sodium; 70 mg cholesterol; 5.4 mg niacin; 0.4 mg vitamin B6; 3.8 mcg vitamin B12; 4.0 mg iron; 9.1 mg zinc._____

title: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients: Cut beef in thin strips.  Garlic salt and pepper.  Cover and refrigerate 3 hours.  Brown meat in 3 tablespoons of butter.  Remove from pan and saute mushrooms and onions in a little extra butter until soft.  Set aside.  Make a roux by melting butter over a low heat.  Stir in flour and keep stirring for about 3 minutes or until it smells nutty and there is no flour smell.  Stir in beef stock a 1/2 cup at a time and stir until all of the broth has been used.  Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened.  Boil 2 minutes.  Add mustard and sour cream.  Turn heat down and simmer gently.   Add meat, onions and mushrooms to sauce.  Simmer gently 20 minutes.

title: Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: or 98% Fat Free Cream of Mushroom Soup

Slice beef into very thin strips. In a large skillet on medium/high, heat oil. Add onion and cook until tender. Add beef and cook until browned, stirring often. Add soup and paprika and bring to a boil, while continuing to stir. Reduce heat to low, stir in sour cream and heat through.

title: Beef Stroganoff with Buttered Noodles
ingredients: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Place the chopped garlic, salt and pepper into a bowl. Add enough extra-virgin olive oil to create a paste. Add the rosemary and thyme leaves to the bowl and stir to combine.
Set short ribs out on a roasting tray and cover with herb paste. Roast in the oven for 2 hours and 30 minutes until they are falling apart.

Heat a large saute pan over high heat and add a 3-count of olive oil. Add mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes until brown. Add shallots and minced garlic and toss to combine. Season with salt and pepper. Cook for a further 2 minutes until garlic and onion become fragrant. Remove pan from heat and carefully add cognac to deglaze the pan. Return to heat and add cream.
