title: BUTTERMILK SCONES*
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Combine the flour, sugar, salt, baking powder and baking soda in a large bowl.  Add butter and mix with your fingertips to a coarse meal.  Add buttermilk and mix just until combined.  Add currants, if desired.

Transfer dough to a floured board and divide into 2 parts.  Roll each to 3/4 inch thick rounds.  Cut each round into 8 wedges and place slightly separated on a greased baking sheet.  Brush the topes with the cream, and bake for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.  Serve warm, split in half with butter and jam.
Description: "TWO HOT TAMALES"

title: BUTTERMILK WAFFLE/PANCAKES
ingredients: Preheat pan over medium heat and season with butter.  In a medium bow, sift ogether flour, baking soda, sugar, baking powder and salt; set aside.  Beat egg until light and fluffy.  Add egg, buttermilk and butter to dry mixture: mix until blended.  Spoon about 2 tablespoons batter into each cavity and cook until pancakes bubble.  Turn each pancake over and continue cooking until pancakes are a light golden brown.

title: Butternut Squash Risotto with Chives
ingredients: peeled, and finely diced into bite-size pieces*
dry white wine (such as Sauvignon Blanc)
instructions: In a medium-sized saucepan over medium-high, heat chicken broth and keep warm over low heat.
In a large heavy saucepan over medium heat, melt 4 tablespoons of butter; add onion and diced butternut squash pieces. Cook until onions are translucent, approximately 5 minutes.
Add arborio rice and cook 1 to 2 minutes making sure all the grains are well coated (toasting the rice in melted butter keeps it from getting mushy).

Add wine and cook, stirring constantly until wine has been completely absorbed by the rice or evaporated. Add a few ladles of hot chicken broth, just enough to barely cover rice. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until broth has been absorbed. Continue cooking, adding a little bit of hot chicken broth (1/2 cup at a time), stirring frequently, until the chicken broth is absorbed and until the rice is tender (but still firm to the bite), about 15 to 20 minutes.
NOTE: Risotto doesn't need constant attention during its cooking time. You'll just need to check on the pan every few minutes, give the rice a stir to keep it from sticking, and add more stock.

During the last minutes of cooking, add remaining 2 tablespoons of butter, 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese, and chives. At this point the rice should have a creamy consistency (it should be tender, but firm to the bite). Add salt to taste. Remove from heat.

NOTE: To test the risotto for proper consistency, spoon a little into a bowl shaking it lightly from side to side. The risotto should spread out very gently of its own accord. If the rice just stands still, it's too dry, so add a little more stock. If liquid forms around the rice, you've added too much stock. Spoon some liquid off, or just let the risotto sit for a few more seconds off the heat to absorb the excess stock.  Serve with remaining grated Parmesan cheese.
Makes 4 to 6 servings.

title: BUTTERNUT SQUASH SOUP
instructions: Peel squash and cut in half.  Scoop out seeds and cut squash into large chunks.  Arrange in a roasting pan that has been sprayed with nonstick vegetable oil spray.  Bake squash in the oven at 425 degrees for 40-45 minutes, turning once.

Set aside to cool.  While the squash is baking, cook the onion and ginger in the butter in a saucepan, over moderately low heat, for 5 minutes or until the onion is softened.  Add the broth and simmer  the mixture for 10 minutes, covered.  puree the squash and add it to the broth.  Transfer the mixture to a blender or food processor, in batches, and puree until smooth.  Add enough water to achieve the desired consistency, and salt and pepper to taste.  Return the soup to the saucepan and cook over moderate heat until hot.  Garnish each portion with a heaping teaspoon of low-fat sour cream.
Description: "GOURMET"

title: Butterscotch Nut Bread
ingredients: Beat eggs, Add sugar gradually, continuing to beat.  Add butter and blend.  Sift together dry ingredients.  Add butter, buttermilk and walnuts.  Bake at 350 for 1 hour in loaf pan.

title: Caesar Salad
instructions: Wash romaine, trim core, and separate.  Shake leaves to remove moisture.  Place in a large plastic bag; chill at least 2 hours.  Combine olive oil, vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, salt, mustard and garlic in a jar.  Cover tightly and shake vigorously.  Set aside. Pour water to a depth of 2 inches in a medium saucepan; bring to a rapid boil, turn off heat.  Carefully lower egg into water using a slotted spoon; let stand 1 minute.  Remove egg from water, and set aside to cool.

Tear romaine leaves into bite-size pieces, and place in a large salad bowl.  Pour dressing over romaine; toss gently until well coated.  Break coddled egg over romaine; then squeeze juice from lemon halves over salad.  Grind a generous amount of pepper over salad, and sprinkle with cheese.  Toss lightly. Top with croutons; garnish with anchovies.  Serve immediately.

title: Caesar Salad Beef Burgers On Garlic Crostini
ingredients: freshly shaved or grated Parmesan cheese
instructions: Combine ground beef, minced garlic, 1 teaspoon salt and ½ teaspoon pepper in large bowl, mixing lightly but thoroughly.
Lightly shape into four ¾-inch thick patties, shaping to fit the bread slices.

Place patties on grid over medium, ash-covered coals. Grill, uncovered, 13 to 15 minutes to medium (160°F) doneness, until not pink in center and juices show no pink color, turning occasionally. Season with salt and pepper, as desired.

Meanwhile brush both sides of bread slices lightly with oil. Place bread around outer edge of grid. Grill a few minutes until lightly toasted, turning once. Remove bread slices from grid. Rub both sides of each slice with a garlic quarter.

Place one lettuce leaf on four of the bread slices; top each with a burger. Sprinkle evenly with cheese; cover with remaining bread slices. Cut burgers in half, if desired; arrange on lettuce-lined platter, if desired.

title: Caesar Salad Dressing
instructions: Bring a small pot of water to a boil; turn off heat and carefully add eggs to pot. Let eggs stand in hot water for 3 minutes; cool under cold, running water.
Meanwhile, place anchovies, lemon juice, broth, mustard, garlic, salt and pepper in bowl of a food processor; process until a thick dressing forms. Add eggs; process until incorporated.
Pour oil into dressing in a steady stream, whisking to combine. Add cheese; blend thoroughly. Yields about 1 tablespoon per serving.  WW 1 Tablespoon = 1 point

title: CAESER SALAD
ingredients: Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper
inner leaves only, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces (about 12 cups)
instructions: Step 1 Heat oven to 450 degrees. Combine the butter and olive oil in a large bowl. Add the cubes of bread, and toss until coated. Sprinkle the salt, cayenne pepper, and black pepper over the bread crumbs, and toss until evenly coated. Spread in a single layer on an 11-by-17-inch baking sheet. Bake until the croutons are golden, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

Step 2 In a large wooden salad bowl, mash garlic, anchovy fillets, and 1/2 teaspoon salt into a paste using two forks. Use a balloon whisk to mix in 1/4 teaspoon pepper, the lemon juice, mustard, and egg yolk until smooth and combined, and then gradually whisk in the oil in a slow, steady stream, until dressing is emulsified.
Step 3 Add lettuce, cheese, and croutons and toss to coat with the dressing.
Step 4 Shave a bit more cheese over the salad, and serve.

title: Cajun Chicken Fritters with Creole Mustard Dipping Sauce
instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, salt and baking soda.
Stir in slightly beaten egg yolks, buttermilk, butter, hot pepper sauce and creole seasoning.
Add grated onion, green and red bell peppers and chicken.
Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form and gently fold into batter.
In Dutch oven, place canola oil to depth of 2 inches and heat over medium high heat to 375℉.

Drop batter by rounded spoonfuls or medium scoop into hot oil, about 5 or 6 at a time. Fry about 3 minutes or until golden brown, turning once. Drain fritters on paper towels and arrange on serving platter. Serve with Creole Mustard Dipping Sauce.
Creole Mustard Dipping Sauce: In small bowl, stir together mayonnaise, creole mustard and horseradish.

title: CAJUN LAMBAA
instructions: Cook's notes:  Make 4 lamb chops to serve 2-4 as an appetizer.  This amount of spice mixture will coat 4 chops with lots to spare.  Store leftover rub in airtight container.
Combine garlic, spices and herbs in a small bowl.
Coat baby lamb chops in mixture.
Broil chops and serve with ranch-style dressing.
Description: "NEWPORT BEACH BREWING CO."

title: Cajun Meatballs 1
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a medium baking sheet. 2.	In a large bowl, mix thoroughly the ground beef, hot pepper sauce, 1 T. Cajun seasoning, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, onion, bread crumbs, milk, and egg. 3.	Form the mixture into golf ball sized meatballs and place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until there is no pink left in the middle. 4.	In a small bowl, combine the barbeque sauce, 1 T. cajun seasoning  and peach preserves. 5.	When meatballs are done, place in a serving dish and cover with the barbeque sauce mixture. Toss to coat.

title: Cajun Meatballs 2
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a medium baking sheet. 2.	In a large bowl, mix thoroughly the ground beef, hot pepper sauce, Cajun seasoning, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, onion, bread crumbs, milk, and egg. 3.	Form the mixture into golf ball sized meatballs and place on the prepared baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes, or until there is no pink left in the middle. 4.	In a small bowl, combine the barbeque sauce and peach preserves. 5.	When meatballs are done, place in a serving dish and cover with the barbeque sauce mixture. Toss to coat.

title: CAKE DONUTS
ingredients: Preheat oven to 325 degrees.  Lightly spray pan with cooking oil.  In bowl mix together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt.  Add butter, eggs, milk, vanilla, nutmeg and cinnamon.  Beat until well blended.  Fill each Donut Hole 2/3 full.  Bake 8 minutes or until tops spring back when lightly touched.  Cool.  Remove from pan and dip in glaze or cinnamon and sugar.

title: CAKE DOUGHNUTS
ingredients: In a large mixing bowl beat eggs, sugar and vanilla until thick and smooth.  In another bowl combine flour, baking powder, spices and salt.  Whisk together milk and butter.  Add flour mixture and milk mixture alternately to egg mixture, in about 3 additions of each, stirring to form a firm dough.  roll out dough 1/2 inch thick.  Use a doughnut cutter to cut out doughnut shapes.  Heat oil in a deep-fryer to 360 degrees.  Fry doughnuts, in batches, turning them several times, until golden all over.  using a slotted spoon remove doughnuts to a rack set over a baking sheet to drain.  If using chocolate glaze, allow doughnuts to cool slightly first.  To make glaze, melt chocolate.  Mix sugar and butter and add chocolate.

title: California Salad
ingredients: Combine first five ingredients. Fold in sour cream and chill over night.

title: CAPRESE MELTS
instructions: Brush one side of each bread slice with olive oil.  Place 3 slices, oil side down on a 10 by 15 inch baking sheet and layer evenly with basil leaves, tomato slices, and mozzarella slices.  Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper and top with remaining bread slices, oil side up.
Broil sandwiches 6 inches from heat, turning once, until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted, 2 to 3 minutes total.  Serve immediately.
Description: "SUNSET MAGAZINE"

title: Caprese Salad
ingredients: Place sliced mozzarella on a large plate or platter. Top with tomato, olive oil, balsamic, basil, salt and pepper.  Servings 8 serving size 1 = 2.5 pt.s

title: CARAMEL PECAN ROLLS
ingredients: Dissolve yeast in very warm water until dissolved.  Stir in milk, 1/3 cup sugar, oil, baking powder, salt, egg and 3 cups flour.  Beat until smooth and elastic.  Add remaining flour 1 cup at a time and knead dough for 8-10 minutes.  Place in a butter greased bowl and turn over.  Cover with a towel and let rise.  (About 1 1/2 hours)  While dough is rising, heat 1 cup butter and 2 cups brown sugar until melted.  Remove from heat and add 4 tablespoons light corn syrup.  Spread evenly in two 3 quart pyrex dishes.  Sprinkle with pecan halves.  Mix 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon.  When dough is doubled in size, punch down and divide in half.  Roll each piece into a rectangle 10 x 15.  Dot with 2 tablespoons of butter and sprinkle with cinnamon mixture.  Roll up dough using the long side.  Cut into 12 slices and put cut side down into pan.  Repeat with other piece.  (At this point, you can cover with heavy duty foil and put in the refrigerator from 12 to 24 hours.  Remove from refrigerator, let stand 10 minutes and bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown.)  If you want to make rolls on the same day, when you put rolls in pans, let rise 45 minutes to an hour and bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown.  (I like to bake them one pan at a time.)  When you take them out of the oven, let stand for 5 minutes, put a bread board over the top and flip the rolls over.  (This is the tricky part.  You might want to run your knife around the edge to make sure the rolls aren't sticking.)  The rolls freeze very well.

title: CARAMELIZED APPLES
ingredients: large golden delicious apples, peeled, cored
Melt butter.  Add apples, saute 3 minutes.  Sprinkle with sugar, saute until apples are golden brown and tender.  About 8 minutes.  Serve warm over ice cream.

title: Caramelized Onion and Garlic Dip
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: In a large saute pan over medium heat, add the olive oil. Add the thyme, shallots, garlic and all the varieties of onions. Saute, stirring constantly. (Onions absorb oil quickly, so add more if necessary.) Continue to cook until the vegetables are lightly browned, about 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and season with salt and pepper. Let cool slightly.
In a medium bowl, add the yogurt and cream cheese and stir together. Add in the onions, scallions and chives. Stir well to combine.

title: Caribbean Bread Pudding with Rum Sauce
instructions: PUDDING Preheat oven to 350. In a food processor, process the milk and coconut for 45 seconds, until smooth. Strain the milk into a bowl. Reserve the coconut for use at another time. In heavy medium saucepan, combine 1 1/2 C coconut milk with the cream. Heat over medium heat stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes, or until hot. In large mixing bowl, using a hand mixer, beat egg yolks and sugar for 3 to 5 minutes until a thick yellow ribbon forms when the beaters are lifted. Slowly beat in the hot coconut milk mixture.

ASSEMBLE Place half the sponge cake cubes over the bottom of a 2 quart baking dish. Spread the pineapple over the top. Cover the pineapple with the remaining cake cubes. Pour the egg mixture over the top and let stand 10 minutes. Bake 40 to 45 minutes until lightly browned. Cool on a wire rack.

RUM SAUCE In medium saucepan over medium heat, cook the cream and milk, stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes, until hot. In a large bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the sugar until light. Slowly whisk in the hot liquid. Whisk in the rum. Transfer the mixture to the top of a double boiler.  Place over simmering water and cook the mixture, stirring constantly for 8 to 10 minutes or until thick enough to coat a spoon. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.

title: Carne Asada
instructions: In a gallon size Ziploc bag, combine all ingredients with steak and mix really well. Let marinate for at least 6 hours - overnight if you can.
Grill meat and serve with caramelized onions, cilantro, salsa, cheese etc. in tortillas.

title: Carnitas (pulled Pork Tacos)*
ingredients: cut into large (3-4 inch) pieces (do NOT trim away the small amount of fat)
or enough to cover the bottom of the pot
(or chicken stock), preferably with citrus notes

Preheat oven to 350°F. Combine salt and rest of spices in a small bowl. Spread spice mixture onto a plate. Evenly coat the pork pieces on all sides with the dry rub. Heat oil in a dutch oven or heavy-bottomed pot over medium-high heat. Add in the seasoned pork pieces, and sear all sides until browned (about 1 minute per side). Remove pork from the dutch oven. Pour in the beer (or chicken stock) and scrape the bottom of the dutch oven to deglaze and release the browned bits of pork. Add in the orange juice, and bring mixture to a boil. Add in the seared pork. Cover dutch oven and place in oven for 1/2 hour. Remove lid, turn pork pieces over, and return to oven–uncovered–for about 1 1/2 hours, or until the pork is fork-tender, turning the pork pieces 1-2 times during the cooking process. Shred pork right into the sauce using two forks. Toss the pulled pork with the reduced sauce. There will be less sauce than there is for BBQ pulled pork (or my Spicy Pulled Chicken), so don’t expect a super saucy end result. Serve with accoutrements.

title: Carrot and Raisin Muffins
instructions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl; stir in shredded carrots and raisins. Make a well in the center of mixture. Combine eggs, milk, oil and molasses; stir well. Add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Spoon into muffin pans coated with cooking spray, filling 3/4 full.
Bake at 425 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

title: CARROT CAKE
ingredients: Mix dry ingredients.  Add sugar, oil, eggs and mix.  Bake in a 13 x 9 inch pan at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes.  Let cool on rack.  Mix butter and cream cheese.  Gradually mix in confectioner's sugar and vanilla.  Frost cake in pan.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine and beat eggs, sugar and oil. Add remaining ingredients. Beat. Bake at 350 in 13" x 9" floured pan, 35-40 minutes.
Mix together frosting and frost cool cake.

title: Carrot Cake
instructions: Combine and beat eggs, sugar, and oil. Add remaining ingredients. Beat. Bake 350, 35-40 min.
FROSTING Mix together and frost cool cake.

title: Carrot Casserole
ingredients: Combine carrots, water and bouillon in a saucepan; cover, bring to a boil, and cook 15 to 20 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain. Saute green onions in butter in a skillet, remove from heat. Add cheese spread, sour cream and milk; blend well. Stir in sliced carrots. Spoon into a greased 2- quart casserole. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and parsley.  Bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until hot.

title: Carrot Casserole
ingredients: Combine carrots, soup and cheese in 1 quart casserole. Top with crumbs that have been mixed with butter. Bake 20-25 minutes in a 350 oven.

title: Carrot Coconut Bread
ingredients: Mix together eggs and sugar.  Add oil and beat well. Add remaining ingredients, blending well. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. Bake at 325 for 45 minutes or until done.

title: CARROT CUPCAKES
instructions: Preheat ovwn to 375 degrees.  Line a 12 cup standard muffin tin with paper liners.  In a large bowl, whisk together melted butter, brown sugar, egg, yogurt, and vanilla.  Stir in carrots.  Gradually add dry ingredients to butter mixture mixing well until well combined.  Divide among muffin tin.  Bake 25 to 30 minutes, rotating pan halfway through until a toothpick inserted in the center to a cupcake comes out clean.

Remove from pan to a wire rack to cool completely before frosting.  To frost:  Using an electric mixer, beat cream cheese, butter, and confectioners' sugar until smooth; beat in vanilla and orange zest.  Top each cupcake with 2 tablespoons of frosting and spread to cover.
Description: "EVERYDAY BAKING"

title: Carrots with Almonds
ingredients: Cut carrots lengthwise into halves. Cook in water and salt until just tender. Drain. Stir in butter, sugar, orange rind, orange juice and almonds. Simmer 5 minutes, turning and coating carrots in sauce.

title: Castilian Chicken with Spanish Pesto
instructions: Rub chicken with juice of 1 lemon; sprinkle with salt. In small bowl, mix together cocoa powder, sazon and paprika; rub liberally over chicken.
In large nonstick frypan over medium heat, place olive oil. Add chicken and cover. Cook 8 minutes, turning often.

Add garlic and cook about 6 minutes more, turning often. Slice chicken breasts across grain and arrange on platter, fanning slightly. Sprinkle with juice of ½ lemon and drizzle with Spanish Pesto. Garnish with olives, parsley and remaining lemon, sliced.
Spanish Pesto: In food processor, place parsley, olives, minced garlic and garbanzo beans. Pulse, adding Spanish olive oil and pimientos. Empty into bowl and stir in finely grated manchego cheese.

title: Cauliflower Casserole
ingredients: Cook cauliflower in a small amount of boiling water 6 to 8 minutes or until crisp-tender.  Drain well; place flowerets in a buttered 2-quart shallow casserole dish. Set aside. Combine soup, sour cream, 1 T butter and pepper; stir well. Pour over cauliflower. Combine breadcrumbs and remaining 1 T butter; stir well. Sprinkle over soup mixture, bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly.

title: Cauliflower Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: cut into florets (1 pound, or about 3 cups)

Place the potatoes in a 4-quart pot, and fill it with enough cold water to cover them, making sure there are about 4 inches of extra water on top (for when you add the cauliflower). Bring the potatoes to a boil. Once the water is boiling, add the cauliflower, and lower the heat to a simmer. Cook for about 15 minutes, until the potatoes and cauliflower are tender. Drain them in a colander, return them to the pot, and use a potato masher to mash them a bit. Add the oil, 2 tablespoons of broth, and the salt and pepper. Mash a bit more. Use a fork to make sure all the seasoning are mixed well. If needed, add another 2 tablespoons of broth. Taste, and adjust seasonings. Serve warm.

title: Cauliflower Salad
ingredients: Good Seasons Garlic Cheese Salad Dressing
Mix the mayonnaise, sour cream and salad dressing. Blend this mixture into the vegetables.

title: Cauliflower Soup 
ingredients: Saute onion in butter or margarine until tender.  Blend in flour, cook 3 to 4 minutes without browning.  Add scalded milk, seasonings and cauliflower.  Cook until smooth and slightly thick, stirring frequently. Just before serving, add shredded cheese and stir until melted.

title: CELEBRATION PUNCH
ingredients: Chill the wine, soda and champagne.  Early in the morning, make an ice ring using a jello mold with bottled water and cherries with stems.  Just before the guests arrive, mix all the ingredients together in a punch bowl.  If it needs a little more kick, add more brandy.  If it isn't sweet enough, add more corn syrup.  You will need to taste it.

title: CHARCOAL GRILLED SRIMP SKEWERS w/ LEMON GARLIC SAUCE
instructions: Pat shrimp dry with paper towels.  Thread shrimp onto 3 skewers, alternating direction of heads and tails.  Brush both sides of shrimp with oil and season lightly with salt and pepper.  Sprinkle one side of each skewer evenly with sugar.  Place the sugar side on the grill first.  Grill shrimp.  Combine sauce ingredients over a low heat, until butter melts.  When shrimp are done, toss them in sauce.  Add parsley just before serving.
Description: "COOKS ILLUSTRATED"

title: Charcoal-grilled Bone-in Chicken Breasts
ingredients: skin-on chicken breast halves(about 12 ounces each), ribs removed, trimmed of excess fat and skin (see note)
instructions: Dissolve salt in 2 quarts cold water in large container. Submerge chicken, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 1 hour. Rinse chicken under cold water and dry thoroughly with paper towels. Season chicken with pepper.

Meanwhile, light large chimney starter filled with charcoal (6 quarts, or about 100 briquettes) and allow to burn until coals are fully ignited and partially covered with thin layer of ash, about 20 minutes. Build modified two-level fire by arranging all coals over one half of grill, leaving other half empty. Position cooking grate over coals, cover grill, and let grate heat up, about 5 minutes. Scrape grate clean with grill brush. Dip wad of paper towels in oil; holding wad with tongs, wipe cooking grate. Grill is ready when side with coals is medium-hot (you can hold your hand 5 inches above grate for 3 to 4 seconds).

Cook chicken on all sides over hotter part of grill until skin is lightly browned and meat has faint grill marks, 6 to 8 minutes. (If constant flare-ups occur, slide chicken to cooler side of grill and mist fire with water from spray bottle.) Move chicken, skin-side down, to cooler side of grill, with thicker side of breast facing coals. Cover loosely with aluminum foil, cover grill, and continue to cook until instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 150 degrees, 15 to 25 minutes longer.

Brush bone side of chicken with glaze (if using). Move chicken, bone-side down, to hotter side of grill and cook until browned, 4 to 6 minutes. Brush skin side of chicken with glaze; turn chicken over and continue to cook until browned and instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 160 degrees, 2 to 3 minutes longer. Transfer chicken to plate and let rest, tented with foil,  5 minutes. Serve, passing remaining glaze separately.

title: Charcoal-grilled Stuffed Chicken Breasts with Prosciutto and Fontina
ingredients: skin-on chicken breast halves (about 12 ounces each), trimmed of excess fat and skin
rind removed, cut into four 3 by 1/2-inch sticks
instructions: Starting on thick side of breast, closest to breastbone, cut horizontal pocket in each breast, stopping ½ inch from edge so halves remain attached. Dissolve 3 tablespoons salt in 1 quart cold water in large container. Add breasts, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate 30 minutes.

Light large chimney starter filled with charcoal (6 quarts, about 100 briquettes) and allow to burn until coals are fully ignited and partially covered with thin layer of ash, about 20 minutes. Arrange all coals over half of grill, leaving other half empty. Position cooking grate over coals, cover grill, and heat grate until hot, about 5 minutes. Scrape grate clean with grill brush. Dip wad of paper towels in vegetable oil; holding wad with tongs, wipe cooking grate. Grill is ready when coals are hot (you can hold your hand 5 inches above grate for 2 seconds).

Meanwhile, combine butter, shallot, and tarragon in small bowl. Roll each piece of cheese in 1 slice prosciutto. Remove breasts from brine, dry thoroughly inside and out with paper towels, and season inside and out with pepper. Spread equal amount of butter mixture inside each breast. Place 1 prosciutto-wrapped piece of cheese inside each breast and fold breast over to enclose. Evenly space 3 pieces kitchen twine (each about 12 inches long) beneath each breast and tie, trimming any excess.

Place chicken breasts, skin side down, over hot part of grill and cook until well browned, 3 to 5 minutes. Flip chicken and cook until second side is just opaque, about 2 minutes. Move chicken, skin side up, to cool side of grill, with thicker side of breasts facing fire. Cover grill and continue to cook until instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of stuffing registers 160 degrees, 25 to 30 minutes. Transfer chicken to carving board and let rest, tented with foil, 10 minutes. Remove twine, then carve breast meat from bone (see photo below). Carve into ½-inch-thick slices and serve.

title: Chart House Bleu Cheese Dressing
ingredients: Place first 6 ingredients in mixing bowl. Blend 2 minutes at low speed. Add mayonnaise. Blend 1/2 minute at low speed, then blend 2 minutes at medium speed. Crumble blue cheese by hand into very small pieces and add.  Blend at low speed no longer than 4 minutes.  Must sit 24 hours before using.

title: CHART HOUSE BLUE CHEESE DRESSING
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine first 6 ingredients and blend 2 minutes at low speed.
Add mayonnaise and blend 1/2 minute at low speed, then increase speed to medium and blend for an additional 2 minutes.
Slowly add bleu cheese and blend at low speed no longer than 4 minutes.
Refrigerate for 24 hours.
Makes 2 1/2 cups thick Bleu Cheese Dressing.
Yield: "2 1/2 cups"
Description: "CHART HOUSE"

title: Chart House Mud Pie
ingredients: Crush wafers and add butter, mix well. Press into 9-inch pie plate. Cover with soft coffee ice cream.  Put into freezer until ice cream is firm. Top with cold fudge sauce (it helps to place in freezer for a time to make spreading easier). Store in freezer approximately 10 hours. To serve, slice Mud Pie into eight portions and serve on a chilled dessert plate. Top with whipped cream and slivered almonds.

title: Chateubriand
instructions: Preheat oven to 450.  Rub garlic, salt and pepper over filet.  Brush with melted butter.  Place on meat roasting rack in pan and bake 30-40 minutes for rare.  Wash mushrooms and saute 8 minutes in butter, turning frequently.  Place Chateaubriand on a hot platter and serve with mushrooms. Brush Maitre butter over top of meat before serving.
MAITRE BUTTER Cream butter in bowl.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add finely chopped parsley.  Mix well.  Add lemon juice very slowly, stirring all of the time.

title: Cheddar Cheese Bread
ingredients: King Arthur Unbleached Special Bread Flour
heaping cup (4 1/2 ounces) shredded sharp cheddar cheese

In a large bowl, mix together all of the dry ingredients. Add the butter or margarine, water, and milk, and stir to form a shaggy mass. Let the mixture sit for 15 minutes, then knead it, by hand or machine, until you've formed a smooth, elastic dough. Knead in the cheese, place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it, and let it rise for 1 hour; it should be puffy, though not doubled in size. Turn the dough out onto a lightly greased or floured work surface, and shape it into a loaf. Place it in an 8 1/2 x 4 1/2-inch loaf pan, let it rise for about 1 hour, and bake the bread in a preheated 375°F oven for 25 minutes, or until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center reads 190°F. Note: If the bread appears to be browning too quickly, tent it lightly with aluminum foil after the first 15 minutes of baking. Yield: 1 loaf.

title: Cheddar Cheese Coins
instructions: Pulse all the ingredients except the water in a food processor until combined, about 12 pulses. Transfer to a large mixing bowl. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons water. Squeeze the mixture between your hands to form a ball, adding additional water as necessary. Form the dough into two 10-inch logs. Wrap tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Adjust two oven racks to the upper- and lower-middle positions and heat the oven to 350 degrees. Slice the logs into 1/8-inch-thick coins and place on two parchment-lined baking sheets. Bake to deep golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes, reversing the positions of the baking sheets from top to bottom halfway through baking. Cool for 3 minutes on the baking sheets, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
To Make Ahead
The dough can be prepared through step 1 and refrigerated for up to 2 days or frozen for up to 1 month. If frozen, thaw in the refrigerator before continuing with step 2.

title: Cheddar-green Onion Muffins
ingredients: Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups; level with a knife. Combine flour and the next 5 ingredients (through pepper) in a food processor; pulse 3 times to combine. Add a bit more than half the cheese and all the butter; pulse 5 times or until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Spoon mixture into a medium bowl. Combine buttermilk, onions, garlic, and egg; stir with a whisk. Add to flour mixture, stirring just until moist. Spoon batter into 12 muffin cups coated with cooking spray. Sprinkle evenly with remaining \cheese. Bake at 375° for 18 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool for 5 minutes in pan on a wire rack; remove from pan. Cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Cheese and Bacon Spaghetti
ingredients: Simmer onions and garlic in butter until onions are clear. Add meat and brown.  Add tomato soup and water and simmer 2 hours.  Cook spaghetti as usual; when done, drain and combine with meat sauce 1/2 hour before serving.  Add grated cheese and allow to slowly melt. Just before serving, sprinkle crumbled bacon on top.   Serve very hot.

title: CHEESE CAKE
instructions: Butter 9-inch springform pan and refrigerate until ready to use.  Mix 2 cups graham cracker crumbs mixed with melted butter and sugar.

Mix cream cheese softened with 2/3 cup sugar.  Blend in 4 egg yolks - 1 at a time.  Alternate 1 cup milk with 4 tablespoons flour.  Add 4 egg whites which have been stiffly beaten.  Add 1 teaspoon vanilla.  Bake in springform pan which has been coated with 2 cups graham cracker crumbs mixed with melted butter and sugar for 50-60 minutes at 325 degree oven.
Turn off oven.  Open door.  Let stand 1 hour.  Remove and top with sour cream mixed with 1/2 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla.
Bake 450 degrees for 7 minutes.  Turn off oven.  Open door.  Let stand 1 hour.
Remove and top with cherries.

title: Cheese Cake
ingredients: Combine ingredients, beat until light, pour into graham cracker crusts. Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 350. Remove from oven, cool for 5 minutes. Whip topping ingredients and pour on top of cake. Return to oven for 10 minutes. Place in refrigerator for 5 hours.

title: Cheese Casserole
ingredients: Butter and cube bread and grate cheese. Alternate bread and cheese in layers. Beat eggs, add milk and mustard, pepper and salt. Pour over bread. Put in refrigerator over nite. Bake 45 minutes before serving. Bake 350. Top with cooked bacon, ham or sausage. Great for brunch.

title: CHEESE CROSTINI WITH ANCHOVY HERB BUTTER*
ingredients: each 2 by 1/3 inch thick slices rustic bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.  Melt the butter in a heavy small skillet over medium heat.  Add the anchovies and stir until they dissolve, about 3 minutes.  Stir in the herbs, garlic, lemon zest, and crushed red pepper.

Arrange the bread slices on a large baking sheet.  Brush with anchovy mixture.  Sprinkle with the cheese.  Bake until the cheese melts and the bread is golden, about 10 minutes.  Cut the bread in half and serve.
Description: "GIADA DE LAURENTIIS"

title: Cheese Fondue
ingredients: Combine and heat first four ingredients. When bubbly lower temperature and garnish with chives. Serve with cubed French bread.

title: Cheese Herb Bread
ingredients: warm water (110 degrees F/45 degrees C)
Place ingredients in bread machine pan in the order suggested by the manufacturer. Select the Basic or White Bread cycle, and press Start.

title: CHEESE POLENTA
instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to boil in a 5 quart pot.
Slowly pour in the polenta and constantly mix.
Once polenta begginss to simmer and bubble, turn flame down very low.
Continue to stir the polenta until it thickens and is smooth.
Next slowly add the cream and mix well.
Next add the butter and continue ot mix.
Slowly mix in the parmesan cheese and stir until the cheese is melted.
Add dhives and stir.  (Keep polenta over a very low flame to eep warm)
Description: "G GARVIN"

title: CHEESE RAVIOLI WITH BROWN BUTTER AND SAGE
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil; add ravioli and cook until al dente.  Drain and divide among four plates.

In a medium skillet, heat butter over medium heat.  When it starts to foam, add sage.  Continue to cook until butter is golden brown and sage is slightly crisp, 1 to 2 minutes.  Season with salt.  Drizzle ravioli with brown butter and sage.  Serve with parmesan cheese.

title: CHEESE RAVIOLI WITH MUSHROOM SAUCE
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook ravioli according to package instructions, drain.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat oil over medium low heat.  Add mushrooms and garlic, cook, stirring frequently until mushrooms are tender, about 7 minutes.
Add water.  Season with salt and pepper.  Cook until liuid is reduced by half, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, add ravioli, parmesan, butter, and parsley.  Toss to coat, serve.
Description: "FOOD EVERYDAY"

title: CHEESE RAVIOLI WITH SHRIMP/CRABMEAT SAUCE
instructions: Cook ravioli in boiling water as directed.  Using a 12-inch saute pan at medium heat, heat olive oil.  Add shrimp and cook until pink.  Add garlic and shallots and saute until translucent.

Add the crabmeat and cook for 2-3 minutes.  Add the tomato sauce and cream and cook until it reduces half way and becomes creamy.  Add 1/4 parmesan cheese.  Add the cooked ravioli to the sauce and cook together for 1 minute.  Garnish with chives and parmesan cheese.
Description: "FOODTV"

title: Cheese Ravioli with Tomato Basil & Cream Sauce
instructions: Boil the tomatoes for 4-5 mins or until tender; Chop the onions and saute them in some oil till they look pinkish and glazed. Add the minced garlic and saute for another 1 minute.
Now blend the tomatoes, onions and garlic mixture to form a smooth paste.
Add some butter to a non-stick pan, then add the tomato-onion-garlic sauce and let it boil on medium-flame. Add the basil and oregano, salt and pepper, and let it simmer.
Whisk the whipping cream and the Parmesan cheese in a separate bowl to form a thick mixture. Reduce the flame to low, and add this mixture to the tomato sauce.
Meanwhile, cook the cheese ravioli in boiling water as instructed on the packet.

title: Cheese Rice Bake
ingredients: Mix together in 7 x 11 casserole.  Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

title: Cheese Roll
ingredients: Blend all ingredients except parsley and nuts with electric mixer or blender until well mixed. Roll into ball-chill. Roll in mixture of parsley and nuts. Can be frozen. Makes 2 medium size balls.

title: Cheese Sauce
ingredients: Melt butter and blend flour. Add milk cheese & seasonings. Cook and stir until thick.

title: CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients: Beat chili seasoning, cream cheese and salsa.  Shape and top with chopped nuts and cheese.  Chill until firm.  Decorate as desired.

title: Cheese Squares
ingredients: Trim 3 slices of bread at a time. Dip middle slice in mixture of one beaten egg and 1/2 C milk. Put slices together and cut into four squares. Dip each square in melted butter (1 cup) then roll in cheese mixture of one part Parmesan and 1 part grated cheddar cheese. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 450 until toasted. About 3 to 5 minutes - Really good. Make the day before. Also can freeze.

title: Cheesy Artichoke Heart Appetizers
ingredients: Unroll dough into rectangles; press onto bottom and sides of 15 x 10 x 1 jelly roll pan to form crust.  Bake at 375 for ten minutes.  Combine remaining ingredients; mix well. Spread over crust.  Bake at 375 for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.  Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

title: Cheesy Bread Recipe
ingredients: to 1 cup chopped green onion (to taste)
4 ounces), softened to the point of being slightly melted
to 2 loaves of French or Italian bread (I used Ciabatta)
depending on the size of the loaves

1 In a large bowl, mix together the cheeses and the green onion. Stir in the mayonnaise and sour cream. In a separate small bowl blend the butter and garlic until smooth. Add the butter mixture to the cheese mixture. 2 Preheat broiler. Slice loaf of bread in half horizontally, lay crust side down. Spread cheese mixture over the bread. Place under the broiler until nicely browned, about 3 to 5 minutes. 3 Remove from broiler and let sit for 5 minutes until cool enough to handle. Slice the bread with a bread knife. Serve. Makes 30 to 40 slices.

title: Cheesy Buttermilk Biscuits
instructions: Position a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to 500.  Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment.  Put the flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and baking soda in a large bowl and stir with a whisk to distribute the ingredients evenly.

With a sharp knife cut the cold butter crosswise into 1/4 inch thick slices.  Stack 3 or 4 slices and cut them into three even strips.  Rotate the stack a quarter turn and cut the strips in half.  You should create 6 small bits of butter per slice.  Toss the butter bits into the bowl with the flour mixture.  Continue cutting all the butter in the same manner and adding it to the flour mixture.  When all the butter is in the bowl with the flour, use your fingers to separate the butter bits (they tend to stick to one another), coat all the butter pieces with flour and evenly distribute them throughout the flour mixture.  Don't rub the butter too hard with your fingertips or palms, as this will melt the butter.  You're just trying to break the butter pieces apart, not blend the butter into the flour.

When all the butter is evenly distributed, add the cold buttermilk and stir with a large spoon until all or most of the flour is absorbed by the buttermilk and the dough forms a coarse lump, about 1 minute.

Dust a work surface with flour and dump the dough onto the floured surface, cleaning out the bowl with a spatula or a plastic bowl scraper.  Dust the top of the dough and your hands with flour, and press the dough into a 3/4 inch thick rectangle.  Sprinkle a small amount of flour on the top of the dough.  Sprinkle on one third of the cheese.  It will look like a lot of cheese, but it will melt and almost disappear into the biscuits when you bake them.  Fold the dough over on itself in three sections, as if folding a letter.  With a bench knife, lift the dough off the counter and dust flour under it to prevent sticking, if necessary.  Dust top with flour and press the dough out again into a 3/4 inch thick rectangle.  Sprinkle on another one third of the cheese, and repeat the tri fold.  Repeat this procedure one more time.

After the third tri-fold, dust under and on top of the dough, if needed, and roll or press the dough into a 1/2 inch thick oval.  Dip a 2 or 2 3/4 inch round biscuit cutter in flour and start cutting biscuits, dipping the cutter in flour between each biscuit.  Press straight down to cut and lift straight up to remove.  twisting the biscuit cuter will seal the sides and interfere with rising.  Use a bench knife to transfer the biscuits to the prepared baking sheet, setting them about 1/2 inch apart.
Gently gather any scraps of dough, pat and roll out again, and cut more biscuits from the remaining dough.  You can gather and roll the scraps two times total and still get good results.

Put the baking sheet in the oven and reduce the temperature to 450 degrees.  Bake for 8 minutes, then rotate the pan 180 degrees.  Continue baking until both the tops and bottoms of the biscuits are a rich golden brown and the biscuits have doubled in height, revealing flaky layers on the sides, another 4 to 6 minutes.  Remove and let the biscuits cool on the pan for at least 3 minutes.

title: Cheesy Creamed Spinach
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add spinach and cook until wilted, stirring constantly. Remove from the skillet and drain in a colander. Try to squeeze out as much liquid as possible.

Melt the butter in the skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and onions; cook and stir until tender, about 5 minutes. Add the spinach and stir in the heavy cream. Sprinkle in the provolone cheese and stir to melt and coat the spinach. Once the provolone has melted, stir in the Parmesan cheese and continue to cook and stir until thickened. Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

title: Cheesy Garlic Bread
instructions: Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat oven to 400 degrees. Cook garlic, 1 tablespoon butter, and water in small nonstick skillet over low heat, stirring occasionally, until straw colored, 7 to 10 minutes.
Mix hot garlic, remaining butter, salt, and pepper in bowl and spread on cut sides of bread. Sandwich bread back together and wrap loaf in foil. Place on baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Carefully unwrap bread and place halves, buttered sides up, on baking sheet. Bake until just beginning to color, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set oven to broil.
Sprinkle bread with cheese. Broil until cheese has melted and bread is crisp, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer bread to cutting board with cheese side facing down. Cut into pieces. Serve.

title: Cheesy Sloppy Jose Beefy Taco Cups
ingredients: container (20 ounces) refrigerated fully-cooked taco sauce with seasoned ground beef
(17.3 ounces) refrigerated grand corn or buttermilk biscuit dough
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F. Separate biscuits and press each into a 3-1/2-inch circle. Place over the underside of muffin cups from a standard-size muffin pan, pressing around cup to shape into bowl.
Bake in 350°F oven 12 to 15 minutes or until browned. Remove baked cups to platter.
Meanwhile combine taco sauce with ground beef and sloppy Joe sauce in medium saucepan; cook over medium heat 6 to 8 minutes or until hot and bubbly, stirring occasionally. Stir in 3/4 cup cheese.
Spoon beef mixture evenly into cups. Top evenly with lettuce, tomato and 1/4 cup cheese. Top with sour cream and olives.
Per serving:	410 calories; 16 g protein; 35 g carbohydrate; 23 g fat; 1,319 mg sodium; 29 mg cholesterol; 2.5 mg niacin; 0.3 mg vitamin B6; 2.3 mcg vitamin B12; 2.9 mg iron; 2.5 mg zinc._____

title: Cheesy Zucchini Enchiladas
ingredients: kosher salt and fresh ground pepper
grated reduced fat mexican blend cheese (Sargento)
Large La Tortilla Factory Low Carb tortillas
chipotle chilis in adobo sauce (optional for more heat)
kosher salt and fresh pepper to taste
instructions: For the enchilada sauce: in a medium saucepan, spray oil and sauté garlic. Add chipotle chile, chili powder, cumin, broth, tomato sauce, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-10 minutes. Set aside until ready to use.
Spray a baking dish with nonstick spray. Preheat oven to 400 degrees.

In a medium nonstick skillet, sauté garlic and scallions in olive oil over medium heat for about 3 minutes; add zucchini, salt and pepper to taste and cook about 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and add 1/2 cup cheese; mix well. Divide zucchini between in each tortilla, roll and place seam side down in baking dish. Top with enchilada sauce (you might not use all) and remaining cheese and bake until hot and the cheese is melted, about 20 minutes. Serve with chopped cilantro, scallions, and reduced fat sour cream if you wish. Enjoy!!
4 servings 1 large enchilada = 7 pts.

title: Cheesy-olive Appetizers
ingredients: Combine first 5 ingredients; stir well.  Spread about 2 T cheese mixture on each toasted muffin half. Broil 2 minutes or until cheese melts; cut each half into quarters.  Serve warm.

title: Chef John Folse's Shrimp Remoulade
ingredients: hot pepper sauce (Chef Folse likes Louisiana Gold

In a food processor, combine all of the above ingredients blending l to incorporate the seasonings. Once blended, cover and place in the refrigerator, preferably overnight. A minimum of four hours will be required for flavor to be developed. When ready, remove from refrigerator and serve with cold, cooked shrimp.

title: Cherry and Vanilla Pies
ingredients: Fresh cherries 2 cups pitted and chopped

For the filling: 1. In a small bowl, combine sugar and vanilla pods. Gently rub together with fingertips to release oils. 2. In a small saucepan combine cherries, sugar, lemon juice and salt and let stand for 15 minutes. 3. In a small bowl whisk together cornstarch and water until smooth. Place pan on medium high heat and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and cook for 4-5 minutes until cherries have softened. Once fruit has softened add cornstarch mixture and almond extract. Bring to a boil and cook for 1 minute until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in jam. Cool. For the pie dough: 1. In the bowl of a food processor, combine dry ingredients. While pressing the pulse button on and off, slowly add cold butter and mix until you see lumps the size of broken walnut pieces. Combine water and vinegar and slowly add to flour/butter mixture pulsing on and off just until dough comes together. The dough should be moist and hold together, but not sticky. 2. Remove from the bowl and divide dough into two pieces. Wrap dough in plastic wrap and flatten into a thick disc. Chill for at least 2 hours or overnight. To assemble: 1. Remove pie dough from refrigerator. Lightly dust work surface with flour. Roll dough to ¼ inch thickness and working quickly, cut out 3-inch rounds. Repeat with second disc and with leftover dough. Chill discs until firm. 2. Cut 3 small slits onto 1/2 of the dough discs — these will be used as the top part of the pops. Make egg wash by whisking together egg and salt. With a pastry brush, brush the edges of the discs with the egg wash. Place a lollipop stick in the center and push gently into the dough and then place 2 teaspoons filling in the center of the disc. Place another dough disc on top. Seal and crimp the edge with a fork. Repeat with remaining dough and then chill cherry pops until firm. 3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees. 4. Brush tops of cherry pops with egg wash and then sprinkle generously with sugar. Bake for 15-17 minutes until tops are lightly browned. Cool completely before serving. Serving Size 2 dozen

title: Cherry Cheese Bars
instructions: For Crust: Combine flour and brown sugar. Cut in Crisco until fine crumbs form. Add 1/2 cup finely chopped nuts and coconut. Mix well. Remove 1/2 cup and set aside. Press remaining crumbs in bottom of 13 x 9 pan. Bake 350 for 12 to 15 minutes, until edges are lightly browned.

For Filling: Beat cream cheese, sugar, eggs and vanilla in small bowl at medium speed of electric mixer until smooth. Spread over hot baked crust. Return to oven. Bake 15 minutes longer. Spread cherry pie filling over cheese layer.  Combine reserved coarsely chopped nuts and crumbs. Sprinkle evenly over cherries. Return to oven. Bake 15 minutes longer. Cool and refrigerate several hours. Cut into bars about 2 by 1 1/2 inches.

title: Cherry Cherry Cheese Pie
ingredients: In medium bowl, beat cheese until light and fluffy. Add sweetened milk, blend thoroughly. Stir in lemon and vanilla. Pour into crust and chill 3 hours or until set. Top with pie filling.

title: Cherry Cream Dessert
ingredients: Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and butter and press into pan (8" x 11"). In sauce pan combine gelatin and water, heat until gelatin dissolves, stir in pie filling. Chill until partially set. Prepare dessert topping according to package directions. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar to soft peaks, gradually add the second 1/4 C sugar and beat to stiff peaks. Fold egg whites and dessert topping into jello mixture, spoon over crumbs, top with reserved crumbs. Chill until firm, 4-6 hours.

title: Cherry Dessert
ingredients: Spread cherry filling on bottom, sprinkle nuts, sprinkle mix. Dot butter on mix. Bake 350. 30 minutes

title: Cherry Sorbet
instructions: Stem the cherries and remove the pits.  In a medium saucepan over medium heat, combine the cherries with the water, sugar, and lemon juice, and cook until the cherries are very soft and cooked through, about 10-15 minutes.  Remove from heat and let it cool to room temperature, then refrigerate to chill thoroughly.
Puree the cherries and their liquid and put the mixture through a fine sieve.
Once the cherry mixture is chilled, freeze according to your ice cream maker's instructions.
Serving Size: 1/2 cup • Old Points: 2 pts • Points+: 4

title: Cherry Tomato Watermelon Salad
instructions: Toss tomatoes, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and sugar in medium bowl; let stand for 30 minutes. Transfer tomatoes to salad spinner and spin until seeds and excess liquid have been removed, 45 to 60 seconds, stirring to redistribute tomatoes several times during spinning. Return tomatoes to bowl and set aside. Strain tomato liquid through fine-mesh strainer into liquid measuring cup, pressing on solids to extract as much liquid as possible.

Bring 1/2 cup tomato liquid (discard any extra), shallot, and vinegar to simmer in small saucepan over medium heat. Simmer until reduced to 3 tablespoons, 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer mixture to small bowl and cool to room temperature, about 5 minutes. Whisk in oil and pepper to taste until combined. Taste and season with up to 1/8 teaspoon table salt.
Add watermelon, mint, feta, and dressing to bowl with tomatoes; toss gently and serve.

title: Cherry-Pecan Brie
ingredients: Stir together cherry preserves, balsamic vinegar, freshly ground pepper, and salt in a bowl. Drizzle over warm Brie round. Top with chopped toasted pecans. Serve with crackers.

title: Chewy Chocolate Cookie
ingredients: Cream butter and sugar in large mixer bowl.  Add eggs and vanilla; blend well.  Combine flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; blend into creamed mixture.  Stir in nuts.  Drop by tsp. onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 350 for 8 - 9 minutes. (do not overbake).  Cookies will be soft.  They will puff during baking, flatten upon cooling. Cool on cookie sheet until set, about 1 minute; remove to wire rack to cool completely.

title: CHEWY NUT TOFFEES*
instructions: Coat a 9 x 13 baking pan that is at least 1 1/2 inches deep with cooking spray.  Set aside.  In a 2 quart saucepan, combine the cream and condensed milk; set aside.

In a heavy 3 to 4 quart saucepan, combine corn syrup, water, sugar, and salt.  Cook over high heat, stirring with a wooden spoon, until sugar is dissolved, about 5 minutes.  Using a pastry brush dipped in water, brush away any sugar crystals on sides of pan to prevent recrystallization.

Stop stirring, reduce heat to medium, and bring to a boil.  Cook without stirring until the temperature reaches the hard-ball stage on a candy thermometer (260 degrees), about 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook the cream mixture over low heat until it is just warm.  Do not boil.  When the sugar mixture reaches 260 degrees slowly stir in the butter and warmed cream mixture, keeping the mixture boiling at all times.  Stirring constantly, cook over medium heat until the mixture reaches the firm-ball stage (248 degrees) about 15 minutes.  Stir in the vanilla and nuts.  Immediately pour into the prepared pan without scraping the pot.  Let sit uncovered at room temperature for 24 hours without moving the pan.

To cut, spray a large cutting board generously with vegetable oil spray.  Unmold the toffee from the pan onto surface.  Cut into pieces, and wrap each in cellophane or waxed paper.  Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 month.
Description: "BON APPETIT" Yield: "75 "

title: Chewy Walnut Squares
ingredients: Stir together eggs, brown sugar and vanilla. Quickly stir in flour, baking soda and salt. Add walnuts. Spread in 13x9x2 cake pan. Sprinkle chocolate and butterscotch chips on top and pat in mixture with spoon. (Set oven to 350) spray pan with Pam - bake approximately 20-25 minutes.

title: Chicken & Seafood Jambalaya
ingredients: Combine first 7 ingredients in small bowl for seasoning mixture.  Preheat oven to 350. Melt chicken fat in heavy oven proof saucepan over medium heat. Add ham and sausage and cook until crisp, 5 to 8 minutes, stirring frequently.  Mix in onion, celery and bell pepper and cook until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes, scrapping bottom of pan occasionally.  Add chicken, increase heat to high and cook 1 minute, stirring. Reduce heat to medium, add garlic and seasoning mixture and stir 3 minutes to blend flavors, scraping bottom of pan. Add tomatoes and cook until chicken is just tender, about 5 minutes, stirring frequently.  Pour in tomato sauce and cook 7 minutes, stirring. Mix in stock and bring to boil.  Stir in green onions and cook 2 minutes. Mix in rice, shrimp and oysters. Cover and bake until rice is barely tender, 20 to 30 minutes. Remove bay leaves. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken A La Jerusalem
ingredients: Dredge chicken in flour.  Melt butter in large skillet, add chicken, saute till lightly brown. Season.  Wash mushrooms, pat dry.  Add to chicken along with artichoke hearts.  Pour sherry over all, simmer 15 minutes or till most wine evaporated.  Stir in cream.  Add more if needed to thin sauce.  Add parsley with chives.  Serves 4-6

title: CHICKEN A LA KING
ingredients: In a large frying pan, melt 2 tablespoons of the butter overmedium heat.  Add mushrooms, bell pepper, and onion.  Cook 5 minutes, until vegetables are tender.  Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside.  Melt remaining 2 tablespoons of butter in the same pan.  Add flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg.  Cook, stirring for 1 minute without browning.  In a small bowl, combine broth and cream.  Gradually stir cream mixture into pan.  Bring to a boil, and cook, stirring, until sauce is smooth and thickened, 3 to 5 minutes.  Gradually whisk 1 cup of sauce into egg yolk.  Stir back into pan until well blended.  Add vegetable mixture, lemon juice, sherry and chicken.  Cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.  Garnish with pimento.

title: Chicken A La Lorain
ingredients: Mix salad dressing, soup and jam in bowl.  Line pan with foil.  Place chicken in pan and pour on the mixture.  Wrap the chicken with foil.  Bake 350 for 1 hour. Uncover and continue baking 15-20 minutes.

title: Chicken Acapulco
instructions: Combine chicken, 1/2 can soup, sour cream, mushrooms, chilies, onions, almonds, celery.
Divide mix on tortillas.  Fold edges like crepes.  Arrange seam side down. Combine sherry and 1/2 can soup.  Spoon over tortillas.

Micro- Cover with wax paper - 7 minutes on high. Remove wax paper and sprinkle grated cheese on tortillas. Micro uncovered 1 minute on high. Can bake in oven till hot and bubbly.

title: Chicken Almond
ingredients: Fry chicken in oil in wok, add remaining ingredients (except cornstarch and water).  Mix well. Cover and steam for 5 minutes.  Mix cornstarch in water, add to chicken and cook, stirring constantly until thick. Garnish with extra almonds. Serve with rice.

title: Chicken Almond
ingredients: Fry chicken in oil, heavy pan or wok- add remaining ingredients (except cornstarch and water). Mix well, cover and steam 5 minutes. Mix cornstarch in water, add to chicken and cook, stirring constantly till thick. Salt to taste. Garnish with extra almonds. Serve at once with Chinese fried rice. Use high heat and quick stirring. Don't overcook.

title: CHICKEN AND BROCCOLI
ingredients: There are five layers in this recipe.  Use a 9 x 13 inch dish.  1st layer.  Thaw and drain broccoli.  Layer into pan.  2nd layer.  chicken breasts cut into bite size pieces.  3rd layer. american cheese slices.  4th layer. mix soup, mayonnaise, broth and pour over above.  5th layer.  top with chopped nuts and chips.  Bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Chicken and English Pea Bake
ingredients: Combine margarine, soy sauce, paprika and rosemary in a shallow 2-quart casserole.  Place skinned chicken in casserole, turning to coat.  Add mushrooms; pour broth around chicken.  Cover and bake at 350 for 50 minutes.  Add peas; cover and bake an additional 10 minutes or until peas are tender.

title: Chicken and Rice Soup 
ingredients: Combine chicken, water, onion, celery salt, pepper, bay leaf in a soup pot. Bring to a boil, cover reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes.  Remove chicken from pot, reserving broth. Discard bay leaf. Set chicken aside.  Add rice and carrot to broth; bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes or until rice is tender.  Bone chicken and cut into bite-size pieces. Add chicken to broth; heat thoroughly.

title: Chicken and Sausage Jambalaya
ingredients: canned low-sodium chicken broth or homemade stock
skinless chicken breasts (about 3 in all), cut into 1-inch pieces

In a large saucepan, heat the oil over moderate heat. Add the sausages and cook, turning, until browned, 5 to 10 minutes in all. Remove. When the sausages are cool enough to handle, cut them into 1/4-inch slices. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon fat from the pan. Add the onion, celery, bell pepper, and garlic to the pan and cook, covered, over moderately low heat until the vegetables start to soften, about 5 minutes. Add the rice, broth, sausage, cayenne, bay leaves, and salt and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 15 minutes. Stir in the chicken and simmer, covered, until the chicken is just done and the rice and the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes longer. Remove from the heat and let stand, covered, for about 2 minutes.

title: Chicken and Shiitake Mushroom Dumplings
instructions: To reconstitute mushrooms, place in small bowl and cover with boiling water; let sit 10 minutes, drain thoroughly, squeezing out excess liquid and dice.
Finely dice chicken, place in medium bowl and stir in soy sauce.
In small bowl, mix together sesame oil, ginger, scallions, pepper and salt. Stir into chicken mixture and add diced mushrooms.
On each wonton skin, spoon 1 heaping teaspoon of the mixture. Moisten edges of wonton skin with water, fold diagonally, seal and crimp edges. Stand dumpling on end.
Using a heavy sauté pan with lid, place on high heat and add 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil.

Arrange dumplings (pot stickers) in pan (do not crowd), reduce heat to medium and add about 2 tablespoons water. Place lid on pan and cook about 2 minutes; remove lid and cook about 1 minute more. (Do not touch dumplings while cooking or they will not develop a crust.) Repeat until all are cooked. Serve as appetizers with Dipping Sauce.
Dipping Sauce: In small bowl, mix together 4 tablespoons soy sauce; 4 tablespoons chili-garlic sauce; 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar; and 2 teaspoons sugar. Let sit to blend flavors.

title: Chicken and Vegetables
ingredients: Place chicken (skin on or off) in Bean Pot. Place chopped onion, celery and carrots on top of chicken. Sprinkle with ½ package of Good Seasons Italian Dressing mix. Cover with the lid. Bake at 350F for 1 hour.

title: Chicken and Wild Rice
ingredients: uncooked wild rice & long grained combined

Lay chicken in bottom of 9" x 13" pan (greased). Sprinkle envelope of onion soup mix over chicken. Combine rice, soup and milk, pour over chicken. Bake 1 hour at 350 in foil covered pan. Uncover and bake 1/2 hour. Can also be baked for 3 hours at 275.

title: Chicken Avocado Egg Rolls
ingredients: rice bran oil or canola oil
instructions: In a saute pan over high heat, add canola oil. Saute red onions and bell peppers until translucent. Add ginger, garlic, bamboo shoots, celery, chicken, and cook for 5 minutes over medium heat. Deglaze pan with soy sauce. Cool mixture.
In large bowl combine cabbage, carrots and chicken mixture.
In medium saucepan, heat rice bran oil to 350 degrees F. Oil needs to be deep enough to keep egg roll from touching bottom of pan. Add more oil, if needed.

To roll egg rolls, layout egg roll skin with corner facing you, place approximately 1/12th of mixture on roll and place 2 pieces of avocado on top of mixture. Fold corner over mixture, and then fold outside corners over the mixture, making a roll, 4 to 5-inches wide. Roll firmly, being careful not to tear wrapper, and seal the final edge with egg wash.
Dredge the egg roll in egg wash, allow excess to drain off and submerge egg roll in oil. Fry until golden brown, about 3 to 4 minutes. Drain on sheet tray lined with a cooling rack.

title: Chicken Breast Cacciatore
ingredients: Heat oil in a large frying pan; saute' chicken and garlic about 4 minutes.  Turn chicken often. Remove garlic. Add salt & pepper and wine. Simmer uncovered until liquid is reduced by 1/3.  Add the tomatoes and the fresh basil, cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until chicken is done. Before serving sprinkle with cheese.

title: Chicken Breast with Tomato and Mozzarella
ingredients: Beat eggs with water, set aside.  Combine crumbs, parmesan, garlic, paprika.  Heat oil, dip chicken that has been dredged in flour.  Dip chicken in egg, then crumbs.  Fry until brown. Put in a 9 x 13 pan.  Lay chicken, drizzle tomato sauce over chicken.  Sprinkle Mozzarella over top.  Sprinkle with parmesan.  Bake 350 for 30 minutes.

title: Chicken Breasts In Cream Sauce
ingredients: Cut chicken into strips.  Melt butter in large skillet; add chicken, vegetables and seasonings.  Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, 10 minutes or until chicken is tender. Add 2 T wine; simmer 5 minutes.  Combine cream cheese, milk and remaining wine in saucepan, stirring over low heat until smooth. Place noodles on platter; top with chicken and cream cheese mixture.

title: Chicken Breasts Stuffed with Spinach, Cranberries and Goat Cheese
instructions: In medium bowl, place cranberries; add wine and set aside.

Place chicken breasts, skin side down, between layers of plastic wrap and pound to flatten. Sprinkle inside each chicken breast with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Place spinach to cover inside of breast. Top with 2 tablespoons of the cranberries and 2 ounces of goat cheese.

Cover cranberries and goat cheese with spinach leaves and fold sides and ends of chicken breast. Repeat with second chicken breast and sprinkle chicken skin with remaining salt and pepper. Place chicken in 400°F oven and bake for about 1 hour.

While chicken is cooking, put wine in sauce pan and bring to a boil over medium heat. Add hot pepper jelly and whisk until blended. Stir in cranberries and cook until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes. Slice chicken, front to back, and arrange on serving dish with cranberry sauce under and around the chicken. Garnish with orange slices and parsley.

title: Chicken Broccoli Supper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
In a large bowl combine first 3 ingredients.  Whisk remaining ingredients together, then add to chicken mixture.
Bake in 9x9 pan, uncovered, 45 minutes at 375 degrees.

title: Chicken Cacciatore with Portobellos and Sage
ingredients: Table salt and ground black pepper
wiped clean and cut into 3/4-inch cubes
chicken stock or low-sodium canned chicken broth
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat oil in Dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering but not smoking, about 2 minutes. Add four chicken thighs, skin-side down, and cook, not moving them until skin is crisp and well browned, about 5 minutes; using tongs, flip chicken and brown on second side, about 5 minutes longer. Transfer browned chicken to large plate; brown remaining chicken thighs, transfer to plate, and set aside.

Drain off all but 1 tablespoon fat from pot. Add onion, mushrooms, and 1/2 teaspoon salt; sauté over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until moisture evaporates and vegetables begin to brown, 6 to 8 minutes. Meanwhile, remove and discard skin from browned chicken thighs. Add garlic to pot and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in flour and cook, stirring constantly, about 1 minute. Add wine, scraping pot bottom with wooden spoon to loosen brown bits. Stir in stock, tomatoes, thyme, cheese rind (if using), 1/2 teaspoon salt (omit salt if using cheese rind), and pepper to taste. Submerge chicken pieces in liquid and bring to boil; cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer until chicken is tender and cooked through, about 45 minutes, turning chicken pieces with tongs halfway through cooking. Discard cheese rind, stir in sage, adjust seasonings with salt and pepper, and serve.

title: Chicken Casserole I
ingredients: Mix rice, soups and milk. Place in large casserole. Place chicken on skin side down and add salt & pepper. Make 3 hours ahead of time. Place in 250 oven uncovered for 3 hours. Turn chicken once.

title: Chicken Casserole II
ingredients: Mix all ingredients well, let stand overnight in refrigerator. Take out one hour before putting in oven. Bake 1 hour at 350 - uncovered.

title: Chicken Casserole III
ingredients: Bake 4 chicken breasts in foil at 350 for 20 minutes. Skin, cut in big pieces. Save juice and use to cover tortillas. Mix sauce ingredients in large bowl. Butter 9 1/2" x 13" casserole. Alternate layers of tortillas and chicken. Cover each layer with sauce. Store in refrigerator 24 hours. Cover with foil and bake 1 1/2 hours at 300. Leave foil cover on the first hour, the next 1/2 hour take foil off cover with cheese. Leave till melted and runny.

title: Chicken City Coleslaw
ingredients: boneless, skinless, cut in 2- inch strips
instructions: In large bowl, toss together coleslaw, red peppers, green onions, water chestnuts, almonds, peanuts and sundried tomatoes.
Spray large skillet with cooking spray, place over medium heat and add 3 tablespoons Dressing. Add chicken and cook, stirring, about 6 minutes until chicken is done and liquid absorbed.

Add half of chicken to coleslaw and toss. Pour warm Dressing over mixture and toss to blend. Transfer coleslaw to serving dish, sprinkle with grated cheese and arrange remaining chicken on top. Garnish with olives.

Dressing: In small saucepan, mix together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, vegetable oil, lemon pepper seasoning and light brown sugar. Place over medium heat and cook, stirring, until mixture comes to a boil. Turn off heat, cover and keep warm.

title: Chicken Cordon Bleu Casserole with Creamy Mustard Sauce
ingredients: Salt and cayenne pepper to taste
instructions: Melt butter over medium-high heat in a sauté pan. Add chicken and sauté until beginning to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in shallots and sauté until softened, 2 minutes. Sprinkle mixture with flour, cook 1 minute.
Combine apple juice and broth; slowly add, stirring constantly to avoid clumping.
Stir in cream, Parmesan, mustard, and thyme; simmer after each addition until sauce is thickened, about 5 minutes. Add broccoli; season with salt and cayenne. Reduce heat to low.

Hollow out loaves by cutting off tops and tearing out insides. (Remove as much bread as possible.) Compress any remaining bread inside loaves to make room for filling. Toast loaves directly on oven rack, about 5 minutes; remove to prepared baking sheet.

Arrange ham slices in bottom of each loaf. Using a slotted spoon, divide chicken mixture evenly between loaves, reserving sauce in pan. Top the chicken in each loaf with a slice of Swiss and sprinkle with 1 tsp. Parmesan.
Bake casseroles until cheese melts, 7–10 minutes. (For extra browning, broil casseroles on high, 3–5 minutes.)
Serve each casserole with reserved cream sauce.

title: Chicken Divan
ingredients: Simmer chicken in lightly salted water to cover for 25 minutes or just until cooked through. Skin and bone chicken. Cook broccoli. Trim so is approximately one inch longer than chicken breast on each side. Melt butter in a saucepan, add flour and cook until bubbly. Add broth and Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Reduce heat and stir in one cup of cheese, heating gently till melted. Empty sour cream into medium bowl, gradually add cheese sauce stirring constantly. Lightly butter 9 x 13 baking dish. Sprinkle croutons over bottom. Arrange broccoli in eight portions in baking dish and season with salt and pepper. Top each with chicken breast and pour sauce over all. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and paprika. Bake 325 for 20 minutes or until heated through.

title: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
instructions: Make sauce.  In a saucepan heat 3 T. oil, add flour and cook, whisking 1 minute.  Add chili powder and cook 30 seconds.  Stir in stock, tomato puree, oregano, and cumin and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes until flavors are well blended.  Season to taste with salt.

Make enchiladas.  Combine cheese, chicken, onion and optional olives for filling.  Heat 1/2 cup oil in a skillet until hot.  Using tongs dip in tortillas, one at a time, to soften (a few seconds on each side), and drian on paper towels.  Dip each tortilla in sauce.  On a plate working with one tortilla at a time, place a generousspoonful of filling down middle of tortilla and roll up.  Place enchiladas seam-side down in a baking dish.  Top with remaining sauce.  Bake for 20 minutes.
Description: "JUDY TOMBLIN"

title: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Place chicken in a Dutch oven; cover with water and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken from broth and let cool; reserve broth for other uses. Remove chicken from bone, and chop; set aside.
Saute onion and garlic in hot oil until tender, set aside.

Place tomatoes in container of an electric blender; process until pureed; add to onion mixture. Add tomato sauce, green chilies, sugar, cumin, oregano, basil, cilantro, and salt and stir well. Bring to a boil; cover, reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Stir in 3/4 cup sour cream.
Spoon 2 heaping T each of chicken and cheese on tortilla; roll up tightly and place seam side down in lightly greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish.  Pour tomato mixture over enchiladas.
Bake uncovered at 350 for 40 minutes. Remove from oven; add the remaining cheese, and bake an additional 5 minutes.
Serve with additional sour cream if desired.

title: CHICKEN FAJITAS
ingredients: boned and skinned chicken breast halves

Combine lime juice, rind, half the garlic, the cilantro, 1 teaspoon olive oil and 1/4 teaspoon cumin in gallon-size resealable plastic food storage bag.  Add chicken; seal.  Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.  Heat broiler or barbecue.  Remove chicken from marinade and place on baking sheet.  Broil chicken for 7 minutes or until no longer pink in center, turning after 3 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Heat remaining oil in nonstick skillet.  Add onions, remaining garlic and the peppers.  Sprinkle with remaining cumin, the salt and pepper.  Saute until vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.  Slice chicken into thin strips.  Spoon vegetables and chicken into tortillas.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
ingredients: skinless chicken breasts , cut into bite-size pieces
small peeled and finely diced carrots (about 4 ounces total)
cut into small pieces about 1/4 inch in size
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Combine 2 2/3 cups water, rice and 1/4 teaspoon of salt in a rice cooker, and cook according to the manufacturer's instructions. Transfer the steamed rice to a baking sheet to cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate until cold.

Heat 1 tablespoon of canola oil in a large wok over medium-high heat. Add the eggs and stir with a fork for about 30 seconds or until just cooked. Remove the eggs from the wok and set aside on a plate.

Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in the wok, season chicken with salt and pepper and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Remove chicken to a plate. Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons of canola oil in the wok over medium-high heat.

Add the carrots and broccoli to the wok, and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the cold rice, and stir-fry for 2 minutes or until heated through. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in the eggs, chicken and 3/4 of the green onions. Add the soy sauce and sesame oil and continue to stir-fry for 1 minute. Transfer the rice to a bowl and sprinkle with the remaining green onions.

title: Chicken In Cilantro Sauce
instructions: Marinate chicken in oregano, garlic salt, pepper and vinegar. Heat oil, add onion.  Cook until tender.  Add Cilantro Sauce and cook 2 minutes.  Add chicken and water to cover.  Cook 45-55 minutes.
CILANTRO SAUCE Combine in processor, blend till smooth.

title: Chicken Kiev
ingredients: Place chicken between sheets of saran and pound until 1/4" thick. Sprinkle with salt and then mixture of parsley and onion tops. Place butter at one end and roll lengthwise

making sure sides are folded in. Secure with a toothpick. Roll in seasoned flour and then in beaten egg and finally fine dry bread crumbs. Refrigerate several hours. Deep fry at 375 for 5-8 minutes. If large chicken breasts are used, cut in half. Follow recipe above, using 8 pieces of butter and divide parsley-chives mixture among the 8 halves. Serve with Sauce Smitane.

title: Chicken Kiev
ingredients: seasoned with salt & pepper for dredging

Place chicken between sheets of saran and pound until 1/4" thick. Sprinkle with salt and then mixture of parsley and onion tops. Place butter at one end and roll lengthwise, making sure sides are folded in. Secure with a toothpick. Roll in seasoned flour and then in beaten egg and finally fine dry bread crumbs. Refrigerate several hours. Deep fry at 375 for 5-8 minutes. If large chicken breasts are used, cut in half. Follow recipe above, using 8 pieces of butter and divide parsley-chives mixture among the 8 halves. Serve with Sauce Smitane.

title: Chicken Milanese
ingredients: butterflied and lightly pounded to 1/4-inch thick
instructions: To make the Chicken Milanese: Set up a standard breading procedure in 3 wide deep plates. Fill 1 with flour, 1 with the beaten eggs, and 1 with the panko and grated Parmigiano. Season the chicken breasts with salt. Using one hand for dry things and 1 hand for wet things, take each piece of chicken through the breading procedure: dredge lightly in the flour, then the egg wash and then through the bread crumbs. Lay the breaded chicken on a sheet tray and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Pour olive oil into a large saute pan until it reaches a thickness of about a half an inch - better a little more rather than a little less. Bring to a medium-high heat and add butter. Test the oil by flicking flour or bread crumbs into the oil. If it doesn't sizzle-WAIT! When the oil is hot, test it again by dipping the edge of a piece of chicken into the oil, the oil should gently sizzle. Cook the chicken in the oil in batches on both sides until it is a lovely golden brown color and is crispy, about 4 to 5 minutes. Do not crowd the pan or the chicken will become very greasy and soggy. When the chicken comes out of the oil lay it on paper towels to drain off the excess oil and sprinkle with salt. You can keep the chicken in a low oven to keep it warm while the rest of the chicken is cooking.

title: Chicken Milanese:
ingredients: butterflied and lightly pounded to 1/4-inch thick

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Place the first 4 ingredients in a 3 1/2-5 quart crock pot. Combine salt and the next 6 ingredients; sprinkle over vegetables. Add 6 cups water; cover and cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours. Remove chicken and bay leaf; add remaining 2 cups water. Stir in noodles and cook, covered, on high setting for 20 minutes. Meanwhile remove bones from chicken and cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Add to slow cooker, stir to mix. Cook for 15 minutes on high setting, covered or until noodles are tender.
Makes 10 (1 Cup Servings)  Points Plus = 2 per serving

title: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP*
instructions: Chicken Stock.  Place the chicken and vegetables in a large stockpot over medium heat.  Pour in only enough cold water to cover (about 3 quarts), too much will make the broth taste weak.  Toss in the thyme, bay leaves, and peppercorns and allow it to slowly come to a boil.  Lower the heat to medium-low and gently simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours, partially covered, until the chicken is done.  As it cooks, skim any impurities that rise to the surface, add a little more water if necessary to keep the chicken covered while simmering.

Carefully remove the chicken to a cutting board.  When it is cool enough to handle, discard the skin and bones; hand-shred the meat into a storage container.
