(Dip both sides of prepared chicken into egg white-cornstarch mixture.  Transfer the chicken to the crumb dish.  Pat crumbs on both sides of chicken)

Saute chicken in oil in a large nonstick, ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat for about 3 minutes, or until golden brown and crisp.  Carefully turn with a spatula and transfer the skillet to the oven to finish cooking.  Roast chicken just until done, about 8 more minutes.
Description: "CUISINE AT HOME"

title: CRUSTED GOAT CHEESE WITH SPINACH AND FRESH TOMATO SAUCE
instructions: Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl.  Season with salt and pepper, cover and chill

Pulse panko and almonds together in a food processor until fine.  Slice cheese into eight 1/2 inch thick slices.  Dip each slice into egg, then coat in almond mixture. Brown coated cheese in 1 T. oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Drain medallions on paper towels; return pan to the burner.
Saute spinach with pepper flakes and salt until wilted, about 1 minute.  Serve crusted cheese over sauteed spinach and top with tomato salsa.

title: Cuban Style Black Beans
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Chop onion, garlic, scallions, red pepper, and cilantro in a mini chopper of food processor.

Add oil to a medium-sized pot on medium heat. Add vegetables to the pot and saute until soft, about 3 minutes. Add beans, water, bay leaf, cumin, oregano, red wine vinegar, salt and black pepper and bring to a boil. Lower heat and cover, simmer about 15 minutes stirring occasionally (adjust water as needed). Taste for salt and serve.

title: Cucumber Sandwiches
ingredients: Blend cheese and mayonnaise well. Add rest of ingredients. Remove crusts and lightly butter bread. Make 8 sandwiches and cut in quarters.

title: Cucumber Slices
ingredients: Spread cucumber with cream cheese and olives.

title: Cucumber-Stuffed Cherry Tomatoes
instructions: Cut a thin slice off the top of each tomato. Scoop out and discard pulp; invert tomatoes onto paper towels to drain.
In a small bowl, combine cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth; stir in the cucumber, onion and dill. Spoon into tomatoes. Refrigerate until serving.

title: CUISINART CHOCOLATE MOUSSE
ingredients: separated, plus 3 egg whites, at room
instructions: Place the chocolate in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade and pulse to chop the chocolate very fine.

In a small saucepan, combine the espresso, grand marnier and 1 tablespoon of the cream and bring to a boil.  Remove from heat.  Turn kon the food processor and add the hot liquid with the processor running.  Process until the chocolate has melted.  Stop the processor and scrape down the sides.  Continue to process until smooth.  Add the egg yolk and process until blended.  Scrape into a laarge bowl.

In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment beat the egg whites on medium speed.  When they foam, add the cream of tartar and continue to beat on medium speed while you slowly stream in the sugar.  Beat until the egg whites form medium peaks.  Fold into the chocolate base, in two additions.
Beat the remaining cream untilit forms soft peaks.  Fold into the mousse.  Spoon into 6 (4 ounce ramekins) and refrigerate for 2 hours, or until set.  Serve with whipped cream.
Description: "LA TIMES"

title: Cumin-crusted Beef Steaks with Orange-olive Relish
ingredients: or chuck top blade steaks, cut 3/4 inch thick (about 1-1/2 pounds)
instructions: Grate 2 teaspoons orange peel from oranges; reserve oranges. Combine orange peel, cumin and salt in small bowl; remove and reserve 2 teaspoons seasoning for relish.
Heat ridged grill pan or large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot. Add pepper to remaining seasoning; press evenly onto beef steaks.
Place steaks in grill pan; cook chuck eye steaks 9 to 11 minutes (top blade steaks 10 to 12 minutes) for medium rare to medium doneness, turning once.
Meanwhile peel and dice enough reserved oranges to measure 1 ½ cups. Combine diced oranges, red peppers, olives, onion and reserved 2 teaspoons seasoning in medium bowl; mix well.
Serve steaks with relish. Garnish with orange slices and olives.

title: Custard
ingredients: Beat eggs slightly, add sugar and salt, pour slowly into milk. Pour in custard cups and set in pan of hot water. Sprinkle with nutmeg. Bake 1 hour at 325.

title: CUSTARD GELATO
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the milk and salt.  Heat the milk over medium heat until bubbles form around the edges of the pan.  Set aside and cover to keep hot.

Blend the sugar and egg yolks together in a mixer until very thick and smooth.  Add a little hot milk and whisk.  Gradually add the rest of the milk and return to the saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon for 6 to 8 minutes, or until mixture thickens slightly and coast the back of the spoon.  Remove the pan from heat and set it in a bowl of ice water.  Stir for 2 minutes to cool the mixture.  Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours, or until thoroughly chilled.
In a deep bowl, beat the cream until soft peaks form.  Fold the whipped cream into the custard mixture.  Transfer to an ice cream maker and freeze according to the manuffacturer's instructions.

title: Dante's Chicken
ingredients: Combine ginger, curry powder, red pepper; rub spice mixture on chicken.  Set aside.  Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; place over medium-high heat until hot.  Add garlic, shallots, celery, and red pepper, saute 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Remove from skillet.  Place chicken in skillet; cook until lightly browned, turning once.  Return vegetables to skillet.  Combine broth, wine and ginger; stir well. Pour over chicken.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes.  Arrange chicken and vegetables on a platter; garnish with celery leaves if desired.

title: Dark Chocolate Cupcakes with Choocolate Chambord
instructions: Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position; heat oven to 350 degrees. Line standard-sized muffin pan (cups have 1/2-cup capacity) with baking-cup liners. 2. Combine butter, chocolate, and cocoa in medium heatproof bowl. Set bowl over saucepan containing barely simmering water; heat mixture until butter and chocolate are melted and whisk until smooth and combined. Set aside to cool until just warm to the touch. 3. Whisk flour, baking soda, and baking powder in small bowl to combine. 4. Whisk eggs in second medium bowl to combine; add sugar, vanilla, and salt and whisk until fully incorporated. Add cooled chocolate mixture and whisk until combined. Sift about one-third of flour mixture over chocolate mixture and whisk until combined; whisk in sour cream until combined, then sift remaining flour mixture over and whisk until batter is homogenous and thick. 5. Divide batter evenly among muffin pan cups. Bake until skewer inserted into center of cupcakes comes out clean, 18 to 20 minutes. 6. Cool cupcakes in muffin pan on wire rack until cool enough to handle, about 15 minutes. Carefully lift each cupcake from muffin pan and set on wire rack. Cool to room temperature before icing, about 30 minutes. (To frost: Mound about 2 tablespoons icing on center of each cupcake. Using small icing spatula or butter knife, spread icing to edge of cupcake, leaving slight mound in center).
Chocolate Chambord Ganache Frosting Makes 6cups
Ingredients 1.5 lbs of bittersweet chocolate (61% cacao) 3 cups heavy cream pint heavy whipping cream 16 tablespoons unsalted butter ¼ cup of Chambord (or your favorite liqueur)

Instructions 1. In a food processor, process the chocolate until very fine. 2. In a medium saucepan over medium heat bring cream to a soft boil (look for small bubbles to form at the edge of saucepan. 3. With the motor on pour the cream through the feed tube. Process for approximately 10 seconds or until smooth. Pulse in the butter. With the motor running add the Irish whiskey. 4. Press the ganache through a strainer and let stand for 1hour. Cover with plastic wrap and allow the mixture to cool for several hours until it reaches frosting consistency.

title: Dark Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Place chocolate in a large bowl set over a bain marie or in a double boiler at a low simmer. Stir chocolate until melted. Turn off the heat and let stand.
Beat the cream over ice until it forms soft peaks. Set aside and hold at room temperature. With a mixer, whip egg to soft peaks. Gradually add the sugar and continue whipping until firm.

Remove the chocolate from the bain marie and using a whisk, fold in the egg whites all at once. When the whites are almost completely incorporated, fold in the whipped cream. Cover the mousse and refrigerate for approximately 1 hour or until set. Serve in goblets topped with more whipped cream and shaved chocolate, if desired.

title: Date Nut Bars I
ingredients: Mix dry ingredients. Stir dates and nuts into dry ingredients. Beat eggs and pour in melted shortening into them. Combine with other mixture and bake 30 minutes at 350. Cut in bars and roll in powder sugar while still warm. Bake in 8" x 8" square pan.

title: Date Nut Bars II
ingredients: Mix as given and spread in greased flour pan. Bake 15-20 minutes, 350. Cut in finger shape pieces, let set a minute.

title: DECADENT ANGEL HAIR PASTA ALFREDO W/LUM CRABMEAT & WHITE TRUFFLE
instructions: Bring a large heavy pot of salted water to a boil.  Add the pasta and cook, stirring to separate the strands of pasta, until just barely al dente.  Drain in a colander.

Combine the cream, basil, garlic, salt and white pepper in the same pot.  Brin to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, or until slightly thickened.  Add the pasta, toss to coat, and simmer for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add the crabmeat and truffle oil, stir gently so as to not break up the crab and cook for 1 minute.  Add the cheese and stir gently to blend.
Divide the pasta among six pasta bowls.  Drizzle 1 teaspoon of truffly oil over each serving and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of Parmesan cheese.  Garnish with chopped chives.  Serve immediately.
Description: "EMERIL LAGASSE"

title: Decadent Doughnuts with White and Chocolate Glaze
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, pour the oil to a depth of 2 inches; heat to 360 degrees F.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sour cream, milk, and eggs. Add to the flour mixture, stirring to combine.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface. Roll to 3/4-inch thickness. Using a 3-inch round cutter, cut out the doughnuts. Using a 1-inch round cutter, cut out the center of each doughnut.
Fry the doughnuts, in batches, for 1 minute per side. Drain on paper towels.

In a small bowl, combine the white chocolate and 2 tablespoons heavy cream. Microwave on High in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until the chocolate is melted and smooth (about 1 minute total). Drizzle over the doughnuts.

In a small bowl, combine the bittersweet chocolate and remaining 2 tablespoons heavy cream. Microwave on High in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until the chocolate is melted and smooth (about 1 minute total). Drizzle over the doughnuts.

title: Decadent's Delight
instructions: Beat the egg yolks and sugar with mixer until they are thick and light colored. Transfer mixture to a small bowl. Grate the zest and chocolate. Add hot butter to chocolate. Add yolk mixture and 1 T of orange liqueur. Beat egg whites and salt until stiff peaks form. Fold whites into chocolate mixture. Pour 1/2 mixture into buttered 10" springform pan. Bake for 28 minutes in 350 oven. Let cool twenty minutes.

Beat 1 C whipping cream, and add 2 tsp. orange liqueur and 2 T powdered sugar. Fold gently into remaining chocolate mixture. Spread over baked shell, freeze. Thaw 2-3 hours before serving. Whip remaining cream, serve on top.

title: DECORATIVE ICING
ingredients: Combine all ingredients in large mixer bowl.  Beat at medium speed until smooth.  Increase speed to high and beat 5 minutes until thick and smooth.  Store in tithtly covered containers up to 3 days.  Makes 2 3/4 cups.  Substitute 3 T. meringue powder and 6 tbl. cold water for the egg whites and cream of tartar.

title: Decorator's Buttercream
instructions: Sift the confectioners sugar and salt together in a large bowl.

In another large bowl, cream the butter with an electric mixer on high until light yellow and slightly thickened, about 3 minutes.  With the mixer still running, beat in the corn syrup and vanilla.  Reduce the mixer to low and beat in the sugar in two additions, beating well after each.  Blend in 1/4 cup of the cream all at once until the frosting is spreading consistency, adding a little more cream if needed.

Return the mixer speed to high and whip until light and creamy, about 3 minutes more.  if you want different colors of frosting, divide into three or four small bowls.  To tint the frosting, add a small amount of color at frist and blend it in completely before adding more.
(Work fast! If the icing gets a little too soft during piping, place the bag in the refrigerator for just a few minutes.  Watch it carefully and remove before it firms up too much.)

title: Deep Dark Chocolate Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350. Grease and flour two round cake pans or one 9 x 13. In large bowl combine dry ingredients.  Add egg, milk, oil and vanilla. Beat on medium speed 2 minutes with mixer.  Stir in boiling water (batter will be thin). Pour into prepared pans. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes for round pans, 35-40 minutes for 9 x 13 or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool cake 10 minutes, Remove round ones from pan. Cool completely. Frost.
FROSTING In small mixer bowl, cream butter.  Add cocoa and powdered sugar alternately with milk; beat to spreading consistency. Additional milk may be needed. Blend in vanilla.

title: Deep Dish Brownies
ingredients: Reese's Peanut butter chips or Semi-Sweet chocolate chips

Heat oven to 350.  Grease square 8x8x2 pan. In medium mixing bowl, blend melted butter, sugar and vanilla.  Add eggs; beat well with spoon.  Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder and salt; gradually add to egg mixture, beating until well blended. Stir in chips. Spread into prepared pan. Bake 40 to 45 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan.  Cool completely; cut into squares.

title: DEEP-DISH BRIOCHE FRENCH TOAST
instructions: Generously butter a 9 x 13 inch baking dish.  Place half the bread cubes in a single layer, filling in all the gaps.  Evenly scatter the cream cheese cubes, nuts and raisins on top.  Cover with the remaining bread cubes and pack down.

In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, brown sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves.  Pour the egg mixture over the bread cubes.  Using your palms, gently press down to allow the top layer of bread to absorb the liquid.  Cover the baking dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.

Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Remove the dish from the refrigerator and let it sit for 20 minutes at room temperature.  Bake the french toast, uncovered, for 30 minutes.  Remove from the oven, drizzle with melted butter, return to the oven and bake until the cubes are nicely toasted and all the liquid is absorbed, about 5 to 10 minutes.  Remove to a rack and run a knife around the rim of the pan to release the French toast.  Cut into squares, arrange on individual plates and sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Serve with the maple syrup.
Description: "LA TIMES MAGAZINE"

title: Delilah's 7 Cheese Mac and Cheese
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F. Bring a large saucepan of salted water to a boil. Add the macaroni and cook until slightly al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain and set aside to keep warm.
Whisk the eggs in a large bowl until frothy.

Add the Velveeta, butter and 2 cups of the half-and-half to the large bowl of eggs. Add the warm macaroni tossing until the cheese has melted and the mixture is smooth. Add the remaining half-and-half, 3 cups of the sharp yellow Cheddar, the remaining grated cheeses, and salt and pepper, tossing until completely combined in the large bowl.

Pour the mixture into 9 by 13-inch casserole or baking dishes (approximately 3 (3-quart) baking dishes) and bake for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 cup of sharp yellow cheese and bake until golden brown on top, about 30 minutes more.
Serve hot.

title: DESSERT BUTTERMILK BISCUITS
ingredients: Preheat oven to 375.  Sift flour, sugar, baking powder and salt into large bowl.  Add butter and rub in with fingertips until mixture resembles coarse meal.  Gradually add buttermilk, tossing with fork until large moist clumps form.  Gather dough into ball.  Divide into 4 pieces.  Shape each piece into 3 inch round.  Transfer to baking sheet, spacing evenly.  Bake biscuits until tester inserted into center comes out dry, about 20 minutes.  (Biscuits will be pale)  Transfer biscuits to rack and cool to lukewarm.

title: Dessert Cake
ingredients: rectangle kind, sliced in 4 slices lengthwise

Soften cheese and whip lightly then add whipped cream add sugar and whip until thick. Spread between layers and cover with cherry pie filling, (takes a fairly deep pan). Should be refrigerated overnight or at least several hours before serving.

title: Dessert Jello
ingredients: Mix jellos and prepare as usual. Add bananas and pineapple. Use liquid (1/2 C) from pineapple with sugar, cornstarch and vanilla. Cook until thickened. Cool. Add cooled mixture to dream whip fold in and spread on jello mixture. Top with nuts.

title: Devil's Food Cake I
instructions: COCOA MIXTURE Combine sugar and cocoa. Add well-beaten egg. Add milk. Cook in double boiler until thick and smooth. Cool.

CAKE Cream shortening and sugar. Add well-beaten eggs. Beat thoroughly. Sift flour, measure and sift with baking soda and salt. Add alternately with milk to creamed shortening and sugar. Add flavoring. Add cocoa mixture which has been well cooled. Beat thoroughly. Pour into well-oiled layer cake pans. Bake in moderate oven (375) about 20 minutes. Use fudge icing.

title: Devil's Food Cake II
ingredients: Cream sugar and shortening. Add beaten eggs. Mix flour, cocoa, salt, and soda. Add sour cream and boiling water. Bake at 300 for 1 hour.

title: DEVIL'S FOOD CAKE*
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit inside a round cake pan and place inside.  Grease the bottome and sides of the pan with butter.  Dust with flour and tap out any excess.  Set aside.

Combine the cocoa and the warm water in a medium sized bowl, whisk until smooth.  In another medium sized bowl whisk the buttermilk, water and vanilla, set aside.  Add the softened butter to the bowl of a standard mixer.  Add the white sugar and the light brown sugar, beat with the paddle until very light in color and texture, about 3 minutes.

Scrape the sides of the bowl with a spatula.  Break eggs into a small bowl.  On low speed , add 1 egg at a time to the bowl.  Add the additional eggs only after each is combined.  Scrape the bowl with a spatula.  Raise the speed to medium, beat 1 minute until light and fluffy.  Add the cocoa mixture, beat on low speed until just combined.  Add the flour mixture and the buttermilk mixture alternately. 3 additions of flour, 2 additions of buttermilk.  Remember to scrape the sides of the bowl with a spatula after each addition.  The batter will be smooth.  Gently fold in the grated chocolate.  Pour the batter into the prepared pan.  Bake in the center of the oven until done, about 35 minutes.  Do not over bake.  Cool.  Turn the cake over onto your work surface.  Peel off the parchment paper.  Cut the cake in half horizontally with a serrated.  Fill the cake with chocolate cream filling.  top with glaze.

Cream filling:  Warm the heavy cream in a heavy stainless pot.  Add the chopped chocolate and butter.  Stir over low heat until the chocolate is almost melted.  Take off the heat, and stir until smooth.  Cool, then refrigerate until cold.  Whip until light and fluffy.  Place the bottom layer on a plate.  Top with cream filling.  Place the other cake layer on top.  Press down gently with your hands.  Finish the cake with the glaze.

Warm the heavy cream, in a heavy stainless pot until warm.  Add the chopped chocolate and the butter.  Stir over low heat until the chocolate is almost melted.  Take off the heat and stir until smooth.  Cool slightly.  Whisk and pour over the filled cake when it has slightly thickened.  Smooth with a spatula.  For a perfect finish, refrigerate the cake with one coat of glaze on top.  When cold and set, add another portion of glaze and smooth nicely with a spatula.  Make sure that the second coat of glaze has not hardened.  If so, reheat only for a few seconds to the desired consistency.
Description: "FOOD TV"

title: Deviled Eggs
ingredients: cider vinegar (or vinegar of your choice)
Table salt and ground black pepper
instructions: Place eggs in medium saucepan, cover with 1 inch of water, and bring to boil over high heat. Remove pan from heat, cover, and let stand 10 minutes. Meanwhile, fill medium bowl with 1 quart cold water and about 14 ice cubes (one tray). Transfer eggs to ice water with slotted spoon; let sit 5 minutes.

Peel eggs and slice each in half lengthwise with paring knife. Remove yolks to small bowl. Arrange whites on serving platter, discarding two worst-looking halves. Mash yolks with fork until no large lumps remain. Add mustard, mayonnaise, vinegar, Worcestershire, and salt and pepper to taste; mix with rubber spatula, mashing mixture against side of bowl until smooth.

Fit pastry bag with large open-star tip. Fill bag with yolk mixture, twisting top of pastry bag to help push mixture toward tip of bag. Pipe yolk mixture into egg white halves, mounding filling about 1/2 inch above flat surface of whites. Serve at room temperature.

title: Deviled Ham - Cream Cheese Spread
ingredients: Soften cream cheese with cream. Blend with remaining ingredients. Serve with crackers.

title: DILL SAUCE
ingredients: Melt butter in heavy saucepan over medium-low heat.  Add flour; stir 3 minutes.  (Do not brown).  Gradually whisk in 2 cups milk and broth.  Bring to simmer, whisking constantly.  Simmer until mixture is thick and smooth, whisking often, about 8 minutes.  Whisk in cream and mustard.  Bring to simmer.  Season with salt and pepper.

title: Dill Sauce
ingredients: Beat egg till fluffy and lemon colored.  Add rest of ingredients.  Blend and chill.

title: DILLED CHEDDAR CHEESE BATTER BREAD
ingredients: Bring first 3 ingredients to simmer in small saucepan; cool to 120 F.  Whisk in oil and eggs.  Combine 1 1/4 cups flour, yeast, salt and 2 cups cheese in large bowl of electric mixer.  Add warm liquid mixture and fresh dill; beat 3 minutes.  Add remaining 1 1/4 cups flour; beat 2 minutes.  Scrape down sides of bowl.  Cover bowl with plastic wrap.  Let dough rise in warm draft-free area until doubled, about 1 hour, 15 minutes.  Preheat oven to 350.  Butter 9x5x3 inch loaf pan.  Do not stir batter down.  Spoon half of batter into pan; sprinkle on remaining 1 1/2 cups cheese.  Cover with remaining batter; smooth top.  Cover and let rise in warm draft-free area until batter reaches top of pan about 30 minutes.   Bake until bread is golden brown and sound hollow when tapped, about 45 minutes.  Turn out onto rack and cool.

title: Dilly Dip
ingredients: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate for at least an hour (the longer the better). Serve with crisp vegetables: carrot and celery sticks, cherry tomatoes, mushrooms, cucumber sticks, radishes, etc.

title: Dinah Shore's Cioppino
ingredients: Heat the oil and butter in a kettle and add the onion, leek, and garlic. Cook, stirring often, until the vegetables are lightly browned. Add the green peppers and continue cooking, stirring, until peppers wilt. Add the tomatoes and tomato sauce. Add salt and pepper to taste, bay leaf, oregano, thyme, basil, and about 1/4 ts red pepper flakes. Add the stock and water and cook slowly about 2 hours, stirring often to prevent burning. More stock may be added if desired. Add the clam juice and wine and continue cooking about 10 minutes. The soup may be made in advance to this point. Twenty minutes or so before serving, return the soup to the boil and add the fish. Cook about 5 minutes and add the ]shrimp. Simmer about 8 minutes and add the clams and crab. Cook, stirring gently, about 5 minutes or until the clams open. Serve in very hot soup bowls with red pepper flakes on the side.

title: Dinner Rolls
ingredients: packets (1/4 ounce each) active dry yeast
melted, plus more for bowl and pans
to 6 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (spooned and leveled)

Place water in a small bowl; sprinkle with yeast, and let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes. In a large bowl, whisk together milk, butter, sugar, salt, and 2 eggs. Whisk in yeast mixture. Using a wooden spoon, stir in 6 cups flour, 1 cup at a time, until you have a soft, shaggy dough (if necessary, add up to 1/2 cup more flour). Turn dough out onto a floured work surface; knead until smooth and elastic, 5 to 10 minutes. Butter the inside of a large bowl; place dough in bowl, turning to coat. Cover bowl with plastic wrap; let stand in a warm spot until dough has doubled in size, about 1 1/4 hours. Butter two 13-by-9-inch baking pans. Divide dough in half. Roll each half into a 15-inch rope; cut each rope into 15 1-inch pieces. Press each piece into a disk, then shape into a ball. Arrange dough balls in prepared pans. (To make ahead: Wrap pans well, and freeze, up to 2 months.) Cover pans loosely with plastic; let stand in a warm spot until rolls have doubled in size, about 1 1/4 hours (2 hours more if frozen). Preheat oven to 375 degrees, with racks in upper and lower thirds. In a small bowl, beat remaining egg until blended; brush onto rolls. Bake until golden brown, about 20 minutes, rotating pans back to front and top to bottom halfway through. Let rolls cool 15 minutes before serving.

title: DIPPED STRAWBERRIES
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine cream and butter.  Bring mixture to a simmer, stirring constantly.  Remove pan from heat.  Add chocolate chips.  Stir until melted and smooth.  Cool slightly.  Transfer to a fondue pot.
Serve immediately with sliced apples, sliced bananas, strawberries, cookies, pretzels, and pound cake.
Description: "FOOD TV"

title: Dipping Sauce for crostini
ingredients: Put ingredients in small food processor.  Process into a fine paste.

title: Dirt Cake
ingredients: chocolate sandwich cookies or choco-mint cookies

Crush cookies and put half of the crumbs in a 9 x 13 pan. Mix cream cheese and butter until smooth with a mixer.  Fold in powdered sugar and then the whipped topping.  In a separate bowl, mix pudding, milk and vanilla.  Fold cream cheese mixture and pudding mixture together and pour into pan with the cookie crumbs.  Sprinkle remaining crumbs over the top.  Whipped cream may be used instead of the whipped topping if a richer dessert is desired. This may be frozen or nice just chilled.

title: Dirt Pie
instructions: ROCKS-  use granola chunks, chocolate chips, peanut butter chips, chopped peanuts or combination.

Pour milk into medium bowl.  Add pudding mix. Beat with wire whisk until well blended, 1 to 2 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Fold in whipped topping. Stir 1 cup of the cookies and the ROCKS into pudding mixture. Spoon into pie crust. Sprinkle with remaining cookies. Freeze until firm, about 4 hours. Garnish  with gumdrops flowers, if desired.

title: DONNA'S SWEDISH PANCAKES
ingredients: Beat eggs.  Add milk.  Mix in flour, sugar and salt.  Let sit for 20 minutes.  Cook in special swedish pancake pan.

title: Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: Combine flour, and baking soda and set aside.  Cream butter with electric mixer.  Add vanilla and sugars and beat until fluffy.  Beat in egg. At low speed beat in cocoa, then milk. With wooden spoon, mix flour and baking soda mixture just until blended. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips. Drop by rounded tsp. onto nonstick or foil-line baking sheets. Bake at 350 12-13 minutes. Remove from oven and cool slightly before removing from baking sheets.

title: Double Dark Decandent Brownie
ingredients: Grease and flour 9-inch layer cake pan. In large saucepan bring corn syrup and butter to a boil, stirring occasionally; remove from heat.  Add chocolate; stir until melted.  Add sugar, stir in eggs, one at a time, then vanilla, flour and nuts.  Pour into pan.  Bake in 350 oven 30 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Remove; cool completely on rack. GLAZE: in small saucepan melt chocolate with butter over low heat, stirring often. Remove from heat. Stir in corn syrup and milk. Pour glaze on top and spread on sides. Let stand 1 hour.

title: DOUBLE DIP CHOCOLATE SLICES
instructions: Combine sugar and butter in large mixer bowl.  Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often, until creamy (1 to 2 minutes).  Add egg, milk and 1/2 teaspoon peppermint extract; continue beating until well mixed.  Add 3 ounces melted chocolate; continue beating until well mixed.  Reduce speed to low.  Add flour, baking powder and salt; beat until well mixed.
Divide dough in half; shape each half into 8 x 2-inch long roll.  Wrap each roll in waxed paper or plastic wrap.  Refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.

Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Cut rolls into 1/4 inch slices with sharp knife.  Place 1 inch apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake for 12 minutes or until set.  Cool 1 minute; remove from cookie sheets.  Cool completely.

Melt white candy coating or chips and 1 tbsp. shortening in 1-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionallty, until smooth (8 to 12 minutes).  Remove from heat.  Stir in peppermint extract and food color.  Tipping saucepan slightly, dip cookies halfway into melted coating.  Lightly shake off excess coating.  Place on waxed paper.  Let stand until coating is firm (at least 20 minutes).

Melt 10 ounces semi-sweet baking chocolate and remaining shortening in 1-quart saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally, until smooth (6 to 8 minutes).  Remove from heat.  Tipping saucepan slightly, dip cookies into melted chocolate, overlapping half of green coating.  Lightly shake off excess chocolate.  Place on waxed paper for at least 2 hours.  Store in single layer between sheets of waxed paper in container.  Can be put in freezer for up to 1 month.
Source: "Land O Lakes Recipe Collection"

title: Double Lemon Bars
instructions: Heat oven to 350&degF. Combine all crust ingredients in small bowl. Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often, until well mixed. Press into greased 8 or 9-inch square baking pan. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.

Meanwhile, combine all filling ingredients in same bowl. Beat at medium speed until well mixed. Pour filling over hot, partially baked crust. Continue baking for 17 to 20 minutes or until top is light golden brown. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Cool completely. Cut into bars. .

TIP: For easy cutting, line pan with aluminum foil, leaving 1-inch overhang on ends. Lightly grease foil. Bake as directed above. Lift out foil and bars from pan; peel foil from sides of bars. Cut into bars.

title: DOUBLE-BAKED POTATOES WITH MUSHROOMS AND CHEESE*
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Pierce each potato in several places with fork.  Place all potatoes  directly on oven rack and bake until tender, about 1 hour.

Meanwhile, melt 1 tablespoon butter in heavy large skillet over medium heat.  Add mushrooms; saute until beginning to brown, stirring frequently, about 7 minutes.  Add green onions; stir until wilted, about 1 minute.  Set aside.

Using oven mitts as aid, cut each potato lengthwise in half.  Scoop cooked potato flesh iinto large bowl, leaving skin intact.  Add cream cheese, sour cream and remaining 4 tablespoons butter and mash well.  Mix in mushroom mixture and 1/2 cup cheddar cheese.  Season to taste with salt and pepper.  Mound mashed potatoes in potato skins.  Sprinkle each half with 1 tablespoon cheese.  Place on baking sheet.  (Can be made 1 day ahead.  Cover and refrigerate.)
Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Bake potatoes until heated through and cheese melts, about 25 minutes, or 35 minutes if potatoes have been refrigerated.
Description: "BON APPETIT"

title: DOUBLED BAKED ZITI CASSEROLE WITH MEAT
instructions: In a large pot, saute onion and garlic  in oil until golden brown (Don't burn it).  Add ground meat and brown.  Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, 3 cups water,   parsley, salt, sugar, basil, oregano and pepper.  Mix well and simmer, covered for one hour, stirring occasionally.

Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Cook box of pasta following directions. To make cheese layer,  In a large bowl, combine ricotta, mozzarella, 1/3 cup parmesan, eggs, parsley, salt and pepper.  Beat with wooden spoon until blended.

Spoon some sauce into casserole dish.  Place a third of the pasta as the bottom layer, then the cheese mixture, then the remaining sauce.  Sprinkle sauce with 1 tablespoon Parmesan.  Repeat again twice.
Bake uncovered 45-50 minutes, or until center bubbles.

(I would prep everything and split the sauce and cheese mixture in two parts, but I would only cook 1 lb. of ziti at a time and put together one casserole at a time.  After it is all prepared, put plastic wrap over the top of the dish and then a double layer of foil and freeze.  You need to put your dish in the refrigerator two days before you are going to cook it.  Also, it might take longer than 50 minutes.  Give yourself plenty of time.)
Description: "RECIPE COTTAGE"

title: Down Home Macaroni and Cheese
ingredients: Melt 3 tablespoons of the butter in large saucepan on low heat. Blend in flour and salt; cook and stir 1 minute. Gradually add milk; cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Add prepared cheese product and 1-1/2 cups of the shredded cheese; stir until melted. Stir in macaroni. Pour into lightly greased 1-1/2-quart casserole. Melt remaining 1 Tablespoon butter; toss with bread crumbs. Sprinkle casserole with remaining 1/2 cup cheese and bread crumb mixture. Bake at 350 degrees F for 20 minutes or until thoroughly heated.

title: DRESSING FOR TURKEY*
instructions: Melt butter in skillet.  Add onion and celery.  Saute until soft.  Add to toast cubes.  Mix egg in 1 cup water and mix.  Mix into rest of ingredients.  (Add seasonings gradually to taste.  Also, you may want up to a cup more water.  It is a matter of feel and taste.)  This is enough for a 20 pound turkey.
Put  20 pound turkey in at 11:15 for 4:30 dinner.

Gravy:  Pour off 1/4 c. fat and discard the rest of the fat.  Pour the fat into the pan and heat.  Add 1/5 cup of flour and stir until smooth.  Slowly stir in  4 cups of chicken broth.  Bring to a boil and then simmer stirring until thickened.  (Heat 1 jar of turkey gravy base and  1  1/2 cups of millk in a saucepan until simmering.)  Add turkey gravy base mixture and stir and simmer until ready to use.

title: Drunken Shrimp*
ingredients: salt and fresh pepper to taste

Heat olive oil and butter in a skillet. Add garlic, pepper flakes, and sauté 2-3 minutes. Add wine, clam juice, lemon juice, anchovy paste, parsley, salt and pepper, and stir. Cook for another 2-3 minutes. Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes. Do not overcook the shrimp or it will become tough and chewy. Serve shrimp with liquid in bowl with crusty bread on the side to soak up the juice. 4 servings 1 serving = 4.75 pts

title: DRY RUB
ingredients: Combine all ingredients thoroughly and store in an airtight jar or container.  Can be used with beef, pork, ribs, etc.

title: DUCHESS POTATOES
ingredients: melted butter to drizzle over potatoes
instructions: Bake the potatoes in a preheated oven at 400 degrees for 1 hour, or until they are tender.

Halve the potatoes lengthwise, scrape the flesh into a bowl, and press them through a ricer into a large bowl.  With an electric mixer beat in the butter, 1 tablespoon at a time, the eggs, 1 at a time, and the milk and beat the mixture until it is combined well and smooth.  Add 1/3 cup of Parmesan.  Add the nutmeg, pepper, and salt to taste and transfer the mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a large tip.

Pipe the mixture into 6 rosettes onto a buttered baking sheet and drizzle them with the melted butter and remaining cheese.  (The rosettes may be chilled, covered loosely, for several hours or overnight).

Bake the potatoes in a preheated 350 degree oven for 10 to 15 minutes for potatoes at room temperature or 10 to 15 minutes for chilled potatoes or until they are heated through.  Then put under a broiler about 6 inches from the heat, and broil the potatoes until the tops are brown.
Description: "FOOD TV"

title: DUTCH APPLE PANCAKE
ingredients: Preheat oven to 400 degrees and butter a 10" ovenproof braiser.  In another fry pan melt 2 T. of the butter.  Add apple slices, cinnamon and sugar and saute, stirring occasionally, until apples begin to soften and brown 5-6 minutes.  Set aside in a bowl.  Beat eggs with a whisk.  Add milk and beat mixture until blended.  Sift flour and salt into egg mixture and beat just until blended.  Melt remaining 2 T. butter, add to flour-egg mixture and beat until smooth.  Pour batter into prepared pan and arrange apples evenly over batter.  Bake until pancake is browned and puffed up, 25-30 min.  Dust with confectioner's sugar and serve immediately.

title: Dutch Babies
instructions: In blender combine whipping cream, flour and salt. Blend until smooth.  Add eggs and blend until all ingredients are evenly combined.  Butter four 8-inch round bake pans very heavily dusted with flour.  Arrange 1/4 cup ham in the bottom of each pan and divide the batter evenly between the pans.  Bake at 450 for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown around the edges. Serve with Spiced Apple Topping, powdered sugar and lemon wedge.

SPICED APPLE TOPPING Peel, core and thinly slice apples.  Melt butter in a large frying pan on medium heat and add apples.  Turn with spatula until apples are translucent.  Add sugar and cinnamon; mix well. Serve hot over Dutch Babies.

title: Easiest Pasta and Broccoli Recipe
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. When water boils, add pasta and broccoli at the same time and cook according to pasta instructions for al dente. When pasta is almost done cooking, reserve about 1 cup of the pasta water and set aside. Drain pasta and broccoli.
Return the pot to the stove and set heat to high; add 1 tbsp olive oil, when hot, add garlic. Cook until golden, reduce flame to low and add pasta back to the pot.
Mix well, add remaining olive oil, grated cheese, salt and pepper to taste mixing well and smashing any large pieces of broccoli to break up.
Add 1/2 cup of reserved pasta water and mix well adding more if needed.
Serve in pasta bowls with additional grated cheese on the side.

title: Easter Chocolate Dessert
ingredients: Layer in each serving dish: brownie bites, fudge sauce, chocolate chips, chocolate truffle. Repeat layers. Top with green pastry cream and chocolate eggs.

title: Easy Asiago-Olive Rolls
ingredients: (13.8-oz.) can refrigerated classic pizza crust dough

Preheat oven to 450°. Unroll pizza crust dough. Spread olive tapenade over dough, leaving a 1/4-inch border. Sprinkle with cheese and rosemary. Gently roll up dough, starting at 1 long side. Cut into 10 (1 1/4-inch-thick) slices. Place slices in a lightly greased 9-inch round cake pan. Brush top of dough with melted butter. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden. Serve immediately.

title: EASY BACON STRATA*
instructions: Cook bacon.  Drain and crumble.

Layer bread cubes, bacon and cheese in a lightly greased 7 x 11 inch casserole dish.  In a large bowl, beat together eggs, milk, salt and mustard.  Pour into casserold on top of other ingredients.  Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight.
Remove casserole from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking.  Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Bake in oven for 50 to 60 minutes, or until a knife inserted into center comes out clean.  Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing.
Description: "ALL RECIPES"

title: Easy Broccoli Bake
ingredients: cut up or 1 pkg. frozen broccoli cuts, cooked and drained

In 1 1/2 quart shallow casserole, combine soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper. Stir in broccoli and 1/2 can of the onions. Bake for 25 minutes or until hot; stir. Top with remaining onions; bake 5 minutes.

title: Easy Brownie Pizza
ingredients: Grease and flour 12x1/2 inch pizza pan or two 9-inch layer cake pans.  In 3-quart saucepan bring corn syrup and cream to boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.  Add chocolate, stir until melted. Set aside 2/3 cup of the chocolate sauce. Add butter and sugar to remaining sauce; stir until butter melts. Remove from heat.  Stir in eggs and vanilla. Gradually stir in flour, salt and nuts. Pour into pan.  Bake in 350 oven 20 min. or until firm; cool on rack. (cool layers in pans 10 min. remove and cool on racks.)  Top with ice cream, fruit nuts and chocolate sauce.

title: EASY CAESAR SALAD*
instructions: Blend ancovy fillets, garlic, olive oil, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, and hot pepper sauce in processor until smooth.  Transfer to small bowl.  Whisk in mayonnaise, 2 tablespoons cheese, and 2 tablespoons lemon juice.
Season with salt and more lemon juice, if desired.
Place romaine in large bowl.  Add 1/4 cup dressing, toss to coat.  Sprinkle with croutons and remaining 1/4 cup cheese and pepper.  Serve, passing remaining dressing separately.
Description: "bON APPETIT"

title: Easy Chicken
instructions: Place chicken in Bean pot. Cover with cream soups. Sprinkle onion soup mix on top.
Bake 6 – 8 hrs at 250 degrees.
Cook 2 cups of instant rice or noodles & serve with your favorite veggies.

title: Easy Chicken & Noodles
ingredients: boneless and skinless cut in 1 inch pieces
instructions: Place cut up chicken in bean pot, add chicken broth, water, soup and garlic; stir.
Cook at 200 degrees for 4 ½ to 5 hours or 350 degrees for 2 ½ to 3 hours.
Add noodles last 30 to 45 minutes, stir, return to oven and cook until noodles are tender.

title: Easy Chicken Curry
ingredients: Saute onions and mushrooms in butter. Flour chicken which has been cut into bite size pieces and saute with onions and mushrooms. Add canned milk and broth, stirring constantly, to keep gravy smooth. Add salt and pepper and curry powder and sage. Cook over medium heat with cover on for about 1 hour or until chicken is tender. Serve over mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Easy Chocolate Ice Cream Recipe
instructions: In a small bowl, combine coffee powder and hot water. Let stand until coffee dissolves, about 5 minutes.

In a bowl, microwave chocolate, sweetened condensed milk, and the coffee mixture, stirring every 10 seconds, until chocolate is melted, approximately 1 minutes. Stir in vanilla extract and salt; let cool.

With an electric mixer on medium-high speed, whip cream to soft peaks, about 2 minutes. Whisk 1/4 of the whipped cream into the cooled chocolate mixture. Fold the remaining whipped cream into the chocolate mixture until incorporated.
Freeze in an airtight container until firm, at least 6 hours or up to 2 weeks.
NOTE: If you plan to store the ice cream for more than a few days, place plastic wrap directly on its surface before freezing.
Makes 1 quart ice cream.

title: Easy Cinnamon Sugar Pecans
instructions: Preheat oven to 250 degrees
Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray or line with parchment paper.
Mix sugar, cinnamon and salt in a large ziploc bag
Whisk egg white, water and vanilla in a large bowl until frothy (you can use a fork or electric mixer, either works just fine)
Add pecans to large bowl and stir to combine, coating each pecan in egg white mixture
Pour coated pecans into ziploc bag, seal and shake to fully coat in cinnamon/sugar mixture
Spread out in a single layer onto prepared baking sheet
Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 20 minutes.

title: Easy Fried Rice*
instructions: Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray; warm pan over medium-high heat. Add eggs; tilt pan so that eggs cover bottom.
When eggs start to set, break them up into pieces with a heat-proof spatula or wooden spoon. Cook until eggs are cooked through, about 1 minute more; remove eggs from skillet and set aside.
Off heat, recoat same skillet with cooking spray; set over medium-high heat. Add carrots and all but 2 tablespoons scallions; sauté until carrots are crisp-tender, about 2 to 3 minutes.

Stir in cooked rice, peas and soy sauce; cook until heated through, stirring once or twice, about 1 minute. Gently stir in cooked egg and remaining scallions; heat through. Yields about 3/4 cups per serving. Notes   4 points per serving

title: Easy Fruit Pocket Pies
ingredients: soft whole grain white or wheat bread

Preheat oven to 350°F. Wash berries and spread to dry on paper towels. Meanwhile, stir together sugar and cinnamon; set aside. 2. For each pie, spoon 1 tablespoon of Smashed Apple Jam in the center of a bread slice. Top with 3 to 4 berries and another slice of bread. Gently press the top slice around the fruit. Trim crusts from bread using a serrated knife. 3. Using a fork, press the edges of the bread together to seal in the filling. Lightly brush the top slice of bread with some of the oil. Pick up each pie and, while holding in your hand, lightly brush the opposite side with oil. Place pies on an ungreased baking sheet. Sprinkle tops with cinnamon-sugar. 4. Bake pies for 18 to 20 minutes or until bread is lightly toasted and bottoms are browned. Transfer to a cooling rack. Cool at least 30 minutes before serving. Makes 6 servings. Teaching Notes: Select soft whole grain bread for these pies, and use the bread directly from the wrapper. The moistness of fresh bread works to seal the fruit inside. Teaching Notes: You will know when the pies are done when the bottoms are evenly toasted. To check for browning, use a spatula to lift the pies and peek at the undersides. Smashed Apple Jam Peel, core and slice 4 pounds apples. Place apples and 1/2 cup water in a 4 or 5-quart heavy-bottom pan over medium heat. Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, until very tender. Remove from heat. Mash apples with a potato masher or blend with an immersion blender. Return to heat and simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes until the jam thickens and most of the liquid has evaporated, stirring frequently. Transfer to a covered container. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

title: EASY LEMON CAKE DESSERT
ingredients: Mix the cake ingredients.  Put in a prepared 13 x 9 inch pan.  Bake in 350 degree oven for 40 minutes.  Glass pan, bake at 325 degrees.  Blend glaze ingredients, prick cake with fork while cake is still hot and pour glaze over cake.  Let cool before serving.

title: Easy Pat-in-the-pan Pie Dough
instructions: Lightly coat a 9-inch pie plate with vegetable oil spray.
Whisk flour, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl.

Beat butter and cream cheese with an electric mixer on medium speed until combined, about 2 minutes, scraping down sides of bowl as needed. Add flour mixture and beat on medium-low until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal, about 20 seconds. Scrape down sides of bowl and increase speed to medium-high until dough begins to form large clumps, about 30 seconds. Reserve 3 T of the dough and set aside.

Turn remaining dough out onto a lightly floured counter, gather into a ball, and flatten into a 6-inch disk. Transfer to pie plate and press the dough evenly over the bottom of the plate towards the sides, using the heel of your hand. With fingertips, work dough up the sides until evenly distributed.
Roll reserved 3 tablespoons into ropes, press onto edges of crust and form a fluted edge. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least one hour.
Preheat oven to 325 degrees and adjust oven rack to middle posiiton. Lightly prick the bottom of the crust with a fork. Bake until golden brown, 35 - 40 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack to cool.

title: Easy Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: Preheat oven to 375.  In large bowl, beat Eagle Brand Milk and peanut butter until smooth.  Add bisquick and vanilla, mix well.  Shape into 1-inch balls. Roll in sugar. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Flatten with fork. Bake 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned.  (Do not over bake).

title: Easy Pizza Dough
ingredients: plus more for oiling the bowl
instructions: Add the warm water into a small mixing bowl or a standard 2 cup measure, sprinkle the yeast over the warm water and let stand until the yeast softens, 3 to 5 minutes. Mix slightly to dissolve yeast and allow it to proof for another 15 minutes in a warm spot in the kitchen. Add the room temperature water and 1 tablespoon of the olive oil to the yeast mixture and stir to combine. Measure the flour and the salt into the bowl of a stand mixer. Combine on very low speed with the paddle attachment. Slowly add the liquid ingredients to the dry, and increase the speed of the mixer slightly to incorporate the mass. Stop the mixer and replace the paddle with a dough hook if you have one. Knead until the dough becomes smooth and begins to pull away from the sides of the bowl, about 4 minutes. Place the dough on a floured board and knead the dough by hand for another 1 to 2 minutes. Add flour to dust as needed to prevent sticking. Shape the dough into a ball and place in a very lightly oiled bowl and cover with a clean towel, let stand until dough doubles in size, about 1 hour.

When the dough has doubled in bulk, divide it into 6 equal pieces (about 6 ounces each). Set the pieces of dough being used on a sheet pan and cover with a clean towel or plastic wrap. (Dough not being used can be placed in the refrigerator or frozen until ready to use.) With a rolling pin on a lightly floured surface, roll each piece of dough as evenly as possible into a 10-inch circle, dusting lightly with flour, as necessary.
Cover with toppings and bake until golden brown, about 10 minutes

title: Easy Shepherd's Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350.
Cook onions with ground beef over medium heat till done.
In a separate pan make mashed potato according to box instructions.
Add  the can of vegetables to the ground beef mixture.
Place beef in baking dish. Distribute mashed potatoes on top. Rough up with a fork so that there are peaks that will brown nicely. You can use the fork to make some designs in the potatoes as well.
Cook in 350 degree oven until bubbling and brown (about 25 minutes). Broil for last few minutes if necessary to brown.

title: Easy Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: Dump chicken and marinade in bean pot at 350 for 3.5 hours
Bake potatoes and pour Teriyaki sauce over potatoes and chicken.

title: Eggnog Christmas Salad
ingredients: Soften unflavored gelatin in the undrained pineapple and the lime juice for 5 minutes.  Cook and stir over medium heat till gelatin dissolves. Cool to room temperature.  Stir in eggnog.  Chill till partially set. Fold in celery; turn into a 12x7x2 pan. Chill till almost firm.  Heat cranberry juice to boiling; stir in the raspberry gelatin till dissolved. Chill till partially set.  Fold in relish.  Carefully spoon atop eggnog mixture. Chill till firm. Cut into squares.

title: EGGNOG SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients: Heat oven to 400 degrees.  In large mixing bowl, combine all cookie ingredients. Beat at low speed, scraping bowl often, until well mixed, 2 or 4 minutes.  For sugar mixture, in small bowl, stir together sugar and nutmeg.  Shape rounded teaspoonfuls of dough into 1 inich balls; roll in sugar mixture.  Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake for 8-10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned.  Remove immediately.  Makes about 4 dozen cookies.

title: EGGNOG TEACAKES
instructions: Heat oven to 350 degrees.  Combine butter and 1 cup powdered sugar in large mixer bowl.  Beat at medium speed, scraping often, until creamy.  Add vanilla and rum extract.  Beat until well mixed.  Reduce speed to low.   Add flour, nutmeg and salt.  Beat until just combined.  Stir in pecans by hand.  Shape mixture into 1 inch balls.  Place 1 inch apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.  Bake for 13 to 16 minutes or until cookies are set.  Cool on wire rack.  While cookies are still warm, roll in powdered sugar.
Description: "LAURA"

title: Eggplant Casserole
ingredients: Combine eggplant, green pepper, onion, and salt.  Add tomatoes, reserving 3 T juice.  Simmer vegetables ten minutes.  Preheat oven to 350.  Mix flour with reserved tomato juice and stir into vegetables.  Simmer until mixture thickens, (about 3 minutes).  Place half the lamb in a greased 2 quart casserole.  Add half the vegetables and half the cheese and repeat layers.  Top with bread cubes and bake 20 minutes or until eggplant is tender.

title: EGGPLANT GRATIN
ingredients: Sprinkle the eggplant slices with coarse salt and allow the eggplant to stand 30 minutes.  Wipe the slices with paper towels.  Brush a baking sheet with olive oil, place the eggplant slices on it and brush the eggplant with oil.  Bake in a preheated oven 350 degrees until soft, about 30 minutes. 2.  In a skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil and saute the onion, garlic and tomato until most of the tomato liquid disappears.  Season with some of the freshly ground peppercorns, salt, and sugar.  In a small bowl, combine the ricotta, egg, creme fraiche, and half the parmigiano to create a thick custard. 3.  Arrange half the eggplant slices in the bottom of a large gratin dish.  Sprinkle with some of the peppercorns, salt and sugar, and half the chopped basil.  Spread the tomato mixture on top and sprinkle with ground peppercorns, salt and sugar and the remainder of the basil.  Cover with the rest of the eggplant.  Pour the cheese and cream mixture on top.  Sprinkle with the remainder of the parmigiano. 4.  Bake for 10 minutes in a preheated 450 degree oven, then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees and bake approximately 20 minutes more, until the surface is golden brown and puffed. Make it ahead:  You can complete the eggplant through step 3 up to 6 hours in advance and refrigerate.  When you are ready, proceed with Step 4.

title: Eggplant Ole
ingredients: Rinse eggplant and cut off the top. Peel, if desired, and cut crosswise into 1/2-inch slices. Place eggplant in a 12x7x2- inch microwave safe baking dish, overlapping the slices as needed; add water. Cover with vented microwave plastic wrap. Micro-cook on high for 5 to 7 minutes, turning the dish once; drain.  In a small mixing bowl combine tomatoes, chili peppers, oregano, cumin, salt and pepper. Top eggplant with the tomato mixture. Cook, uncovered, on high for 1 to 2 minutes or till heated through. Sprinkle cheese over all. Let stand, covered for 2 to 3 minutes or till cheese is melted. Sprinkle with cilantro

title: EGGPLANT, MERMAID STYLE
ingredients: Place eggplant slices on a sheet try and bake for 15 minutes, until golden brown at 450 degrees.  Form sandwiches out of the eggplant slices and cheese, placing cheese between two pieces of eggplant.  Dredge each sandwich in egg then flour.  Heat olive oil until very hot and fry sandwiches until golden brown.  Remove to a plate lined with paper towels.  Arrange sandwiches in a ceramic pie pan and distribute the basil leaves evenly over the sandwiches.  Season tomato with salt and pepper to taste and spoon them over the sandwiches.  Sprinkle each sandwich with Parmigiano-Reggiano and bake for 17 to 20 minutes.  Serve warm.

title: Eggroll with Pork and Shrimp Filling
instructions: FILLING In a small bowl, combine pork, shrimp, mushrooms, water chestnuts, green onion, soy sauce, cornstarch, wine, salt and beaten egg. Mix them thoroughly together.

EGG PANCAKE Beat eggs with fork or whisk, just enough to combine. To cook;  Over moderate heat use 12 or 8 inch skillet.  With pastry brush, brush bottom of pan with oil. Pour in half beaten eggs, Lower heat at once, working quickly but carefully, tip pan from side to side until a thin, round pancake about 8 inches in diameter forms.  Immediately pour any uncooked egg on surface of pancake back into bowl.  As soon as pancake is firm enough to handle, approximately 30 seconds, lift spatula and transfer to a plate. Make second pancake as first. Reserve uncooked egg.  Spread half of pork filling over each pancake.  Roll them tightly, jellyroll fashion, and seal edges with a little reserved uncooked egg. Press edges together firmly,  Lay eggrolls on heatproof platter 1/2" smaller than diameter of steamer pot. Set on rack, cover pot.  Keep water at slow boil, steam eggrolls for 20 minutes.  Cut eggrolls diagonally into 1/2 inch slices.

GRAVY SAUCE Cook in small saucepan, bring stock to a boil. Add soy sauce, salt and cornstarch mixture.  Reduce heat and cook 2 minutes until sauce is thick and clear. Pour sauce over eggrolls. Serve hot.

title: Eggs Benedict
instructions: Prepare Hollandaise Sauce and keep warm over hot water.

Hollandaise Sauce: Put into blender container; egg yolks, lemon juice, hot water, salt and cayenne. Cover and blend 20 seconds. Add melted butter slowly while blender is operating at low speed.  Pour into small sauce pan and cook over low heat, stirring until sauce is thick and smooth.

Slice muffins in half.  Spread each with 1 tsp. butter. Toast until brown.  Arrange cut side up on serving platter.  In large skillet, bring 2 inches water to simmering, add salt.  Add eggs carefully, poach 3-5 minutes.  Meanwhile in large skillet saute bacon about 3 minutes.  Arrange bacon on muffins.  Remove eggs with slotted spoon.  Place egg on top of bacon and top with Hollandaise sauce.  Garnish with cayenne.

title: EGGS IN A BLANKET*
ingredients: Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  Coat a 10 by 15 inch rimmed baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray.  Using a 2 1/2 inch round cookie cutter, cut a circle out of the center of each slice of bread (you can toast the cutouts and serve them on the side).  Brush both sides of bread slices with butter and place on the baking sheet.  Crack eggs one at a time and place in the center hole of each slice of bread.  Bake 12 to 14 minutes, or until bread is golden and eggs are cooked through.  Serve immediately.

title: Eggs, Potatoes and Cheese Casserole
ingredients: Beat egg whites until stiff peak forms.  Beat yolks one at a time into hot mashed potatoes in another large bowl.  Stir in cheese, chives, green pepper, parsley, pimiento and pepper. Fold in egg whites and stir until thoroughly mixed.  Spoon mixture into buttered baking dish.  Bake at 375 for 40 minutes, or until puffed and golden brown.  Sprinkle with paprika.

title: El Torito Chimichanga Filling
ingredients: Heat 2 T oil in dutch oven.  Add meat and brown slowly.
Cover and continue to cook over moderate heat until meat is tender
about 45 minutes.  Watch to see that juices do not cook away.  If necessary, add a small quantity of water to keep meat from sticking.
combine salt, garlic powder, pepper, cumin, bay leaf and oregano.  Add seasonings to meat as it cooks.  Add crushed tomatoes and tomato sauce and cook 5 minutes longer.  Add diced chilies to meat.
Place Serrano chile in hot lard for few minutes to blister and then combine with cilantro and water in blender and blend until pureed.
sliced tomatoes, chicken stock, accent and Worcestershire to meat mixture and cook, stirring until blended.

warm flour tortilla until pliable.  Heat lard 1 to 1/2 inch deep in skillet.  Place 1/2 cup meat mixture in center of each flour tortillas. Fold in sides, then roll.  Place seam side down in hot lard. Press down with spatula to keep from unrolling.  Fry 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and lightly browned, turning to brown both sides. Drain on paper towel.

title: El Torito Chimichangs
instructions: Heat 2 T oil in dutch oven.  Add meat and brown slowly. Cover and continue to cook over moderate heat until meat is tender, about 45 minutes.  Watch to see that juices do not cook away.  If necessary, add a small quantity of water to keep meat from sticking.

In bowl, combine salt, garlic powder, pepper, cumin, bay leaf and oregano.  Add seasonings to meat as it cooks.  Add crushed tomatoes and tomato sauce and cook 5 minutes longer.  Add diced chilies to meat.

Place Serrano chile in hot lard for few minutes to blister and then combine with cilantro and water in blender and blend until pureed.  Add chilies, sliced tomatoes, chicken stock, accent and Worcestershire to meat mixture and cook, stirring until blended.

To make chimichangas, warm flour tortilla until pliable. Heat lard 1 to 1/2 inch deep in skillet.  Place 1/2 cup meat mixture in center of each flour tortillas. Fold in sides, then roll.  Place seam side down in hot lard. Press down with spatula to keep from unrolling.
Fry 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and lightly browned, turning to brown both sides. Drain on paper towel.

title: ENGLISH TOFFEE CANDY*
instructions: Butter a 12 x 18 inch baking pan.  Set aside
Place chocolate in a double-boiler and melt, meanwhile, start preparing the toffee.

Combine butter, sugar, vanilla, water, corn syrup in a heavy saucepan, stirring constantly over medium hight heat, bring to a boil.  It should gently boil for 15 minutes or until the candy thermometer registers 300 degrees.  Pour immediately into the prepared buttered pan and spread evenly.  Sprinkle 1 cup chopped pecans over evenly.  Let sit on counter for 3 minutes, then put pan in refrigerator to cool completely.
Pour melted chocolate over spreading evenly and then sprinkle the crushed almonds all over.  Let harden in refirgerator.
With a knife crack the candy and put in a tin.
Description: "RECIPELINK"

title: Escalloped Eggs and Pea Casserole
instructions: Combine eggs and peas in buttered casserole and cover with white sauce.  Sprinkle bread crumbs over top. (brown bread crumbs in butter first). Bake 30 minutes
WHITE SAUCE Combine butter and flour. Stir until smooth and add milk, cook until thick, stirring. Salt and pepper to taste.

title: Evelyn's Cinnamon Rolls
ingredients: In a saucepan, combine milk, 1/2 cup sugar, and salt. Warm (stirring constantly to keep sugar from sticking).
Add the shortening to the warm milk/sugar mixture, just to soften it. Put into a mixing bowl and cool.
In a small bowl, soak dry yeast and 1/2 tsp. sugar in warm water for 5 minutes, without stirring. After the 5 minutes, stir mixture and add to the above mixture.
Begin stirring in 4 cups of flour. When dough gets somewhat stiff, turn out onto a floured board or cloth and gently knead dough for a few minutes, until dough does not stick to board.
Place the dough into a greased bowl. Cover lightly with a cloth. Place in warm place to rise for about 1 1/2 hrs. Punch down dough and turn over. Cover with cloth and let rise again for 30 minutes.
After the second rising, roll the dough out on your floured cloth or board into an oblong shape, approx. 9" x 18". Spread with softened butter and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Roll up tightly, beginning at wide side. Seal by pinching edges of roll together. Cut roll into 1" slices. Place a little apart on greased cookie sheet.
Cover and let rise in warm place about 40 minutes.
Bake at 375° for about 12 minutes, or until lightly done.
Just before serving, top rolls with icing made from powdered sugar mixed with enough water to form a thick consistency.

title: Face Up Sandwich
ingredients: Arrange muffin halves on cookie sheet. Top each with tomato then two slices of bacon. Cut cheese diagonally in halves and place two over bacon. Broil till cheese melts.

title: Fall Apple Cake
ingredients: In a large mixer bowl, beat sugar and oil on medium speed till combined; add eggs and vanilla.  Beat for 1 minute or till creamy.  Stir in juice.  In a medium mixing bowl stir together the flour, whole wheat flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and baking soda.  Stir flour mixture into egg mixture.  Gently stir in the apples and nuts.  Pour the batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Bake 350 for 60-65 minutes or till wooden pick comes out clean. Cool in pan for 10 minutes. Remove from pan; cool on a wire rack for 30  minutes. Serve warm. If desired, sprinkle with powdered sugar, top each slice with a dollop of vanilla yogurt and additional nutmeg.

title: FALL RIVER CLAM CHOWDER*
instructions: In a stockpot, over medium-high heat, render the bacon, until crispy, about 6 minutes.  Stir in the leeks, onions, celery and carrots.  Saute for about 2 minutes or until the vegetables start to wilt.

Season the vegetables with salt and pepper.  Add the bay leaves and thyme.  Stir in the flour and cook for 2 minutes.  Add the potatoes.  Stir in the clam juice.  Bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer.  Simmer the mixture until the potatoes are fork tender, about 12 minutes.  Add the cream and bring up to a simmer.  Add the clams and simmer for 2 minutes.  Stir in the parsley.  Season with salt and pepper if needed.
Description: "EMERIL LAGASSE"

title: Fantastic Slow Cooker Roast
ingredients: (.7ounce) package dry italian-style salad dressing mix
(1 (.75 ounce) packet dry brown gravy mix
instructions: Whisk together the first 4 ingredients until smooth.
Place roast in slow cooker and pour sauce over the top.
Cook on low for 6 hours.
Add the rest of the ingredients and cook an additional 1-2 hours.

title: Far East Albacore Steaks
ingredients: In a small bowl combine soy sauce, orange juice, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, onions and olive oil, mix well.  Pour over tuna, marinate for 4 to 6 hours or overnight (refrigerate). Grill tuna over hot grill until done, 6 to 8 minutes for each side.

title: Farm In A Blanket
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. In a medium saute pan over medium heat add the oil and saute onions and raisins until both are tender, about 10 minutes. Set aside to cool.

Roll out 6 of the crescent pastry rolls and slice in half forming 2 triangles and 12 pieces total. To assemble, place a piece of salami and cheese on 1 triangle. Add a dollop of the onion mixture in the center. Starting at the wider edge, roll the crescent triangle to form a small croissant. Place seam side down on a baking sheet. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Sprinkle poppy seeds over each roll and bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Farro Risotto with Arugula, Lemon, and Parmesan
ingredients: grated lemon zest plus 1 teaspoon juice
instructions: Combine onion, oil, and 1/4 teaspoon salt in large saucepan. Cover and cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, 8 to 10 minutes. Stir in garlic and thyme and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Stir in farro and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes. Stir in broth and water and bring to simmer. Reduce heat to low and continue to simmer, stirring often, until farro is tender, 20 to 25 minutes.
Off heat, stir in arugula, Parmesan, parsley, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve.
Per serving:	PER 3/4-CUP SERVING: Cal 270; Fat 6g; Sat fat 1g; Chol 5mg; Carb 47g; Protein 10g; Fiber 6g; Sodium 430mg_____

title: Farro with Feta Cucumbers and Sun-Dried Tomatoes
ingredients: kosher salt and fresh cracked pepper to taste
instructions: Cook farro in salted water according to package directions until al dente, about 15-20 minutes. Drain and let cool.
Combine with remaining ingredients and toss well. Serve chilled or room temperature.

title: Fast and Easy Chicken Pot Pies
ingredients: Cook onion in butter. Stir in flour, bouillon and seasonings. Add milk and water.  Cook and let thicken, about 5 minutes. Stir in chicken and vegetables.  Heat thoroughly.  Pour into 2 individual casseroles.  Quarter 2 biscuits.  Top the hot filling with biscuits.  Put casseroles on baking sheet. Arrange remaining biscuits along side of pan.  Bake at 400 for 10-12 minutes.

title: Favorite Layer Bars
instructions: Combine crumbs sugar and margarine, press onto bottom of 13 x 9 inch baking pan. Bake at 350 for 5 minutes.

Combine cream cheese, sugar and egg, mixing until well blended. Spread over crust. Sprinkle with remaining ingredients, press lightly into surface.  Bake at 350, 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool and cut into bars.

title: FENNEL, ROASTED TOMATO, AND BASIL RELISH*
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.  Slice tomatoes in half lengthwise; arrange them, cut side down, in a single layer on baking sheet.  Place garlic cloves on baking sheet next to tomatoes.  Roast in oven until tomatoes are soft and wrinkled and garlic is aromatic and tender, about 35 minutes.  Remove from oven, and let cool.  In a medium bowl, combine fennel with vinegar, capers, red-pepper flakes, and oil.  Stir to combine.  Finely chop garlic and roughly chop tomatoes; add to bowl.  Slice basil into fine strips; add to bowl along with parsley.  stir to combine; serve chilled or at room temperature.
Description: "COOKING LIGHT"

title: Fettuccine All'alfredo
ingredients: Cook fettuccine in boiling, lightly salted water until just tender and drain. Rinse with hot water and drain again. While the fettuccine cooks, combine 2/3 C whipping cream and 1/2 C butter in a saucepan or skillet large enough to hold fettuccine. Cook over low heat until butter melts and mixture is thickened. Add drained fettuccine to cream mixture. Place over how heat and toss to coat fettuccine. Add remaining whipping cream, remaining butter, Parmesan cheese, a light sprinkle of salt and pepper. Toss until butter melts and fettuccine is well coated. Serve at once with additional Parmesan cheese on the side.

title: Fettucine Alfredo
ingredients: Pre-cook the fettucine for 6 minutes, then place in colander and run cold water over them to stop their cooking any further, they can be refrigerated for later use. Place butter in large frying pan.  When butter is melted, add noodles and toss in butter over high heat.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Add heavy cream and the parmesan cheese.  Mix together and let mixture bubble until sauce just begins to thicken.  Remove and serve immediately.

title: FILA TRIANGLES WITH CRAB  FILLING*
ingredients: coarse salt and freshly ground pepper
instructions: Chop shrimp meat.  Set aside.  Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a small skillet, and saute the green onions for 2 or 3 minutes.  Add the lobster meat and wine and stir quickly to combine over high heat.  Drain the mixture, reserving the liquid.

Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter in another skillet.  Add the flour and cook slowly without coloring the flour for 5 minutes.  Add the reserved liquid and the cream, and stir constantly until the mixture begins to thicken.  Stir the crab meat back into the mixture, add cayenne pepper, and season to taste.
Cool the mixture completely before filling the triangles.

Place 1 sheet of phyllo on a flat surface and brush with butter.  Top with 2 more sheets, buttering each.  Cut in half crosswise.  Then cut each half lenthwise into 2 1/2 inch wide strips.   Spoon a teaspoon of filling onto the end of each strip and form a triangle by folding the right-hand corner to the opposite side, as you would a flag.  Continue folding until the strip is used.  Repeat the whole process until all the filling is used.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Place on a buttered baking sheet.  Brush with melted butter and bake until golden brown, about 10 minutes.
Triangles can be frozen.  Cook from frozen 20 minutes.
Description: "MARTHA STEWART"

title: Filet of Sole
ingredients: filets Sole rinsed and dried with paper towel
instructions: 3333 cup Vegetable oil
Consider pre-heating your dinner plates in the oven on the very lowest setting. Sole will cool quickly, due to its large surface area, and is far better served warm.
Whisk egg and milk together; add salt and freshly ground pepper to taste.
Set out 3 plates. Place egg mixture in one, spread flour in another, and breadcrumbs in the third.
Take rinsed and dried fillets, and:
1) dredge in flour, and shake off excess. Then,
2) coat with egg, and wipe off excess, then
3) coat liberally with seasoned breadcrumbs
Wait until you are only about 6 minutes away from sitting down and eating, then proceed. Sole cools very quickly.

Put large flat saute pan on medium high, place olive oil in it, and allow it to come up to full heat, about 2 minutes. Do not rush this step you really want the pan piping hot! Then, place sole in the pan, dropping it down away from you to prevent hot oil from splattering on you. Wait about 2 minutes, until filets are browned, and flip.

title: Fillet of Beef Bordelaise
ingredients: Saute onion and garlic in butter until translucent, remove and add flour and cook stirring constantly until light brown.  Add beef consomme gradually with wine and stir over medium heat until smooth.  Add browned garlic and onion, catsup, worcestershire sauce, celery salt, sugar and salt. Simmer covered 30 minutes stirring frequently.  Trim fat from beef and cut into diagonal strips 1/4".   Brown meat in oil and remove from pan.  Add sauce to drippings, cook 2 minutes, then add meat.  Cook 1 minute, don't over cook.

title: Fire-roasted Tomato and Winter Squash Soup with Shrimp
instructions: 5	teaspoons	salt
1	teaspoon	ground black pepper
12		cooked large shrimp	peeled and the tails left on
Cracked black pepper

Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. Cut squash in half and  discard the seeds. Place squash, cut sides down, on prepared baking sheet. Cut 0.25 inch off of the pointed end of garlic bulb, keeping cloves intact. Place garlic, cut side up, on a small sheet of aluminum foil. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Wrap garlic in foil and place on the baking sheet with squash. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until squash and garlic are very tender. When cool enough to handle, scoop squash pulp from peel into a small bowl; discard peels. Squeeze garlic pulp into bowl. In the container of a blender, combine squash, garlic pulp, remaining 2 tablespoons oil, 1 cup broth, and tomatoes; process until smooth. Pour mixture into a medium saucepan, and pepper. Cook over medium heat until warm. Spoon into small serving cups; top each serving with a shrimp. Garnish with cracked black pepper if desired. Serving Size Makes 12 servings

title: Firecracker Burgers with Cooling Lime Sauce
instructions: Combine ground beef and seasoning ingredients in large bowl, mixing lightly but thoroughly. Shape into four 3/4-inch thick patties. Place patties on grid over medium, ash-covered coals.
Grill, uncovered, 13 to 15 minutes to medium (160°F) doneness, until not pink in center and juices show no pink color, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile combine sauce ingredients in small bowl; set aside.
Spread sauce on cut sides of rolls. Place a burger on bottom half of each roll; top evenly with watercress. Close sandwiches.

Per serving:	600 calories; 38 g protein; 31 g carbohydrate; 35 g fat; 1,502 mg sodium; 125 mg cholesterol; 8.3 mg niacin; 0.5 mg vitamin B6; 3.7 mcg vitamin B12; 5.1 mg iron; 8.5 mg zinc. This recipe is an excellent source of protein, niacin, vitamin B6, vitamin B12, iron and zinc._____

title: Fish Espanol
ingredients: Brush shallow baking dish with 1/2 tsp. olive oil.  Heat 3 T olive oil and saute sliced onions until transparent.  Season with paprika and sugar, cook 1 minute.  Cover bottom of baking dish with cooked onions.  Rub fish with cut lemon and arrange fish fillets over onions and sprinkle with salt, pepper and cayenne.  Top with tomatoes.  In small skillet, heat 2 T olive oil and saute mushrooms 2 to 3 minutes.  Add sherry and cook 1 minute.  Stir in green onions.  Spoon mushrooms over fish.  Cover loosely with oiled wax paper and bake at 400 for 15 minutes.  Uncover and top with buttered crumbs.  Bake 15 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily with a fork.  Allow dish to rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Fish Espanol
ingredients: Brush shallow baking dish with 1/2 t olive oil. Heat 3 T olive oil and saute sliced onions until transparent. Season with paprika and sugar and cook 1 minute longer. Cover bottom of baking dish with cooked onions. Rub fish with cut lemon and arrange fish fillets or steaks over onions and sprinkle with salt, pepper and cayenne. Top with tomatoes. In a small skillet, heat 2 T olive oil and saute mushrooms 2 to 3 minutes. Add sherry to pan and cook 1 minute longer. Stir in green onions. Spoon mushrooms over fish. Cover loosely with oiled parchment or wax paper and bake at 400 degrees 15 minutes. Uncover and top with buttered crumbs. Bake 15 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Allow dish to rest 5 to 7 minutes before serving.

title: Fish Tacos 2
ingredients: Mix ingredients for dipping sauce.  Mix batter.  Dip fish in batter and deep fry.

title: FLAKY BUTTERMILK BISCUITS 1
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.  Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups; level with a knife.  Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl; cut in butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal.  Chill 10 minutes.  Combine buttermilk and honey, stirring until well blended.  Add buttermilk mixture to flour mixture; stir just until moist.

Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead lightly 4 times.  Roll dough into a (1/2 inch thick) 9 x 5 inch rectangle; dust top of dough with flour.  Fold dough (crosswise into thirds (as if folding a piece of paper to fit into an envelope).  Reroll dough into a 9 x 5 inch rectangle, dust with flour and fold in thirds; gently pat to a 3/4 inch thickness.  Cut dough with a 1/14 inch biscuit cutter to form 14 dough rounds.  Place dough rounds, 1 inch apart, on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  Bake at 400 degrees for 12 minutes or until golden brown.  Remove from pan; cool 2 minutes on wire racks.  Serve warm.
(It made 20 rolls.  2 points WW

title: FLAKY BUTTERMILK BISCUITS 2
instructions: Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position; heat oven to 450 degrees.  Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in large bowl.

Add shortening to flour mixture; break up chunks with fingertips until only small, pea-sized pieces remain.  Working in batches, drop butter slices into flour mixture and toss to coat; pick up each slice of butter and press between floured fingertips into flat, nickel-sized pieces.  Repeat until all butter is incorporated; toss to combine.  Freeze mixture (in bowl) until chilled, about 15 minutes.

Spray 24 inch square area of work surface with nonstick cooking spray; spread spray evenly across surface with kitchen towl or paper towl.  Sprinkle 1/3 cup of extra flour across sprayed area; gently spread flour across work surface with palm to form thin, even coating.

Add all but two tablespoons of buttermilk to flour mixture; stir briskly with fork until ball forms and no dry bits of flour are visible, adding remaining buttermilk as needed (dough will be sticky and shaggy but should clear sides of bowl).  With rubber spatula, transfer dough onto center of prepared work surface, dust surface lightly with floured hands, bring dough together into cohesive ball.

Pat dough into approximately 10 inch square; roll into 18 by 14 inch rectangle about 1/4 inch thick, dusting dough and rolling pin with flour as needed.
