In a large skillet melt the 1/4 cup butter; add diced bacon, the 1/2 cup onion and garlic. Cook and stir about 5 minutes or till bacon is golden and onion is tender. Stir in the 1/4 cup wine, parsley, 1 tsp. salt and 1/4 tsp. pepper, add to cooked mixture with nuts. Toss till well mixed.
Stuff into turkey cavity. Bake any additional stuffing in a covered casserole for the last 30 minutes of roasting.

title: WINE CAKE
ingredients: Put all ingredients in bowl.  Beat at high speed for about 5 minutes.  Pour into buttered bundt pan.  Bake 45 minutes at 350 degrees.  Cool in pan.  Turn out onto plate and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Wine Marinated Leg of Lamb
ingredients: Combine wine, water, oil and seasonings; pour over lamb in shallow dish. Cover and marinate one day, turning lamb occasionally. Place lamb on rack in shallow roasting pan; reserve marinade. Roast in 325 degree oven 30 minutes per lb. until meat thermometer registers 175, basting occasionally with marinade. If desired, prepare gravy using pan drippings. Or, add one-cup dry red wine to any marinade left, add to drippings and simmer for 5 minutes.

title: Wine Sponge Cake
ingredients: Almonds in blender, mix flour, almonds, salt and cinnamon. Beat egg whites till peaks. Beat egg yolks, beat in sugar. Stir in wine and orange juice. Add yolk mixture in flour mixture. Add beaten egg whites and pour into tube pan. Bake 325 for one hour. Remove from pan. Powder with powdered sugar.

title: WON TONS
ingredients: Saute pork in 1 Tablespoon oil until brown.  Add water chestnuts, garlic salt, soy sauce, green onions.  Blend sherry with cornstarch.  Add to pork and cook and stir 1 minute.  Cool filling.  (You need trays with moist paper towels to cover won tons.  Heat oil to 360 degrees.  Take a won ton skin.  Put a small amount of filling in a corner.  Put egg wash on edges.  Fold for won tons.  When you have all the won tons made, deep fry.  At this point, you can freeze them.  Take out of freezer about an hour before you need them.  When you are almost ready, pop them in a 350 degree oven until hot.  Serve with chili sauce and hot mustard or sweet and sour sauce.)

title: WORLD'S BEST VANILLA ICE CREAM
ingredients: In a medium saucepan, heat milk, vanilla bean, which has been split lengthwise and scraped.  Bring to a gentle boil, cover and remove from heat.  Steep for 30 minutes.  Combine egg yolks and sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer.  Beat at medium high speed until very thick and pale yellow, 3 to 5 minutes.  Meanwhile, return milk to a simmer.  Remove vanilla bean.  Add half the milk to egg-yolk mixture, and whisk until blended.  Stir inito remaining milk, and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thick enough to coat a spoon.  Remove from heat, and immediately stir in cream.  Pass mixture through a strainer into a medium bowl, set over an ice bath so it begins to chill.  Stir in vanilla extract, then freeze in an ice cream maker according to directions.

title: Ww Banana Nut Pancakes
instructions: Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl. Combine milk, egg white and mashed bananas in a bowl and mix until smooth. Combine wet ingredients with the dry and mix well with a spoon until there are no more dry spots. Don't over-mix.

Heat a large skillet on medium heat. Spray oil to lightly coat and pour 1/4 cup of pancake batter. When the pancake starts to bubble and the edges begin to set, flip the pancakes. Repeat with the remainder of the batter.
Makes about 3 cups of batter which yields 12 pancakes.  2 pancakes = 4

title: WW Zucchini Pancakes*
ingredients: kosher salt and fresh pepper to taste

Grate zucchini using the large holes of a cheese grater and place in a large bowl. Add flour, shallots, garlic, parsley, chives, eggs, cheese, salt and pepper. Season with salt and pepper. Heat a large skillet over medium heat and spray oil to cover pan. Drop tablespoons of the batter into the skillet. Cook about 2 minutes on each side until golden brown. Set aside and keep warm. Spray more oil in the skillet as needed, and continue with remaining batter. Makes about 20 small pancakes.  5 pancakes = 3 ww pts.

title: Yeasted Buttermilk Waffles
ingredients: or low-fat milk, or skim milk
instructions: Heat milk and butter in small saucepan over medium-low heat until butter is melted, 3 to 5 minutes. Cool milk/butter mixture until warm to touch. Meanwhile, whisk flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in large bowl to combine. Gradually whisk warm milk/butter mixture into flour mixture; continue to whisk until batter is smooth. In small bowl, whisk eggs and vanilla until combined, then add egg mixture to batter and whisk until incorporated. Scrape down sides of bowl with rubber spatula, cover bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate at least 12 and up to 24 hours.

Following manufacturer’s instructions, heat waffle iron; remove waffle batter from refrigerator when waffle iron is hot (batter will be foamy and doubled in size). Whisk batter to recombine (batter will deflate). Bake waffles according to manufacturer’s instructions (use about ½ cup for 7-inch round iron and about 1 cup for 9-inch square iron). Serve waffles immediately or hold in low temperature oven (see above note).

title: Yorkshire Pudding
ingredients: Beat well egg and flour and salt, then add milk and beat well. Make about 1 hour before baking. Beat before putting in pan. Bake 325 for 10 minutes, 425 till done. Use 9 x 13 pan. Pour drippings from roast beef or bacon drippings into pan then pour batter. Serve with roast beef.

title: Yorkshire Pudding
ingredients: pan drippings from roast prime rib of beef
Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F.

Sift together the flour and salt in a bowl. In another bowl, beat together the eggs and milk until light and foamy. Stir in the dry ingredients just until incorporated. Pour the drippings into a 9-inch pie pan, cast iron skillet, or square baking dish. Put the pan in oven and get the drippings smoking hot. Carefully take the pan out of the oven and pour in the batter. Put the pan back in oven and cook until puffed and dry, 15 to 20 minutes.

title: Zesty Beef 'n' Bean Wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Combine ground beef, beans, stuffing mix, lime juice and pepper in large bowl, mixing lightly but thoroughly.
Spread mixture evenly in 12-inch pizza pan.
Bake in 375°F oven 15 minutes to medium (160°F) doneness, until beef is not pink in center and juices show no pink color.
Sprinkle with cheese, continue baking 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. Sprinkle with green onions; cut into 8 wedges. Garnish with lime wedges, if desired.

title: Zucchini Cookies
ingredients: Cream butter and sugar. Beat in egg and vanilla; stir in zucchini. Stir in flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Add almonds and chocolate chips. Drop by heaping tsp. onto greased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes or until lightly browned. Cool on wire rack. Sift powdered sugar over cookies.

title: Zucchini Gratin
ingredients: cut into ½ to ¼ inch diagonal slices
instructions: Sauté the zucchini in the butter over high heat just until a little color appears on the zucchini. Season with salt and pepper. Pour zucchini into gratin casserole.
In a bowl, combine the eggs and cream and whisk until smooth.  Pour this mixture over the zucchini. Sprinkle the bread crumbs evenly over the zucchini. Top with the grated cheese.
Bake in a 400°F oven for 15 minutes until the custard is set and the top is browned.

title: Zucchini Herb Casserole
instructions: Combine the rice and water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes, until rice is tender.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a shallow 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.

Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat, and cook the zucchini, green onions, and garlic 5 minutes, or until tender. Season with garlic salt, basil, paprika, and oregano. Mix in the cooked rice, tomatoes, and 1 cup cheese. Continue to cook and stir until heated through. Transfer to the prepared casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake uncovered 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Zucchini Herb Casserole
instructions: Combine the rice and water in a saucepan, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 20 minutes, until rice is tender.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a shallow 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.

Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat, and cook the zucchini, green onions, and garlic 5 minutes, or until tender. Season with garlic salt, basil, paprika, and oregano. Mix in the cooked rice, tomatoes, and 1 cup cheese. Continue to cook and stir until heated through. Transfer to the prepared casserole dish. Top with remaining cheese.
Bake uncovered 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Zucchini Pancakes
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F.

Grate the zucchini into a bowl using the large grating side of a box grater. Immediately stir in the onion and eggs. Stir in 6 tablespoons of the flour, the baking powder, salt, and pepper. (If the batter gets too thin from the liquid in the zucchini, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of flour.)

Heat a large (10 to 12-inch) saute pan over medium heat and melt 1/2 tablespoon butter and 1/2 tablespoon oil together in the pan. When the butter is hot but not smoking, lower the heat to medium-low and drop heaping soup spoons of batter into the pan. Cook the pancakes about 2 minutes on each side, until browned. Place the pancakes on a sheet pan and keep warm in the oven. Wipe out the pan with a dry paper towel, add more butter and oil to the pan, and continue to fry the pancakes until all the batter is used. The pancakes can stay warm in the oven for up to 30 minutes. Serve hot.  (Serve with sour cream and minced chives.)

title: Zucchini Vinaigrette
ingredients: Cut ends from each zucchini and slice lengthwise into 5 pieces. Cook in small amount of salted boiling water until crisp tender. Drain on paper towel and cool. Combine salad dressing mix, vinegar, oil, green pepper, parsley, green onion and sweet pickle relish in a jar with a tight lid. Cover and shake to mix well. Pour over zucchini and chill overnight.

title: Zucchini-apple Bread
ingredients: Combine, flour, salt, soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg; set aside. Combine eggs, sugar, oil and vanilla in a large bowl; beat at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended. Stir in zucchini, apple and pecans. Add dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Spoon batter into 3 greased and floured 8 x 4 x 3-inch loaf pans. Bake at 350 for 50 - 55 minutes. Cool in pans 10 minutes; remove to wire rack and cool completely.
